AI.tldr: 本文提出StateBridge交通视频-语言框架，在仅使用合成数据训练的条件下，通过结构化证据构造与多模型融合提升交通场景描述与视觉问答的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 交通安全视频包含丰富的行人-车辆交互信息，但真实场景训练成本高、获取受限；模型需要能够从合成场景中学习并迁移到真实交通环境，因此合成到真实评测的设置具有较大挑战。
AI.method: 作者提出StateBridge框架，采用阶段感知片段构造、行人和车辆轨迹摘要以及结构化提示，将视觉语言模型锚定到稳定的交通证据上；随后在合成描述与视觉问答样本上微调公开视觉语言模型，并通过事实锁定的描述融合和证据多样化的视觉问答共识进一步提升跨行为角色、阶段和问题类型的一致性。
AI.result: StateBridge仅使用合成训练数据，在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 2上取得了官方S2分数55.4679，验证了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果说明，面向交通安全描述和视觉问答的结构化证据迁移能够提升模型从合成场景到真实场景的泛化能力。

title: Automated Nucleus Segmentation in Histology Images: An Attention U-Net Approach with Comprehensive Preprocessing and Inference Pipelines
summary: Objectives: In the area of digital pathology, nucleus segmentation is an essential step for quantitative analysis; however, high nuclear density and staining heterogeneity in histology images pose a great challenge. Methods: This study implements a lightweight Attention U-Net model on the MoNuSeg 2018 dataset to overcome these challenges. The proposed pipeline integrates comprehensive image and mask preprocessing, including stain deconvolution and multi-pass mask smoothing, with a high-fidelity overlapping patch-stitching strategy during inference on high-resolution images. Results: The model achieved an Intersection over Union (IoU) score of 0.8745 on full-resolution, unseen test images. This result demonstrates the effectiveness of attention mechanisms in enhancing feature localization and validates the stitching methodology for generating seamless and accurate segmentation maps. Conclusion: Attention U-Net is an effective and competitive method for automated, scalable nucleus delineation in challenging clinical contexts.
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures

AI.tldr: 该研究针对数字病理图像中细胞核密度高、染色不均导致分割困难的问题，实现了一个轻量级 Attention U-Net 模型，并结合预处理与重叠图块拼接推理策略，在 MoNuSeg 2018 数据集上取得了 IoU 0.8745 的全分辨率未见测试集表现，证明其适合自动化、可扩展的细胞核分割任务。
AI.motivation: 在数字病理分析中，准确分割细胞核是定量分析的关键步骤；但组织病理图像中常见的核密度过高、染色异质性强等问题会显著降低分割难度，因此需要兼顾精度与计算成本的模型和推理策略。
AI.method: 研究在 MoNuSeg 2018 数据集上构建轻量级 Attention U-Net 分割流程。该方法包括：对图像和标签掩码进行预处理，采用染色解卷积以及多轮掩码平滑；在高分辨率图像推理阶段使用高保真重叠图块拼接策略，以生成完整、连续且准确的分割图。
AI.result: 模型在全分辨率、未见过的测试图像上取得 IoU 0.8745。结果表明，注意力机制能够增强特征定位能力，重叠拼接方法也能有效提升高分辨率病理图像分割结果的连续性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: Attention U-Net 在高核密度和染色不均的病理图像场景中是一种有效且具有竞争力的细胞核分割方法，可支持自动化、可扩展的临床数字病理分析。

title: PixGR: Pixel-Space Generative Decoding for Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: We present PixGR, an efficient framework that integrates lightweight pixel-space generative modeling into feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction to model scene uncertainty. Context observations are encoded once into a scene latent representation, which conditions generative decoding from noisy target views to produce a shared 3D Gaussian representation. We formulate this process using pixel-space flow matching, enabling end-to-end optimization of 3D reconstruction with direct pixel-space generative supervision through differentiable rendering. This avoids VAE-based latent compression and error propagation inherent in previous two-stage pipelines. To preserve feed-forward efficiency, PixGR caches the scene representation and performs iterative inference using a lightweight DiT decoder. Experiments demonstrate that PixGR outperforms regression-based approaches in challenging sparse-view settings, particularly with widely spaced observations and view extrapolation. Meanwhile, it maintains sub-second inference and remains competitive with substantially heavier pretrained generative models. Our project page is available at this https URL.
comment: Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: PixGR 将轻量像素空间生成模型与前馈式 3D Gaussian 重建结合，通过像素空间 flow matching 对场景不确定性建模，在稀疏视角下实现高质量、亚秒级推理的 3D Gaussian 重建。
AI.motivation: 传统前馈式 3D Gaussian 重建在多视角监督不足或视角分布外推困难时往往表现有限，而基于扩散/生成模型的方案通常需要 VAE 潜空间压缩、两阶段流程或重型预训练生成模型，导致误差传播、优化困难和推理效率低下。该工作旨在构建一个既保留前馈式 3D 重建效率，又能在像素空间直接利用生成监督来建模场景不确定性的框架。
AI.method: 作者提出 PixGR：首先将上下文观测图像编码一次为场景潜在表示；随后以该场景潜变量为条件，使用像素空间 flow matching 从噪声目标视角生成图像，并将其监督通过可微渲染反馈到 3D Gaussian 表示中，实现端到端优化。生成解码器采用轻量 DiT，并缓存场景表示，以保持前馈式效率和迭代推断能力。整个过程避免依赖 VAE 潜空间压缩，减少两阶段管线中的误差传播。
AI.result: 实验表明，PixGR 在具有挑战性的稀疏视角设置中优于基于回归的方法，尤其适用于观测视角间隔较大以及需要视角外推的场景。同时，该框架保持亚秒级推理速度，并在性能上与参数量和计算开销显著更大的预生成模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PixGR 展示了将像素空间生成建模与前馈式 3D Gaussian 重建有效结合的可行性。其核心优势在于利用 direct pixel-space generative supervision 和可微渲染，在不牺牲推理效率的情况下提升稀疏视角 3D 重建对场景不确定性的建模能力，为高效生成式 3D 重建提供了新范式。

title: Synthetic-to-Real Text-Based Person Anomaly Search via Multi-Model Retrieval Fusion and Cross-Encoder Reranking
summary: Text-based person anomaly search requires a model to retrieve individuals from a large image gallery using natural-language descriptions of both appearance and behavior. This task is challenging because model training relies on synthetic image-text pairs, whereas evaluation is performed on real surveillance images containing domain differences, near-duplicate frames, and many visually similar distractors. We present a multi-model retrieval and reranking framework designed to improve synthetic-to-real transfer. The framework first adapts Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B to synthetic person descriptions using bidirectional contrastive learning, explicit negative sampling, false-negative masking, and domain randomization. It then combines the normalized scores of six complementary Qwen3-VL checkpoints with those of a frozen SigLIP2 model using four-view gallery encoding. The fused retrieval scores identify the strongest candidates, which are jointly evaluated with the query using Qwen3-VL-Reranker-8B. The cross-encoder and retrieval scores are subsequently blended to produce the final ranking. We also construct a distractor-matched validation protocol entirely from synthetic data to select checkpoint weights, fusion coefficients, candidate depths, and reranking parameters without accessing the official test images. The final system achieves 94.7815% mAP and 90.8493% R@1 under the official AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 test setting, with a reported eighth-place finish on the public leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个面向真实监控图像的多模型检索与重排序框架，用于文本驱动的行人异常搜索，通过从合成数据到真实场景的迁移优化，实现高检索精度，并在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4中取得较高指标和公开榜单第八名。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动的行人异常搜索需要用自然语言描述同时刻画外观与行为，并在大规模真实监控图像库中检索对应个体。该任务难点在于训练主要依赖合成图像-文本对，而测试图像来自真实监控场景，存在领域差异、近重复帧和大量视觉相似干扰样本，导致合成数据训练的检索模型难以直接迁移到真实评测。
AI.method: 作者构建一个多模型检索与重排序框架：首先对Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B进行适配，利用双向对比学习、显式负样本采样、假负样本屏蔽和域随机化，使其更好理解合成行人描述；随后在检索阶段融合六个互补的Qwen3-VL checkpoint以及冻结的SigLIP2模型分数，并采用四视图gallery编码来增强候选召回；最后使用Qwen3-VL-Reranker-8B对查询和候选进行联合评估，将交叉编码器重排序分数与检索融合分数进行混合得到最终排名。为适应测试图像不可访问的设定，作者还设计完全基于合成数据的干扰样本匹配验证协议，用于选择checkpoint权重、融合系数、候选深度和重排序参数。
AI.result: 最终系统在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4官方测试设定下达到94.7815% mAP和90.8493% R@1，并在公开榜单上报告为第八名，表明该框架在合成到真实监控场景的行人异常文本检索任务中具有较强竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明，在大规模真实监控检索任务中，仅依赖单一合成数据训练模型不足以应对领域差异和干扰样本。通过多模型分数融合、四视图编码、强重排序器以及可控制的合成验证协议，可以显著提升文本到行人图像检索的泛化能力，为监控视频中的异常个体搜索提供了有效的系统级解决方案。

title: LOCI: Localized Continuous Control for Multi-Subject Image Editing
summary: Recent instruction-following image editors such as Flux.1-Kontext enable text-driven editing but lack fine-grained control over where and how much an edit is applied. Existing approaches provide either continuous but global control or spatially localized editing at a fixed strength. To our knowledge, none jointly supports explicit spatial localization, continuous per-region strength, and independent simultaneous control of multiple subjects. We present LOCI (LOcalized Continuous control for multi- subject Image editing). Given a multi-subject image with per-subject regions and instructions, LOCI edits each subject at an independently chosen, continuously adjustable strength, for instance gradually aging one person while adding a beard to another with minimal cross-region leakage. LOCI pairs subject-level attention binding for spatial isolation with a Regional LoRA layer that replaces the LoRA's scalar coefficient with a per-token scaling vector aligned to the spatial layout. A single adapter is trained at one suppression point, and continuous edit strengths follow by rescaling its regional residual at inference. Experiments on multi-subject scenes demonstrate that LOCI achieves strong edit fidelity with significantly reduced cross-region interference compared to baselines, while maintaining continuous control over edit strength

AI.tldr: LOCI提出面向多主体图像的局部化连续指令编辑方法，通过主体级注意力绑定和区域化LoRA残差缩放，实现可空间限定、可按区域连续调节编辑强度且多主体互不干扰的图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有指令驱动图像编辑器虽能按文本编辑图像，但难以精确控制编辑发生的位置和程度：全局控制连续但空间不精准，空间局部控制又常固定强度。作者指出缺少一种能同时支持明确空间区域限定、区域级连续编辑强度以及多个主体独立并行控制的方案。
AI.method: LOCI接受包含多个主体区域及其编辑指令的图像。其核心设计有两类：一是主体级注意力绑定，用于在空间上将编辑影响限制在对应主体区域，降低跨区域泄漏；二是Regional LoRA层，将传统LoRA的全局标量系数替换为与空间布局对齐的逐token缩放向量。训练时只需在单一抑制强度点训练一个适配器，推理时通过重新缩放区域残差获得连续可变的编辑强度，从而对不同主体分别施加强度可调的编辑。
AI.result: 在多主体场景实验中，LOCI相比基线方法展现出较强的编辑保真度，并显著减少跨区域干扰，同时保持对编辑强度的连续控制能力。
AI.conclusion: LOCI为指令式图像编辑提供了一种更细粒度的控制范式：既能定位编辑区域，又能连续调节每个区域的编辑强度，并支持多主体独立编辑。其单适配器训练、推理重缩放区域残差的设计，兼顾了控制精度、灵活性和部署效率。

title: STEP: Surgical Point Tracking from Sparse Endpoints and Pseudo-trajectories
summary: Surgical point tracking requires persistent correspondence through tissue deformation and occlusion, yet dense trajectory annotations are costly to obtain. We present STEP, a two-stage framework that learns from surgical video and sparse physical endpoints. First, a frozen offline teacher generates candidate trajectories, and temporal reversibility and stereo consistency select dense supervision for a causal student. Second, a robust physical endpoint loss anchors terminal correspondence, while a round-trip loss constrains temporal consistency. A gradient-free prefix exposes training to accumulated drift, while a final differentiable window bounds activation memory. The trained tracker processes a single RGB stream with fixed weights. In STIR-to-VL-SurgPT transfer, temporal-stereo union selection reduces endpoint error by 7.0% relative to unfiltered trajectories. On a post-hoc diagnostic of 29 VL-SurgPT clips excluded from the endpoint-training manifest, STEP reduces endpoint error from 31.52 to 16.80 pixels relative to dense-label fine-tuning. These results support combining curated trajectories with physical observations to train surgical point trackers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEP，一种利用手术视频与稀疏物理终点信息进行手术点跟踪的两阶段框架：先由冻结的离线teacher生成候选轨迹并通过时序可逆性和立体一致性筛选伪监督，再结合物理终点损失与往返损失训练因果student，最终仅需单路RGB流和固定权重即可跟踪。
AI.motivation: 手术点跟踪需要在组织形变和遮挡下保持持久对应关系，但密集轨迹标注成本高、难以获取，因此需要一种减少对稠密人工标注依赖的训练方式。
AI.method: 第一阶段，冻结的离线teacher生成候选轨迹，并利用temporal reversibility和stereo consistency筛选高质量稠密监督信号来训练因果student。第二阶段，引入鲁棒的physical endpoint loss锚定终端对应关系，并使用round-trip loss约束时间一致性；同时通过gradient-free prefix让训练暴露于累计漂移，最后用可微窗口限制激活显存。训练完成后的tracker仅处理单路RGB流，权重固定。
AI.result: 在STIR到VL-SurgPT的迁移实验中，temporal-stereo union选择相比未筛选轨迹使端点误差降低7.0%。在29个被排除于端点训练清单的VL-SurgPT片段上进行事后诊断时，STEP相比稠密标签微调将端点误差从31.52像素降低到16.80像素。
AI.conclusion: 结合经筛选的伪轨迹监督与稀疏物理观测能够有效训练手术点跟踪器，为在缺乏密集标注的视频手术场景中实现稳定点对应学习提供了可行路径。

title: Spectra: Multi-Scale Implicit Decomposition for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfakes increasingly undermine trust in digital media, yet existing detectors often struggle to generalize across unseen manipulation techniques, compression levels, and dataset shifts. Most approaches rely on RGB appearance, frequency-domain artifacts, or their combination, learning cues present in the final synthesized image. While effective in-distribution, such cues are frequently generator-specific and can diminish as synthesis models evolve. We argue that a complementary perspective can be obtained through implicit neural representations (INRs), which expose how an image is reconstructed rather than merely how it appears. By fitting an INR to an image and analyzing its internal activations, one can reveal reconstruction dynamics that are difficult to observe in the image domain alone and may capture more intrinsic differences between genuine and synthetic content. To this end, we propose Spectra, a deepfake detection framework that combines semantic visual representations with artifact-aware cues derived from INR reconstruction. Spectra extracts multi-level reconstruction heatmaps from image-specific INRs and jointly models them with semantic features through a bidirectional fusion mechanism. This enables direct interaction between image semantics and reconstruction artifacts, allowing the model to identify forgery cues that are less dependent on specific generation pipelines. Extensive experiments on multiple deepfake benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness and cross-dataset generalization, consistently outperforming detectors based solely on RGB appearance or semantic representations. Furthermore, we show that the proposed representation extends beyond deepfake detection to face presentation attack detection, highlighting its potential as a unified framework for facial attack detection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Spectra：一个面向深度伪造检测的框架，将图像语义特征与隐式神经表示（INR）重建过程中提取的 artifact-aware 特征进行双向融合，以提升对未知生成方法、压缩变化和跨数据集偏移的鲁棒性，并进一步扩展到人脸呈现攻击检测。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器大多依赖 RGB 外观、频域伪影或二者组合，这些特征往往与特定生成器或数据集相关，面对新的合成模型、压缩方式和数据分布变化时泛化能力不足。作者认为，除了观察图像“看起来是什么样”，还可以从 INR 如何重建图像的动态过程中获得补充信息，从而捕捉更本质、更少依赖具体生成流程的真伪差异。
AI.method: 提出 Spectra 框架：首先对每张输入图像拟合图像特定的隐式神经表示（INR），并从其内部激活或多层级重建过程中提取重建热图，作为与伪造痕迹相关的 artifact-aware 线索；同时提取多尺度/多层级的视觉语义表示；然后通过双向融合机制联合建模语义特征与 INR 重建线索，使图像语义信息与重建伪影信息能够相互交互，形成面向伪造检测的互补表示。该表示随后用于深度伪造检测，并进一步用于人脸呈现攻击检测，以验证其通用性。
AI.result: 在多个深度伪造基准上的大量实验表明，Spectra 相比仅依赖 RGB 外观或语义表示的检测器具有更好的鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化性能，并在多个数据集上保持一致性提升。此外，该方法在人脸呈现攻击检测任务上也表现出适用性，说明其学习到的表示不局限于特定伪造检测场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义视觉表示与 INR 重建动态中的伪影线索相结合，Spectra 能够学习更不依赖特定生成管线的伪造证据，从而提升深度伪造检测的泛化能力。该工作表明 INR 重建过程可作为图像真伪检测的有用信息源，并为构建统一的生物特征攻击/伪造检测框架提供了可行路径。

title: Interpreting Physics in Video Encoders using Multi-Object Interaction Videos
summary: Video encoder models are increasingly used as world models for physical AI, where a policy plans by rolling out the latent, so what physics the latent holds bounds what the agent can plan over. Moreover, existing interpretability work probes quantities belonging to a single object; the quantities that make physics relational, such as momentum transfer, restitution, and friction, are defined between bodies and have not been examined. We probe relational physics attributes in two frozen self-supervised video encoders (V-JEPA2 and VideoMAE) under two-body settings and test if they transfer across environments. Our early findings are mixed. Both encoders separate elastic from inelastic collisions reliably. V-JEPA2's own predictor is less likely to predict a collision that creates kinetic energy compared to one that loses it. Momentum-violation detection appears in only one of the two encoders, a kinetic-energy readout survives a change of environment for V-JEPA2 but not for VideoMAE, and neither model holds a friction coefficient that survives a change of geometry.

AI.tldr: 该研究在两个冻结的自监督视频编码器（V-JEPA2 和 VideoMAE）中探测双物体场景下的关系性物理属性，包括碰撞弹性/非弹性、动量守恒、动能变化和摩擦，并检验这些内部表示能否跨环境迁移；结果显示其物理编码能力并不一致且总体有限。
AI.motivation: 视频编码器正被用作物理 AI 的世界模型，策略可能通过在潜在空间中 rollout 来规划，因此潜在表示是否真正编码了物理规律会限制其可规划性。既有可解释性工作多关注单个对象的属性，但决定物理过程的关系量（如动量传递、恢复系数、摩擦）定义在物体之间，尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 作者使用两个冻结的自监督视频编码器 V-JEPA2 和 VideoMAE，在双物体交互设置中探测关系性物理属性；比较弹性与非弹性碰撞，检测动量违反情况，分析碰撞后动能变化，并评估这些表示在不同环境或几何变化下是否仍可迁移。
AI.result: 结果表明证据是混合的：两个编码器都能可靠区分弹性碰撞与非弹性碰撞；V-JEPA2 的预测器更不容易预测出“产生动能”的碰撞，相对于“损失动能”的碰撞更倾向于抑制这种违反；动量违反检测只在两个编码器中的一个出现；V-JEPA2 的动能读出可以跨环境保留，但 VideoMAE 不能；两个模型都没有形成能够抵抗几何变化的摩擦系数表示。
AI.conclusion: 当前自监督视频世界模型可能编码了部分粗粒度碰撞类型，但并不稳定或完整地保留关键的关系性物理量，尤其是摩擦和跨环境守恒量。这说明仅凭视频潜空间未必能支持可靠的物理规划，若要构建更强物理 AI，可能需要显式关系推理、守恒约束或针对物理量设计的目标函数与监督。

title: OpenHome: From Perception to Insight in Smart-Home Camera Videos
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have been increasingly adopted in consumer smart-home camera systems to interpret recorded videos and provide insights. However, video clips captured from smart-home cameras are different from curated web videos dominating existing VLM benchmarks. Smart-home video clips often do not contain subtitles or narration and are captured from different viewing angles, under various lighting conditions, and in diverse scenarios. However, the capabilities of the model in this domain, under sparse visual signals and limited context, are not fully assessed by existing VLM benchmarks. To close this gap, we introduce OpenHome, a visual-only, four-option multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating smart-home video understanding. It contains 2,254 questions on 1,118 real-world video clips and organizes 10 tasks into three capability levels. Perception evaluates visible content, Reasoning evaluates causal, spatial, and temporal relationships, and Insight evaluates subject intent, supporting evidence and appropriate homeowner responses. Based on the dataset, we describe the task design, data pipeline and evaluation protocol, and report results for 32 closed-source and open-weight VLMs. The best model, Gemini 4 Argon, reaches 81.2% overall accuracy. Frontier closed-source models outperform open-weight models on every level. The best closed-source model leads the best open-weight model by 16.3% on Perception, 22.4% on Reasoning and 37.4% on Insight.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 OpenHome，一个面向智能家居摄像头视频理解的视觉-only 四选一多项选择基准，包含 2254 个问题和 1118 个真实视频片段，并从感知、推理和洞察三个能力层级评估 32 个 VLM，结果显示闭源模型整体显著优于开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 基准多基于网络策划视频，常包含字幕、解说或较完整上下文，而智能家居摄像头视频往往没有字幕或解说，并存在视角、光照、场景变化和视觉信号稀疏等差异，导致现有基准不能充分评估 VLM 在真实智能家居视频理解中的能力。
AI.method: 作者构建 OpenHome 基准：使用 1118 个真实智能家居视频片段和 2254 个四选一视觉多项选择问题，将 10 类任务组织为三个能力层级——感知、推理和洞察；同时描述任务设计、数据构建流程和评测协议，并在 32 个闭源与开源权重 VLM 上开展系统评测。
AI.result: 在该基准上，最佳模型 Gemini 4 Argon 的总体准确率为 81.2%。所有能力层级上，前沿闭源模型均优于开源模型；最佳闭源模型相较最佳开源模型在感知、推理和洞察三个层级分别领先 16.3%、22.4% 和 37.4%，其中洞察层面的差距最大。
AI.conclusion: 智能家居视频理解对 VLM 提出了不同于通用网络视频的挑战，尤其是在缺乏字幕、上下文有限和视觉信号稀疏条件下。OpenHome 能更有效暴露模型在感知、因果/时空推理以及意图理解与 homeowners 响应建议方面的能力差距。当前闭源前沿模型仍明显优于开源模型，表明智能家居场景下高可靠视频理解仍存在较大提升空间。

title: MAGIC: Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration for VLM Test-time Robustness Scaling
summary: This paper studies the problem of test-time robustness scaling for large vision-language models (LVLMs), which aims to mitigate language bias during inference. Existing approaches typically adopt test-time scaling techniques such as contrastive decoding to improve inference performance. Despite the progress, the performance of these approaches is far from satisfactory due to intentional evidence removal during perturbations and redundant inference cost. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration (MAGIC). The core of our MAGIC is to evaluate the decision margins of LVLMs to selectively activate textual and visual perturbation branches for efficient debiased inference. In particular, our MAGIC first measures the prediction margins of crucial tokens, and applies a gating function to identify low-confidence responses that are susceptible to language biases. For selected samples, we integrate the token logits from multiple textual and image perturbation branches with the original ones for debiased decision. More importantly, we selectively restore the most informative corrupted views with sharp prediction distributions for ambiguous samples after debiasing, enabling evidence recovery for discriminative decision-making. We further utilize a calibration dataset to actively identify and prune ineffective branches during contrastive debiasing for cost reduction. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed MAGIC in comparison with extensive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MAGIC（Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration），通过基于决策边际的选择性对比去偏与证据恢复，在大视觉语言模型推理阶段缓解语言偏置，同时降低冗余计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法（如对比解码）虽能提升 LVLM 推理鲁棒性，但通常在扰动过程中会主动破坏或移除原始证据，并且对所有样本进行多分支推理造成冗余成本，导致性能受限且效率不足。因此，需要一种既能有效去偏、又能恢复关键视觉-语言证据、并减少不必要计算的推理策略。
AI.method: MAGIC 的核心是根据 LVLM 的决策边际选择性激活文本扰动和图像扰动分支。具体而言，模型先测量关键 token 的预测边际，并用门控函数识别低置信度、易受语言偏置影响的样本。对于被选中的样本，将原始 token logits 与多个文本和图像扰动分支的 logits 融合，实现去偏决策。随后，对于去偏后仍存在模糊性的样本，选择性地恢复最具信息量、预测分布更尖锐的扰动视图，以补充判别证据。此外，使用校准数据集主动识别并剪枝无效的对比去偏分支，从而降低推理成本。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MAGIC 相比多种现有基线方法能够有效提升大视觉语言模型在测试时的鲁棒性和去偏推理性能，同时通过门控选择与分支剪枝减少冗余计算。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC 通过“边际门控 + 多扰动分支融合 + 证据恢复 + 无效分支剪枝”的机制，在语言偏置缓解和推理效率之间取得更好平衡，为 LVLM 测试时鲁棒性扩展提供了一种高效且可解释的推理优化方案。

title: NUViT: Vision Transformers for Fourier Space Data
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated strong performance in many computer vision tasks but do not naturally extend beyond the natural image domain. One important example is Fourier-space data, which is used to represent a rich and diverse set of modalities, including medical imaging and microscopy. Standard ViT tokenization partitions an image into square patches on a Cartesian grid, which poorly fit the frequency and phase structure of Fourier-space data. We introduce Non-Uniform ViT, a simple, general-purpose vision transformer that redesigns image tokenization, data representation, and positional encoding to respect this structure. Experiments on Fourier-domain image classification, 2D crystal lattice identification, MRI annotation, and cryo-EM protein heterogeneity analysis show that NUViT consistently captures the structure of Fourier data better than standard architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Non-Uniform ViT（NUViT），通过重新设计图像 tokenization、数据表示和位置编码，使 Vision Transformer 更适合处理频率域和相位结构显著的 Fourier-space 数据。
AI.motivation: 标准 ViT 通常将图像划分为规则笛卡尔网格上的方形 patch，这种 tokenization 方式对自然图像有效，但不能很好适配 Fourier-space 数据的频率与相位结构，限制了 ViT 在医学成像、显微成像等 Fourier-domain 数据上的应用。
AI.method: 作者引入一种简单且通用的非均匀 Vision Transformer：对 tokenization 方式、输入数据表示以及 positional encoding 进行重新设计，使其能够尊重并建模 Fourier 数据的非笛卡尔、频率—相位结构。
AI.result: 在 Fourier-domain 图像分类、二维晶体点阵识别、MRI 标注和冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）蛋白异质性分析等任务上，NUViT 相比标准架构能够更准确地捕捉 Fourier 数据结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对 Fourier-space 数据特性重新设计 ViT 的输入表示与位置编码机制，可以有效扩展 Vision Transformer 到医学成像和显微成像等非自然图像领域，提升模型对频率与相位结构的建模能力。

title: ACVA-Bench: Beyond Prompt Following in Abstract Concept Visualization Ability for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable progress in image quality and instruction following, prompting growing research interest in their capacity for deep understanding that goes beyond literal prompt matching. However, without an explicit visual scheme provided, it remains unclear and has not been systematically evaluated whether T2I models can autonomously translate abstract concepts lacking a fixed visual referent, such as "loyalty," into visual representations that are accurate, diverse, and distinguishable from closely related concepts. We define this capability as Abstract Concept Visualization Ability (ACVA) and introduce ACVA-Bench, a category-balanced benchmark grounded in psycholinguistic norms of abstract concepts, which examines models' ACVA along three dimensions semantic sufficiency, representational diversity, and conceptual distinctiveness under a low-intervention setting that withholds concrete objects, scenes, or visual metaphors. Since abstract concepts lack a unique reference image, conventional evaluation metrics that rely on reference-image matching are difficult to apply. To address this, we propose a fine-grained visual-semantic evaluation method constrained by concept semantics, which decomposes concept semantics into independently verifiable visual-semantic questions to assess the semantic representation quality of generated images, with its validity further confirmed by human evaluation. Benchmarking results on mainstream T2I models show that these models rely on a small set of prototypical visual patterns, leaving room for improvement in representational diversity and conceptual distinctiveness for abstract concepts, thereby providing an interpretable and reproducible evaluation foundation for future research.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出“抽象概念可视化能力”（ACVA）及其基准ACVA-Bench，用于评估文本到图像模型在没有具体视觉提示时，将“忠诚”等抽象概念转化为准确、多样且可区分图像的能力，并设计了基于概念语义的细粒度视觉-语义评测方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本生成图像模型在图像质量和指令遵循方面进展显著，但其是否具备超越字面匹配的深层理解能力仍缺乏系统评估。尤其当提示涉及没有固定视觉参照的抽象概念时，模型能否自主生成语义充分、表达多样且与相近概念可区分的图像尚不清楚。传统依赖参考图像的评测指标也难以适用于此类缺乏唯一标准答案的任务。
AI.method: 作者将这一能力定义为抽象概念可视化能力（ACVA），并构建类别平衡的基准ACVA-Bench，其依据抽象概念的心理语言学规范，在低干预条件下不提供具体物体、场景或视觉隐喻。评测覆盖语义充分性、表征多样性和概念区分度三个维度。为评估生成图像，作者提出一种受概念语义约束的细粒度视觉-语义评测方法，将概念语义分解为可独立验证的视觉-语义问题进行打分，并通过人工评估验证其有效性。
AI.result: 对主流文本生成图像模型的基准测试显示，模型通常依赖少数典型视觉模式完成抽象概念可视化，在表征多样性和概念区分度方面仍有明显不足。该评测框架具有可解释性和可复现性，为后续研究提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: 当前T2I模型在抽象概念可视化方面尚未达到充分理解与灵活表达的水平，亟需超越原型化视觉模式的生成策略。ACVA-Bench及其语义约束评测方法为评估和改进模型的深层概念理解能力提供了系统化基准。

title: Guided Zero-Shot Anomaly Explanation for Anonymized Crowd Video Monitoring: Context, Categorization, and Spatial Localization
summary: Despite the promising development of deep learning for video anomaly detection (VAD), explainability (XAI) of these models remains a challenge. Explainable and privacy-protecting VAD builds transparency and trust that facilitates adoption of computer vision systems, including safety and security monitoring. However, anomaly explainability in privacy-preserving VAD systems is underexplored. In this study, we present the XAVAD approach, a unified descriptive anomaly XAI for an anonymized VAD, that integrates flexible zero-shot anonymization, anomaly type categorization, visual localization, and scene context description. We provide empirical and qualitative assessments of multifaceted explanations integrated with full-body visual anonymization for privacy protection. We adopt a multimodal CLIP embedding for videos, using improved LLM-assisted prompting and pool-scoring mechanisms for anomaly-type identification. We enhance Grad-ECLIP for spatial anomaly heatmap localization, leveraging computation and accuracy through our novel prompt-guided patching autofocus mechanism. We employ VLMs to generate context and reasoning descriptions of detected anomalies through curated prompt engineering. We have evaluated the accuracy and computational cost of XAVAD on several publicly available CCTV and video datasets. Our experiments demonstrate substantial gains of our XAVAD over state-of-the-art benchmark approaches and provide insights into privacy protection trade-offs in XAI for VAD. We further present ablation studies and assessments across diverse configurations and modeling alternatives to demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed methods. Code: this https URL}{this https URL .
comment: 21 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables, preprint

AI.tldr: 该研究提出 XAVAD，一种面向隐私保护视频异常检测（VAD）的统一可解释异常描述框架，集成零样本人体匿名化、异常类型识别、视觉定位和场景上下文描述，以增强 VAD 系统的透明性与可信度。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在视频异常检测中发展迅速，但其可解释性仍具挑战。尤其在隐私保护型 VAD 系统中，如何既保护被监控人员隐私，又提供可信、透明的异常解释，仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: XAVAD 采用多模态 CLIP 视频嵌入，并通过改进的 LLM 辅助提示与池化评分机制进行异常类型识别；同时增强 Grad-ECLIP 进行空间异常热图定位，提出提示引导的 patch autofocus 机制以提升计算效率与定位准确性；进一步利用视觉语言模型（VLM）和精心设计的提示工程生成异常上下文与推理描述。该方法还与全身视觉匿名化结合，兼顾隐私保护与可解释性。
AI.result: 在多个公开 CCTV 与视频数据集上的实验表明，XAVAD 在异常检测相关任务中的准确率与计算成本方面优于现有基准方法，并通过消融实验验证了各模块设计的有效性。同时，研究进一步分析了隐私保护与可解释性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: XAVAD 为隐私敏感场景下的视频异常检测提供了统一、多模态且可解释的解决方案。其结合匿名化、异常分类、空间定位和语言化解释，有助于提升安防监控等计算机视觉系统的透明度、可信度与实际可部署性。

title: RADIANT: Object-Centric Feed-Forward Global Illumination
summary: Feed-forward neural renderers synthesize global illumination across novel 3D scenes without per-scene optimization or runtime ray tracing. Existing transformer-based renderers tokenize individual triangles, so self-attention scales quadratically with mesh resolution. Yet macroscopic radiative transport is governed by the underlying surface geometry and object arrangements rather than a particular mesh discretization; finer tessellation can thus inflate token counts without changing the underlying transport physics, motivating a discretization-agnostic and object-centric representation. We introduce RADIANT (RADiance-based Inter-Actor Neural Transformer), an object-centric architecture for feed-forward global illumination from point inputs. By representing each object with a compact budget of 32 surface-patch tokens, RADIANT decouples attention sequence length from polygon counts. In a single network, an inter-object scene transformer models 3D radiative exchange and a view decoder renders images at target camera poses. To capture light transport without materializing O(N^2) bias matrices, invariant form-factor attention embeds geometric distances and surface orientations directly into query-key dot products as SE(3)-invariant inner products weighted by learned area and material gains. For primary visibility without mesh connectivity, camera rays cross-attend scene tokens guided by depth-tested point splats in a shared spherical frame. Across a 1.03M-scene benchmark under matched model capacity, RADIANT reaches 25 dB tone-mapped PSNR in 5x fewer training steps than RenderFormer, and achieves 32.2 dB at 600k steps (+3.3 dB over RenderFormer and +7.6 dB over RenderFormer-V2). We further demonstrate the scalability of RADIANT, which completes a 512x512 forward pass of a 500-object scene in 0.83 s, with computational cost scaling with the number of objects rather than polygons.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RADIANT，一种面向对象中心的神经前馈渲染器，通过每个物体仅使用 32 个表面 patch token 并设计 SE(3) 不变形式因子注意力，使全局光照推理成本随物体数量而非多边形数量扩展，在多场景基准上显著优于 RenderFormer 系列。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的前馈渲染器将单个三角形作为 token，导致自注意力复杂度随网格分辨率二次增长。然而宏观光传输主要由物体几何和空间布局决定，并不依赖特定三角化；更细的网格只会增加 token 数量而不改变物理光照传输，因此需要一种与离散化无关、以物体为中心的表示方式来降低计算开销并提升可扩展性。
AI.method: RADIANT 从点云输入中学习前馈全局光照，采用对象中心的场景表示：每个物体使用紧凑预算（32 个表面 patch token）表示，从而将注意力序列长度与多边形数量解耦。整体包含两个核心模块：一个 inter-object scene transformer 建模物体间三维辐射交换；一个 view decoder 在目标相机位姿下渲染图像。为了避免显式构造 O(N^2) 偏置矩阵，提出 invariant form-factor attention，将几何距离、表面朝向等以 SE(3)-invariant inner product 的形式嵌入 query-key 点积，并通过学习面积和材质增益进行加权。对于主可见性且不依赖网格连通性的场景，使用相机射线与场景 token 的 cross-attention，并由共享球面坐标系中经过深度测试的点 splat 引导。
AI.result: 在 103 万场景的基准上，在模型容量匹配条件下，RADIANT 仅需 5 倍更少训练步数即可达到 25 dB tone-mapped PSNR，优于 RenderFormer；在 60 万训练步时达到 32.2 dB tone-mapped PSNR，比 RenderFormer 高 3.3 dB，比 RenderFormer-V2 高 7.6 dB。可扩展性实验中，RADIANT 可在 0.83 秒内完成 500 物体场景的 512×512 前向推理，计算成本随物体数量扩展而非随多边形数量扩展。
AI.conclusion: RADIANT 证明以物体为中心、与网格离散化解耦的场景表示能有效提升前馈全局光照渲染的效率和可扩展性。其核心优势在于用少量 surface-patch token 表示物体，并通过 SE(3) 不变形式因子注意力显式编码辐射传输的几何结构，从而在更少训练成本和更低计算扩展性下取得更好的渲染质量。

title: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
summary: Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.

AI.tldr: ImageRSI提出一种冻结文生图生成器前提下的“验证—修复—经验复用—评判器离线更新”框架，并构建包含961条真实困难请求的ImageReq-Bench，用于提升复杂文生图任务的可靠满足能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂文本到图像请求往往包含多约束、细节要求和现实场景语义，单次生成容易失败。虽然可以对图像进行验证和修复，但某个请求上的成功修复并不保证能迁移到其他请求，因此需要可复用、可验证且能跨任务积累的系统化方法。
AI.method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：第一，在每个任务内部进行五维度的图像验证与修复，以定位并修正生成结果中的问题；第二，构建跨任务共享的经验库，只有经过成对A/B验证的候选经验才会被收录，避免不可靠经验污染后续任务；第三，离线更新评判器，即在累积的图像判定记录上使用监督微调和GRPO优化judge，并在复用前进行评估。此外，作者提出ImageReq-Bench，聚焦真实图像生成请求中的困难案例，并为每条请求配套评估检查清单。
AI.result: 在MindBench上，以Nano Banana Pro作为生成器时，ImageRSI取得52.6%的Checklist Strict Accuracy；在ImageReq-Bench上取得65.66%。论文还比较了不同judge训练配置对系统最终效果的影响。
AI.conclusion: ImageRSI表明，在保持生成器冻结的情况下，通过细粒度验证修复、经验库筛选复用以及评判器离线更新，可以提升复杂文生图请求的系统性解决能力。但整体严格通过率仍不高，说明复杂图像生成可靠性仍具挑战，且经验迁移依赖严格验证机制。

title: Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit
summary: RVL-CDIP is the de facto standard benchmark for document classification, and reported accuracy on it is now 98.8%. In this paper, we audit RVL-CDIP for data quality issues and find that approximately 10.5% of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2% of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set. Identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy, and a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them. Image-only models trained on RVL-CDIP lose 16 to 28 points on documents from other sources, and the choice of OCR engine changes accuracy by 4.1 to 8.3 points. We find that nearly 16,000 RVL-CDIP documents contain sensitive personal data, and produce de-identified versions of these documents. We re-benchmark 25 models, and with all defects remediated, the 13 that we retrain are 0.9 to 2.9 points more accurate than in the original condition; the most accurate of them, LayoutLMv3, is 96.5% accurate. We release the corrected corpus, the annotations and the out-of-distribution data.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了文档图像分类标准数据集 RVL-CDIP，发现其存在标签错误、训练/测试重复、识别码捷径、OCR 偏差、分布外泛化差和隐私泄露等问题，并在修复缺陷后重新评估了多个模型，提出更可靠的修正基准与数据资源。
AI.motivation: RVL-CDIP 是文档图像分类领域的默认基准，报告准确率已达 98.8%，高度饱和。若数据集本身存在标签噪声、样本重复、捷径特征或隐私问题，则模型在该基准上的高准确率可能并不代表真实文档理解能力，因此需要审计其数据质量、评估可靠性和公平性。
AI.method: 作者对 RVL-CDIP 的约 400,000 份文档进行数据质量审计，包括：1）检查并修正错误标签；2）检测训练集与测试集之间的重复或近重复样本；3）分析页面上标识性代码是否形成分类捷径；4）比较不同 OCR 引擎对模型性能的影响；5）识别包含敏感个人信息的文档并制作脱敏版本；6）重新测试 25 个模型，并对其中 13 个模型在修复后的数据条件下重新训练和评估。
AI.result: 审计发现：约 10.5% 的 RVL-CDIP 文档存在错误标签；35.2% 的测试集样本在训练集中存在重复或近重复；仅使用页面上的识别码即可达到 69% 的分类准确率；在去除识别码后，最先进模型准确率下降 11 个百分点；仅在 RVL-CDIP 图像上训练的模型迁移到其他来源文档时准确率下降 16 到 28 个百分点；不同 OCR 引擎会导致 4.1 到 8.3 个百分点的性能差异；近 16,000 份文档包含敏感个人信息，作者提供了脱敏版本。修复数据缺陷后，重训的 13 个模型相比原始条件提升 0.9 到 2.9 个百分点，其中最佳模型 LayoutLMv3 达到 96.5% 的准确率。
AI.conclusion: RVL-CDIP 作为文档分类基准存在显著数据质量问题和捷径学习风险，原始高准确率部分被噪声标签、样本重复和页面识别码等因素夸大。经过标签修正、去重、隐私脱敏和评估规范化后，模型排名与性能更可信，但整体准确率上限有所降低，说明真实文档分类难度更高。该研究强调了基准数据集审计、可复现评测和发布修正资源的重要性。

title: SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.

AI.tldr: SyncPro是一种同步双流框架，分别设置内部证据追踪流和用户响应流，使视频助手能在持续观察视频事件时按需更新证据并并及时、准确地响应用户条件。
AI.motivation: 主动式流式视频理解要求助手持续追踪正在发生的事件，并在用户指定条件满足时及时响应。现有方法分别关注“何时响应”或“通过中间文本推理组织观察”，但如何协调持续推理与及时响应仍缺乏充分研究。固定推理间隔、单一生成路径和响应依赖推理完成等设计，会导致无效更新、延迟更新或响应等待，影响时机和准确性。
AI.method: 提出SyncPro同步双流框架，包含Inner分支和Response分支。Inner分支负责证据追踪与内部更新，Response分支负责生成面向用户的最终响应。两个分支共享因果历史并可独立激活：当相关证据发生变化时触发内部更新，同时响应可以在推理仍在进行时并发产出。模型通过构建189K条双流训练样本，先进行监督微调，再采用轨迹级强化学习优化整体决策过程。
AI.result: 在三个主动式视频理解基准实验中，SyncPro在响应时机和用户请求回答准确性方面均取得提升，说明其能更好地协调持续证据推理与及时用户响应。
AI.conclusion: 将证据追踪与用户响应拆分为共享历史但独立激活的双流生成路径，有助于克服固定节奏推理和单一路径耦合带来的问题，从而提升主动式流式视频理解中的实时响应能力与答案可靠性。

title: Separating Angular Alignment from Radial Ordering in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models are well suited to modeling the hierarchical structure of multimodal data, because hyperbolic volume grows exponentially with radius, enabling low-distortion representations of tree-like taxonomies from general to specific concepts. However, existing pretraining objectives for hyperbolic vision-language models entangle semantic alignment with entailment modeling, forcing radial coordinates to simultaneously encode semantic matching and hierarchical structure, leading to conflicting geometric constraints. In this paper, we introduce AURORA, a hyperbolic vision-language framework that decouples the objectives through angular alignment and a novel Radial-Angular Order Cone (RAOC) for entailment modeling. Angular alignment captures semantic similarity while preserving the radial structure for representing hierarchies. Unlike conventional entailment cones, RAOC determines angular allowance from relative parent-child radial gaps. It is incorporated into hierarchical entailment contrastive training to capture partial-order relations. We further introduce a norm regularization term that prevents undesirable radial degeneration for stable training. We train models on millions of image-text pairs and evaluate them across zero-shot classification, image-text retrieval, hierarchical reasoning, and compositional understanding. Our model consistently outperforms strong Euclidean and hyperbolic vision-language baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of decoupling semantic alignment from hierarchical entailment modeling.
comment: 34 pages, 12 figures

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AURORA，一种用于超图/双曲视觉-语言建模的框架，通过角度对齐与径向-角度序锥（RAOC）将语义对齐和层级蕴含建模解耦，从而提升多模态层级表示、检索与推理性能。
AI.motivation: 双曲空间因其体积随半径指数增长，适合表示由一般到具体的层级结构和树状概念体系。然而，现有多模态双曲模型的预训练目标常常把语义相似性匹配与层级蕴含关系建模混在一起，导致径向坐标既要承载语义对齐，又要承载层级结构，产生相互冲突的几何约束。
AI.method: 作者提出 AURORA 框架，将不同目标分离：一方面使用角度对齐来捕捉图像与文本之间的语义相似性，同时保留径向结构用于表示层级关系；另一方面引入新的 Radial-Angular Order Cone，即 RAOC，用于建模父子概念之间的偏序/蕴含关系。与常规蕴含锥不同，RAOC 根据父子节点之间的相对径向间隔来确定允许的角度范围。此外，训练中加入规范正则化项，以防止不理想的径向退化，提高训练稳定性。模型在百万级图文对上训练。
AI.result: 在零样本分类、图文检索、层级推理和组合理解等任务上，AURORA 一致优于强欧式基线和双曲视觉-语言基线，表明将语义对齐与层级蕴含建模解耦能够有效提升多模态模型表现。
AI.conclusion: AURORA 的核心贡献在于用角度和径向分别承担语义与层级功能：角度对齐负责匹配，RAOC 负责偏序蕴含，并通过正则化稳定训练。实验结果表明，解耦语义对齐与层级关系建模能够缓解双曲视觉-语言模型中的几何约束冲突，是提升多模态层级表示与推理能力的有效路径。

title: Forging Emotions: a deep learning experiment on emotions and art
summary: Affective computing is an interdisciplinary field that studies computational methods that relate to or influence emotion. These methods have been applied to interactive media artworks, but they have focused on affect detection rather than affect generation. For affect generation, computationally creative methods need to be explored that have recently been driven by the use of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), a deep learning method. The experiment presented in this paper, Forging Emotions, explores the use of visual emotion datasets and the working processes of GANs for visual affect generation, that is, for generating images that can convey or trigger specified emotions. This experiment concludes that the methodology used so far by computer science researchers to build image datasets for describing high-level concepts such as emotions is insufficient and proposes utilizing emotional networks of associations according to psychology research. Forging Emotions also concludes that to generate affect visually, merely corresponding to basic psychology findings, such as bright or dark colours, does not seem adequate. Therefore, research efforts should aim to understand the structure of trained GANs and compositional GANs in order to produce genuinely novel compositions that can convey or trigger emotions through the subject matter of generated images.
comment: 10 pages. Published in Artnodes no. 31 (2023), Universitat Oberta de Catalunya, under CC BY 4.0. Extended version of a paper presented at ISEA 2022, Barcelona

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验“Forging Emotions”探讨如何利用视觉情绪数据集与生成对抗网络（GAN）实现视觉情感生成，即生成能够传达或诱发特定情绪的图像；研究认为现有用于描述情绪等高阶概念的图像数据集构建方法不足，并指出仅依赖颜色明暗等基础心理学对应关系不足以实现有效的情感生成，未来应深入理解训练后GAN及组合式GAN的结构，以生成真正新颖且能传达情绪的内容。
AI.motivation: 情感计算是一个跨学科领域，研究影响或与情绪相关的计算方法。现有方法多应用于交互式媒体艺术作品，但主要集中于“情绪识别”，而非“情绪生成”。为了实现计算意义上的创造性情感生成，需要进一步探索由生成对抗网络等深度学习方法驱动的新机制，尤其是如何通过生成图像传达或触发指定情绪。
AI.method: 论文提出了名为“Forging Emotions”的实验，结合视觉情绪数据集与生成对抗网络的工作过程，探索视觉情感生成的方法。研究重点不是单纯识别情绪，而是尝试利用GAN生成能够表达或诱发特定情绪的视觉图像，并评估现有情绪图像数据集构建方式以及基于基础心理学对应关系的视觉生成策略是否充分。
AI.result: 实验得出两个主要结论：第一，计算机科学研究者目前用于构建描述情绪等高阶概念图像数据集的方法并不充分，建议借鉴心理学研究中的情绪联想网络来改进数据集构建。第二，仅通过对应基础心理学发现，例如明亮或暗淡颜色，不足以实现有效的视觉情感生成。
AI.conclusion: 未来的研究不应停留在表面化的颜色或图像对应规则上，而应深入分析训练后的GAN以及组合式GAN的内部结构，探索如何通过生成图像的内容与构图来真正传达或诱发情绪。该方法论旨在推动从情绪识别向创造性情绪生成的转变，并促进更可靠、更具新颖性的计算情感生成系统。

title: Real-Time Localisation of Dorsal Anatomical Regions on Dairy Cows in Commercial Rotary Parlours from RGB-D
summary: Automated monitoring of dairy cows increasingly measures one part of the body, such as the rump for temperature or the back for posture, yet the region itself is usually placed by hand. Existing systems either score the cow as a whole or detect sparse keypoints, often in controlled walkways, and neither yields the named region masks that such measurements need on a crowded commercial rotary platform. We present a perception front end that finds the target cow, ten bony landmarks and four named dorsal regions (withers, back, rump and tail-head) in a single forward pass over a whole RGB-D frame from a commercial rotary parlour. Two encoders, one for colour and one for depth, are fused late and share one decoder with three heads. On an anatomical region dataset that we built on public rotary-parlour RGB-D images (538 annotated frames, cow-disjoint test set), the network reaches PCK@10 0.905 for landmarks and region IoU 0.70 to 0.91, and runs end to end in 26.4 ms per frame on a T4 GPU, against an 11 fps camera. Dense region supervision is what makes the landmarks accurate: removing the region head costs 0.15 PCK@10. Agreement between the two heads flags unreliable frames without labels. On our own rig at the largest dairy farm in Western Australia, the model transfers with ten labelled frames (PCK@10 0.84), and its regions are carried through depth into a radiometric thermal camera, giving one repeatable temperature per region and cow.
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ACRA 2026

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向商用转盘式挤奶厅RGB-D画面的端到端感知前端，可在单次推理中同时定位目标奶牛、检测10个骨性关键点，并分割withers、back、rump和tail-head四个命名背部区域；结合自建解剖区域数据集、深度-颜色多任务网络与热像仪配准，实现了真实拥挤牛群场景下的区域级精准监测和可重复分区温度测量。
AI.motivation: 自动化奶牛监测通常需要针对特定身体部位测量，例如用臀部测温度、用背部判断姿态，但这些解剖区域往往依赖人工放置。现有系统大多只进行整头牛级别评分或稀疏关键点检测，且多在受控走道中部署，无法在拥挤的商用转盘式挤奶厅中稳定输出“具名区域掩码”，因而难以满足区域级传感器配准、姿态分析和热成像测温等精确监测需求。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个基于公开转盘式挤奶厅RGB-D图像的奶牛解剖区域数据集，包含538个标注帧，并采用按奶牛隔离的测试划分。感知模型以颜色和深度双编码器进行后期融合，共享一个解码器和三个任务头，在整幅RGB-D帧上单次前向推理，同时输出目标奶牛、10个骨性关键点和4个命名背部区域掩码。实验进一步分析区域密集监督对关键点精度的贡献，并利用多任务头之间的一致性检测无标签下的不可靠帧。最后将该模型部署到西澳大利亚大型奶牛场的自研测量平台上，仅用10张标注帧完成迁移，并通过深度信息将背部区域映射到热像仪，获得按区域和按奶牛的可重复温度估计。
AI.result: 在自建区域数据集上，该方法达到关键点PCK@10为0.905，四个区域分割IoU为0.70至0.91；在T4 GPU上端到端推理耗时26.4 ms每帧，快于11 fps相机采集速度。消融实验显示，移除区域分割头会使关键点PCK@10下降0.15，说明密集区域监督显著提升了骨性关键点定位精度。多任务头之间的一致性能够标记不可靠帧而无需人工标签。在新牧场现场仅使用10张标注帧迁移后，模型仍达到0.84 PCK@10，并成功将深度区域映射到热像仪，实现分区、分牛的可重复温度测量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将颜色与深度信息联合用于奶牛局部解剖区域的密集监督分割，不仅能为真实商业场景中的关键部位定位提供更稳定的感知前端，还能显著提升稀疏骨性关键点精度，并支持少样本迁移与热成像测温配准。相较于整牛评分或单纯关键点检测，这种方法更适合作为区域级奶牛监测系统的核心视觉组件。

title: Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. InternVL2.5-4B shows qualitatively similar depth-dependent activation geometry despite differences in layer location and magnitude. Our results expose a white-box, representation-level refusal-bypass attack surface in VLM vision encoders and motivate inference-time stabilization of safety-sensitive representations.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop

AI.tldr: 本文研究冻结视觉-语言模型中与安全行为相关的内部表征，提出一种轻量级推理时分析框架，发现早期视觉层对“拒绝/接受”控制具有因果可操控性，而深层表征虽与安全性方向分离度较高，却较难通过干预直接改变行为，从而揭示视觉编码器层面的安全绕过攻击面。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型已大规模部署，但其安全机制为何有效、哪些内部表征真正决定拒绝行为仍缺乏清晰理解。仅依靠端到端输出难以解释安全失败或鲁棒性差异，因此需要从表示层面分析冻结模型内部与安全性相关的几何结构和因果控制关系。
AI.method: 作者在冻结的 VLM 上构建推理时框架，不重新训练、不修改参数，而是在层间进行激活差异分析与安全性方向学习。通过层间激活差异分析识别不同深度上的安全相关表征几何，并通过因果干预测试这些表征是否真正控制安全输出。具体包括沿学习的“安全方向”进行激活引导，以及对比不同深度的激活幅度缩放和干预响应。实验对象包括 Qwen3-VL-4B 和 InternVL2.5-4B。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 中，安全相关表征的几何结构在不同层深上并不均匀。早期视觉层表现出较强的双向拒绝控制能力：沿安全方向进行激活引导可使不安全请求的拒绝率覆盖约 6% 到 96%。较后层则对激活幅度缩放更敏感，并存在安全性与选择性之间的明显权衡。更深层表征沿安全方向仍然分离良好，但对激活引导大多不敏感，说明“表征可分离性”并不等同于“行为因果可控性”。InternVL2.5-4B 也呈现出相似的深度相关激活几何，只是在具体层位和强度上有所差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了 VLM 视觉编码器内部存在白盒、表示层面的拒绝绕过攻击面：攻击者或异常输入可能通过改变或劫持特定深度的安全敏感表征来影响模型是否拒绝。与此同时，单纯发现安全相关表征并不能保证模型安全，因为可分性不等于因果可控性。未来 VLM 安全优化应关注推理时稳定关键安全敏感表征，而不仅依赖训练阶段的对齐或外部护栏。

title: DS-BiCA-Net: Pair-Preserving Cross-Temporal Modeling for Remote Sensing Change Captioning
summary: Remote sensing image change captioning (RSICC) describes in natural language the semantic changes between two images of the same scene captured at different times. Previous methods commonly merge the pair during repeated processing or combine intra-image and cross-image relations in one operation, weakening source identity and leaving the two temporal directions implicit. Without separate modules for intra-image and cross-temporal processing and a separate path for each direction, the contribution of each part cannot be measured on its own, so it remains unclear which part matters most, and the design of later models has no such evidence to build on. To address these issues, we propose DS-BiCA-Net, which assigns the two kinds of processing to separate modules and keeps the two images as separate streams throughout the encoder. A windowed state-space module models context within each image, and a bidirectional cross-attention module compares the two images along two directed paths that share their projections. The two modules use the same pre-normalisation residual architecture and differ only in their mixers, and the two streams are fused only in the aggregation head, so each module and each direction can be removed and its contribution measured on its own. Controlled experiments on LEVIR-CC and Dubai-CC examine operator interaction, temporal direction and module order, showing that intra-image refinement carries no benefit alone and becomes beneficial only when followed by bidirectional cross-attention, an order that outperforms the reverse at matched parameter count and FLOPs. The bidirectional module also outperforms either temporal direction alone. Our method reaches an S_m^* of 82.65 on LEVIR-CC, the highest among the published results compared, and 66.72 on Dubai-CC without geometric augmentation, the second-highest among the published results compared.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DS-BiCA-Net，用于遥感图像变化描述（RSICC）。核心思想是在编码器中始终保持前后两期图像为独立流，并用分离的“图像内建模”模块和“双向跨图像比较”模块替代以往混合式关系建模，从而能够单独分析各模块与两个时间方向的贡献。
AI.motivation: 以往 RSICC 方法常将两幅图像合并处理，或将图像内关系与跨图像关系混合在一个操作中，导致源图像身份被削弱、前后时间方向变得隐式。由于缺少独立模块和独立方向路径，研究者难以单独衡量图像内处理、跨时间处理及方向设计的作用，进而影响后续模型设计。
AI.method: DS-BiCA-Net 采用双流结构：1）每个图像使用窗口化状态空间模块建模图像内上下文；2）使用双向交叉注意力模块，通过两条有向路径比较两期图像，且两条路径共享投影；3）两模块采用相同的预归一化残差架构，差异仅在 mixer；4）双流仅在聚合头阶段融合，使每个模块和每个方向都可独立移除或测量。
AI.result: 在 LEVIR-CC 和 Dubai-CC 上的受控实验表明：单独的图像内细化没有收益，只有当它后面接双向交叉注意力时才开始有益；该顺序在参数量和 FLOPs 匹配条件下优于反向顺序。双向交叉注意力模块优于任一单向时间方向。最终模型在 LEVIR-CC 上达到 S_m^* = 82.65，为对比已发表结果中最高；在 Dubai-CC 上达到 66.72，且未使用几何增强，为对比已发表结果中第二高。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，在 RSICC 中显式保持两期图像的身份和时间方向，并分离图像内建模与跨图像比较，是更有效的架构设计。实验揭示了模块顺序和双向跨时间注意力的重要性，为后续遥感变化描述模型提供了可解释、可量化的设计依据。

title: Neural Disjunctive Normal Forms for Learning Exact Rank Filters
summary: Gradient-based learning of morphological operators is hindered by locally sparse derivatives with respect to the structuring elements. We develop a method for learning rank filters that retains exact operator evaluation while distributing the derivatives across the window. Using threshold decomposition, we construct a neural disjunctive normal form representation and establish a sufficient condition for exactness with integer-valued images and structuring elements. We then derive a smooth surrogate from the unique root of a smooth threshold equation. Implicit differentiation gives closed-form derivatives with normalised local weights, whose distribution is controlled by a smoothing parameter. These derivatives are used in a straight-through procedure: the forward pass evaluates the exact rank filter, while the backward pass uses the surrogate. For fixed ranks, the procedure learns real-valued structuring elements of any rank filter, including the median, and extends to compositions, infima, and suprema of rank filters. Experiments on image denoising using MNIST and Fashion-MNIST and retinal vessel segmentation show that, starting from a generic random initialisation, the proposed approach consistently improves performance over training with exact subgradients in every setting. In image denoising, our best network also outperforms smooth morphological networks in all settings. On vessel segmentation, the learned erosions recover structuring elements that fit the vessels, as theoretically expected, whereas most of those trained with exact subgradients remain close to their initialisation.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可微分学习形态学秩滤波器的方法，前向保留精确算子评估，反向通过平滑代理分布导数，显著提升图像去噪和视网膜血管分割性能。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的形态学算子学习面临关键障碍：算子对结构元素的导数在局部是稀疏的，导致梯度传播不足、参数难以更新。因此需要一种既保留精确形态学算子行为、又能在窗口内充分分布梯度的学习方法。
AI.method: 作者针对秩滤波器提出可微学习方法。首先利用阈值分解构造神经析取范式表示，并给出整数图像和整数结构元素下精确性条件。随后从平滑阈值方程的唯一根推导平滑代理算子，通过隐函数求分得到闭式导数，这些导数具有归一化局部权重，其分布由平滑参数控制。进一步采用直通估计：前向传播评估精确秩滤波器，反向传播使用平滑代理。该方法在固定秩下可学习任意秩滤波器（包括中值滤波器）的实值结构元素，并可扩展到秩滤波器的复合、下确界和上确界。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST 图像去噪以及视网膜血管分割实验中，从通用随机初始化开始，该方法在所有设置中均稳定优于使用精确次梯度的训练方式。图像去噪中，最佳网络还在所有设置中超过平滑形态学网络。血管分割中，学习得到的腐蚀算子能恢复符合血管形态的结构元素，符合理论预期；而精确次梯度训练得到的多数结构元素仍接近初始值。
AI.conclusion: 该方法解决了形态学算子梯度局部稀疏的问题，在保持精确秩滤波器前向评估的同时，通过平滑代理实现有效反向传播。其学习实值结构元素的能力更强，并适用于复合与格运算扩展，在去噪和医学图像分割任务中显示出优于精确次梯度和平滑形态学网络的实际效果。

title: Benchmarking Data-Free Continual Model Merging for Whole-Slide Image Survival Analysis
summary: Continual survival analysis on whole-slide images (WSIs) requires models to integrate knowledge from sequentially arriving cancer cohorts while preserving previously learned information. Model merging offers a data-free alternative by combining independently fine-tuned task experts without retaining previous training data. However, the relative behavior of different merging strategies for WSI-based survival prediction remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we establish an end-to-end benchmark for data-free continual model merging, covering task-specific fine-tuning, sequential merging, and inference under both TASK-IL and CLASS-IL settings. We systematically evaluate six representative merging strategies across four TCGA cancer cohorts and three task orders using C-index, IPCW C-index, Forgetting, and Backward Transfer under a controlled protocol. Results show that no merging strategy consistently dominates across all evaluation criteria, while censoring-aware evaluation can substantially alter the relative ranking of the compared methods. This benchmark provides a unified foundation for developing and evaluating more effective continual model merging methods for WSI-based survival analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个面向全切片图像（WSI）生存分析的无数据持续模型融合基准，系统比较六种融合策略在TASK-IL与CLASS-IL设置下的表现，发现不同评价标准下最优方法不一致，且删失感知评估会显著改变方法排序。
AI.motivation: 在WSI生存分析中，模型需要在不断到来的癌症队列中持续学习，同时保留已学知识；但保留历史数据常不可行或受限，因此数据自由的模型融合具有潜力，然而不同融合策略在该任务中的相对表现仍缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建端到端无数据持续模型融合评测框架，覆盖任务特定微调、按序融合和推理阶段，并在TASK-IL与CLASS-IL两种设置下评估。以四个TCGA癌症队列和三种任务顺序为实验设置，采用C-index、IPCW C-index、遗忘率和后向迁移作为评价指标，系统比较六种代表性模型融合策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，没有哪种融合策略在所有评价指标上始终占优；同时，考虑删失数据的评估指标会明显改变不同方法之间的相对排名，说明评价方式对结论具有重要影响。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为面向WSI生存分析的持续模型融合研究提供了统一、可控的评测基础，并提示未来方法需要在数据受限条件下综合考虑任务保持、灾难性遗忘和删失感知评估进行设计。

title: Angular Supervision for Visual Object Grounding in Autoregressive Vision-Language Models
summary: Autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to ground generated text in the correct image regions, and existing explainability methods, such as attention maps and Logit Lens, often produce poor spatial explanations due to weak text-to-vision attention and sink tokens. We propose \textbf{Angular Relevance} ($R_L$), a simple visualization measure based on cosine similarity between visual token embeddings and unembedding-matrix rows. Because $R_L$ is invariant to token norm, it produces substantially sharper and more faithful heatmaps than attention maps or Logit Lens on out-of-the-box models. Without any training, $R_L$ yields competitive referring-expression segmentation (RES), outperforming prior diagnostic maps and CLIP-based training-free methods. To preserve localized object information during cross-modal mixing, we introduce \textbf{Angular Object-Aware Loss (AOL)}, an auxiliary loss that directly supervises visual token embeddings to align angularly with the vocabulary directions of their corresponding object concepts. Finetuning with AOL alongside the standard next-token prediction objective significantly sharpens object localization in heatmaps, showing that the VLM's own visual tokens can be used directly for grounding and improving RES, without training any segmentation heads and without degrading general VQA performance. We further demonstrate that the learned grounding also transfers to category-level segmentation of object categories not seen during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“角度相关性”（Angular Relevance, R_L）用于生成自回归视觉语言模型（VLM）更清晰的文本到图像区域解释热力图，并进一步提出“角度对象感知损失”（Angular Object-Aware Loss, AOL）通过直接约束视觉 token 与词表方向的对齐来提升视觉定位与指代表达分割（RES）性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归 VLM 难以将生成文本可靠地定位到正确图像区域；常用可解释性方法如注意力图或 Logit Lens 往往因文本到视觉注意力较弱以及 sink token 等问题产生空间解释不清、不忠实，难以有效支持视觉定位和分割任务。
AI.method: 首先提出无需训练的可视化度量 R_L，通过计算视觉 token 嵌入与模型反嵌入矩阵各行之间的 cosine similarity 来衡量其对特定词/概念的贡献，并利用其相对于 token 范数不变性的特点生成更锐利、更忠实的热力图。随后提出 AOL 辅助损失，在标准下一词预测目标之外，直接监督视觉 token 嵌入使其与对应 object concept 在词表中的角度方向对齐，从而在跨模态混合过程中保留定位化的物体信息。该方法不额外训练分割头，也不依赖复杂后处理。
AI.result: R_L 在开箱即用的 VLM 上即可生成比注意力图和 Logit Lens 更清晰、更忠实的热力图，并在无需训练的情况下取得有竞争力的 RES 表现，优于以往诊断式解释图和 CLIP-based 无训练方法。引入 AOL 后，微调能够显著增强热力图中的物体定位效果，提升 RES 性能，同时不明显损害一般 VQA 能力；并且所学习到的定位能力还能迁移到训练阶段未见过的类别级分割任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明：自回归 VLM 的视觉 token 本身即可作为有效的定位与解释信号；通过角度对齐而非额外分割监督，可以在不牺牲通用 VQA 性能的前提下显著提升空间 grounding 和 RES 能力，为可解释的视觉语言对齐与训练自由分割提供了一种简洁有效的新思路。

title: ACWM-RM: A Reference-Free Reward Model from Complementary Mismatch Preferences
summary: Reinforcement learning has gained attention for improving action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), as it enables reward-driven optimization of visual quality (VQ) and action-following fidelity (AF) beyond flow-matching optimization. Realizing this potential requires reward signals that reliably rank videos by both VQ and AF. However, existing rewards capture only one dimension: metric-based rewards assess VQ but require ground-truth videos and do not directly assess AF, while inverse dynamics model (IDM) rewards assess AF without references but do not guarantee VQ. Moreover, IDMs, typically trained on real videos, may provide unreliable rewards for generated videos containing visual artifacts and physical inconsistencies. In this work, we introduce the Action and Video Mismatch Benchmark (AVM-Eval), comprising 67.2k pairs that evaluate how reliably IDMs assess AF on real and generated videos. We then propose ACWM-RM, a reward model that jointly assesses VQ and AF without ground-truth videos during reward computation. To train it, we first construct the Action and Video Mismatch Preference Dataset (AVM-Pref) with 506.3k pairs providing complementary supervision: action-mismatch pairs supervise AF, while video-mismatch pairs supervise VQ and expose the model to generated videos. We then pretrain an action-conditioned predictor on real videos to learn forward dynamics before jointly training it with a patch-weighted score head on AVM-Pref to transfer these dynamics to AF assessment on generated videos. Evaluation on AVM-Eval reveals the limited reliability of IDMs on generated videos, while downstream RL experiments show that ACWM-RM outperforms reward baselines in both criteria.

AI.tldr: 论文针对动作条件世界模型（ACWM）的强化学习优化，指出当前奖励模型难以同时可靠评估视觉质量（VQ）与动作跟随保真度（AF），并提出基准AVM-Eval、偏好数据集AVM-Pref及联合奖励模型ACWM-RM，以提升无参考视频条件下的VQ与AF联合评估。
AI.motivation: 强化学习可超越flow-matching优化，提升动作条件世界模型的视觉质量和动作跟随保真度。但现有奖励信号存在维度单一问题：基于指标的奖励能评估VQ但依赖真实视频且不能直接评估AF；逆动力学模型（IDM）可无参考评估AF但不能保证VQ。此外，IDM通常在真实视频上训练，对含视觉伪影或物理不一致的生成视频可能给出不可靠奖励。因此需要能在无真实视频参考下同时可靠评估VQ与AF的奖励模型。
AI.method: 首先构建动作与视频不匹配基准AVM-Eval，包含67.2k个视频-动作配对样本，用于评估IDM在真实视频和生成视频上对AF判断的可靠性。随后提出ACWM-RM作为联合评估VQ和AF的奖励模型。为训练该模型，作者构建AVM-Pref偏好数据集，包含506.3k个偏好配对：动作不匹配配对用于监督AF能力，视频不匹配配对用于监督VQ能力，并让模型接触生成视频。训练流程先利用真实视频预训练动作条件预测器以学习前向动力学，再将其与patch加权分数头在AVM-Pref上联合训练，从而把学到的动力学知识迁移到生成视频的AF评估中。
AI.result: 在AVM-Eval上的评估表明，现有IDM在生成视频上的AF评估可靠性有限。下游强化学习实验显示，ACWM-RM相较多种奖励基线能够在视觉质量和动作跟随保真度两项指标上带来更优的ACWM优化效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了现有IDM奖励模型在处理生成视频时用于动作跟随评估的不足，并通过面向动作-视频不匹配的基准、偏好数据和联合训练策略，提出ACWM-RM实现了无需真实视频参考的VQ与AF联合奖励建模，为强化学习改进动作条件世界模型提供了更可靠的奖励信号。

title: Towards Effective and Transferable Physical Camouflage against Multi-View BEV-based 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern autonomous driving systems widely adopt multi-view Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) based 3D perception models due to their superior performance. Despite their success, the robustness of these models against adversarial camouflage attacks remains largely unexplored. Existing camouflage attacks primarily target single-view 2D detectors, limiting their effectiveness in multi-view 3D perception settings. To address this gap, we propose BEVCA, a novel adversarial camouflage generation framework tailored for multi-view BEV-based 3D perception. Our framework integrates a BEV-feature-based adversarial loss with a multi-view neural rendering module, enabling effective and transferable camouflage attacks across different models and tasks. Extensive experiments in both digital and physical settings demonstrate that BEVCA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and exhibits strong robustness under real-world conditions. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 BEVCA，一种面向多视角 BEV 3D 感知的对抗伪装生成框架，通过 BEV 特征级对抗损失与多视角神经渲染实现更强、可迁移的伪装攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗伪装攻击主要针对单视角二维检测器，难以威胁自动驾驶中广泛使用的多视角 BEV 三维感知模型；同时，这类模型在物理/数字对抗伪装下的鲁棒性问题尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 该方法以多视角 BEV 三维感知任务为攻击对象，设计基于 BEV 特征的对抗损失，使扰动在鸟瞰特征空间中直接误导三维感知；并引入多视角神经渲染模块，联合建模不同相机视角下的外观一致性，从而提升伪装在数字仿真和真实物理场景中的攻击有效性与跨模型、跨任务迁移性。
AI.result: 在数字和物理环境中的实验表明，BEVCA 相比当前最先进的基线方法具有更强的攻击性能，并在现实条件下展现出较好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了多视角 BEV 三维感知模型易受对抗伪装攻击的安全风险，并提出了一种有效且可迁移的伪装攻击框架，可作为自动驾驶感知系统鲁棒性评估与防御研究的重要参考。

title: TileShare: Training-Free Acceleration of Overlapping Tiled ViT Decoding
summary: Fixed-window Vision Transformer (ViT) decoders run at deployment resolution as overlapping tiles: every token in an overlap band is processed by several full decoder instances. In the 2.4B-parameter MiniMax-H3 video decoder, about half of all per-token computation is duplicated. Removing the tiles fails because attention, global tokens and coordinates are bound to them. TileShare keeps each released tile's attention and computes every other operation once per token. The released computation changes at one kind of step only: an overlap token's per-tile results are blended into one shared state with the released weights. Interventions show that this blend costs quality where attention reads the shared states, mainly in the first few layers, which TileShare therefore keeps per tile. Without training, keeping six layers per tile decodes 1.38-1.51x faster than batched and compiled tiling on two GPU types (up to 1.96x with FP8) and is equivalent to the released decoder in PSNR, LPIPS and DISTS on DAVIS videos. On unseen UVG videos with the setting frozen beforehand, it matches PSNR and DISTS and improves LPIPS. TileShare carries over to two further decoders and is again confirmed on unseen data. It is equivalent in PSNR and DISTS on MAGI-1. On the ViTok-v2 image autoencoder at 2K-4K, it matches overlapping tiling in PSNR, improves LPIPS and DISTS and decodes 1.5-1.8x faster. How many layers stay per tile is measured once per model (for decoders, without labels); we report it for 14 decoders and encoders. Optionally, two GPU-hours of self-distillation let MiniMax-H3 share every layer without a loss in PSNR, and a coordinate field trained while the network stays frozen brings fully shared CLIP-based open-vocabulary segmentation to parity with sliding windows on seven benchmarks.
comment: 8 pages main paper + supplementary material

AI.tldr: TileShare 通过重叠带内 token 去重计算与选择性保留逐 tile 注意力，在基本免训练条件下显著加速固定窗口 ViT 解码器，并接近或匹配原重叠分块方案的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 固定窗口 ViT 解码器在部署时依赖重叠 tile 消除边界伪影，但重叠区域中的 token 会被多个完整 decoder 实例重复处理。在 2.4B 参数的 MiniMax-H3 视频解码器中，约一半逐 token 计算属于重复；直接取消 tile 又不可行，因为注意力、全局 token 和坐标特征都与 tile 绑定。
AI.method: TileShare 保留每个 tile 的注意力计算，将其他操作改为每 token 仅计算一次；仅改变一种“发布式”计算：把重叠 token 的逐 tile 结果用发布权重混合为共享状态。实验发现共享状态主要在注意力读取处、尤其前几层造成质量下降，因此将少量前层保持为逐 tile 计算。层数保留为每模型一次性测量，无需训练；进一步可用约 2 GPU 小时自蒸馏实现全部层共享，并用冻结网络下训练的坐标场支持开放词汇分割等任务。
AI.result: 在 MiniMax-H3 上，保持 6 层逐 tile 时，无需训练即比批量与编译 tiling 解码快 1.38–1.51 倍，FP8 下最高 1.96 倍；在 DAVIS 视频上与发布 decoder 的 PSNR、LPIPS、DISTS 等价。在未见过的 UVG 上 PSNR 与 DISTS 相当，LPIPS 更好。方法可迁移至另外两个 decoder：MAGI-1 上 PSNR/DISTS 等价；在 ViTok-v2 2K–4K 图像 autoencoder 上匹配 PSNR、改善 LPIPS/DISTS，并加速 1.5–1.8 倍。论文还报告了 14 个 encoder/decoder 所需保留层数。可选自蒸馏使 MiniMax-H3 全层共享且不损失 PSNR，冻结主干并训练坐标场后，完全共享的 CLIP 开放词汇分割在 7 个基准上与滑动窗口相当。
AI.conclusion: TileShare 识别出固定窗口 ViT 解码器中重叠 tile 的计算冗余主要来自可去重的 token 级操作，而注意力与早期共享状态交互是质量瓶颈；通过保留少量关键层为逐 tile 计算，可在训练无关或轻量微调下实现显著加速，并保持高质量视频/图像重建与分割精度。

title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
summary: Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality. Meanwhile, specialized 3D object generators provide detailed object geometry, while 3D foundation models offer strong and generalizable spatial understanding. We propose Easy-3Dfy, a compositional workflow that decouples object generation from scene layout estimation, allowing specialized models to fully exploit their respective strengths. An RPF-based aligner then bridges these capabilities by establishing geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, recovering object layout for scene composition. Without requiring complete scene-level supervision, the proposed workflow consistently outperforms SAM-3Dfy across multiple geometric metrics on Scene-Maker and 3D-FUTURE200. Our results demonstrate that explicit geometric composition can effectively combine high-quality object generation with strong spatial understanding, while enabling the workflow to benefit independently from advances in both 3D object generation and foundation models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Easy-3Dfy，一种将“物体生成”和“场景布局估计”解耦的组合式单图 3D 场景重建流程，通过几何对齐将高质量物体网格放置到场景中，从而提升细粒度几何与资产质量。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端方法如 SAM-3Dfy 能从单张图像重建 3D 资产及其场景布局，但在精细几何和资产质量方面仍有不足。与此同时，专门的 3D 物体生成模型擅长生成细节丰富的物体，3D 基础模型则具备较强的空间理解能力，如何将这些优势结合用于场景级重建是关键问题。
AI.method: 提出 Easy-3Dfy，将物体生成与场景布局估计解耦，组成可分模块的 workflow。使用 RPF 对齐器在物体局部网格和部分场景点云图之间建立几何对应关系，恢复物体在场景中的布局并完成场景组合。该方法不依赖完整的场景级监督信号。
AI.result: 在 Scene-Maker 和 3D-FUTURE200 数据集上，Easy-3Dfy 在多项几何指标上一致优于 SAM-3Dfy，说明显式几何组合能够有效结合高质量物体生成与强空间理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将专门的 3D 物体生成模型与 3D 基础模型在几何层面进行显式组合，Easy-3Dfy 能够同时受益于两类模型的独立进展，为单图 3D 场景构建提供了一种更细粒度、可组合且更强可扩展性的方案。

title: Representation Learning via Composite Subspace Flow Matching
summary: Distilling semantic meaning from raw image data remains a challenge in machine learning. Current self-supervised paradigms face a trade-off: joint-embedding architectures produce relevant features by aggressively discarding intra-class variance, irreversibly spatial and reconstruction. Conversely, generative models preserve spatial details but struggle to isolate semantics, as their optimization is dominated by pixel variations. To bridge this divide, we propose composite subspace flow matching (CSFM). Rather than corrupting data with unstructured isotropic noise, CSFM formulates representation learning as the variance-minimizing inversion of a deterministic degradation curriculum across spectral, color, and illumination subspaces. By bounding trajectory variance with hard temporal style truncation, a capacity-constrained encoder is driven to ignore transient style artifacts and encode persistent content. Empirical evaluations across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10 show that CSFM yields competitive discriminative transferability while preserving generative synthesis across both convolutional and vision transformer architectures. By avoiding the collapse pathologies of non-generative methods, CSFM forms a smooth latent space that outperforms standard optimal transport flows on linear probing and few-shot classification, while enabling coherent synthesis and trajectory interpolation. These results confirm that steering the physical dynamics of generative flows offers a scalable paradigm for learning representations that are simultaneously linearly separable and generatively invertible.
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures

AI.tldr: 论文提出复合子空间流匹配（CSFM），通过在光谱、颜色和光照子空间上进行受控退化与反演，使自监督模型既保留生成所需的细节，又能提取稳定的语义表征，兼顾判别迁移与生成合成。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督学习存在两难：联合嵌入架构容易通过压缩类内方差获得相关特征，但可能丢失空间与可重建信息；生成模型能保留空间细节，却因像素级变化主导优化而难以提取纯语义。因此需要一种统一框架，使表征同时具备线性可分性与生成可逆性。
AI.method: CSFM 不使用无结构的各向同性噪声破坏图像，而是将表征学习建模为跨光谱、颜色、光照子空间的确定性退化课程的方差最小化反演过程。通过硬性时间风格截断限制流轨迹方差，容量受限编码器被迫使忽略瞬态风格伪影，转而编码持久的内容语义。该方法适用于卷积网络和视觉 Transformer。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 STL-10 上，CSFM 在获得有竞争力的判别迁移性能的同时保留生成合成能力。相比标准最优传输流，它形成更平滑的潜空间，在线性探测和少样本分类上表现更优，并支持连贯生成与潜空间轨迹插值。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动引导生成流的“物理动力学”，而非被动添加随机噪声，CSFM 为自监督表征学习提供了可扩展范式，能够同时学习线性可分且生成可逆的图像表征，缓解联合嵌入方法的表征坍缩问题。

title: Beyond Pattern Matching in 3D MLLMs: Part-Level Functional Reasoning for Generalizable Recognition
summary: 3D MLLMs recognize objects via pattern matching, which fails when geometrically similar objects require functional reasoning to disambiguate (e.g., dresser vs. wardrobe). Our per-sample Geometric Confusion Score (GCS) exposes this failure: baseline accuracy is 33.7% on ModelNet40's most ambiguous 20% versus 84.0% on its least ambiguous 20%. We identify a function-as-annotation pattern, in which functional language decorates a known identity instead of supporting inference, and hypothesize that reversing this information flow should concentrate improvements on the most ambiguous samples. PFIR (Part-level Functional Inference for Recognition) reverses that flow. Built on PartNeXt part segmentation, its data pipeline produces 507K QA pairs with functional CoTs (geometry $\to$ function $\to$ identity), and its progressive curriculum culminates in dual-objective GRPO: strict functional reasoning and descriptive grounding for Objaverse's diverse distribution. The two RL objectives yield nearly orthogonal task vectors ($\cos = 0.056$), enabling composition via Task Arithmetic. Under a strict dual OOD protocol (Objaverse $\to$ ModelNet40; XYZRGB $\to$ XYZ-only), PFIR raises zero-shot accuracy from 60.5% to 66.7%, with gains concentrated $2.6\times$ more on geometrically ambiguous samples---supporting part-level functional reasoning as an effective route to more generalizable 3D recognition. Code: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PFIR（部件级功能推理识别），通过让 3D 多模态大模型从几何结构推断功能、再由功能推断类别，缓解几何相似物体仅靠模式匹配难以区分的问题，并在严格跨域设置下提升识别准确率，尤其改善高混淆样本。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D MLLM 主要依赖模式匹配识别物体，当物体外形相似但功能不同（如 dresser 与 wardrobe）时容易混淆。作者发现样本越具几何歧义性，基线性能下降越明显，因此希望引入部件级功能推理，使识别依据从表面形状匹配转向功能语义推断。
AI.method: 作者提出 Geometric Confusion Score（GCS）量化样本的几何混淆程度，并发现“功能作为注释”的问题：功能语言常只是描述已知类别，而不真正支撑推理。PFIR 基于 PartNeXt 部件分割构建数据管线，生成 507K 个包含“几何→功能→身份”链式推理的 QA 对；采用渐进课程学习，最终使用双目标 GRPO：一方面训练严格功能推理，另一方面训练对 Objaverse 多样分布的描述性 grounding。两个 RL 目标得到的任务向量近乎正交，通过 Task Arithmetic 进行组合。
AI.result: 在严格双 OOD 协议（Objaverse→ModelNet40；XYZRGB→XYZ-only）下，PFIR 将零样本准确率从 60.5% 提升至 66.7%，且增益主要集中在线何上更易混淆的样本，提升效果为其他样本的约 2.6 倍，验证了部件级功能推理对 3D 识别泛化性的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 部件级功能推理能够纠正 3D MLLM 中“功能只是类别注释”的信息流缺陷，通过几何到功能再到类别的推理路径，提高对几何相似但功能不同物体的识别能力和跨域泛化性。

title: LapaFM: A Laparoscopic Foundation Model via Multi-Stage Continual Learning
summary: Artificial intelligence-based analysis of intraoperative laparoscopic videos has the potential to improve surgical decision-making and precision. However, effective surgical assistance requires models that can generalize across diverse intraoperative tasks. Here we present LapaFM, a foundation model for laparoscopic surgery trained on more than 20,000 minutes of surgical videos using a multi-stage continual learning strategy that mitigates catastrophic forgetting and inter-task interference. LapaFM learns multimodal visual representations and supports multiple tasks, including smoke removal, surgical phase recognition, instrument and polyp segmentation, and lesion identification. The model was evaluated on 13 retrospective and two prospective cohorts collected from different imaging devices. LapaFM consistently outperformed task-specific models and existing foundation models across datasets, and also generalized to gastrointestinal endoscopy tasks, including polyp detection and classification. Notably, it recovered over 90% of smoke-obscured frames and achieved clinician-level or superior performance in lymph node metastasis prediction and prospective polyp classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LapaFM，一个面向腹腔镜手术视频的基础模型，通过超过 20,000 分钟手术视频和多阶段持续学习训练，支持去烟雾、手术阶段识别、器械/息肉分割、病灶识别等多种任务，并在多中心回顾性和前瞻性数据上表现优于任务专用模型及现有基础模型。
AI.motivation: 腹腔镜手术视频分析有望提升术中决策和手术精度，但不同手术任务之间差异大，通用模型容易出现灾难性遗忘和跨任务干扰，因此需要能够泛化到多种术中视觉任务的手术基础模型。
AI.method: 作者构建 LapaFM，利用超过 20,000 分钟的腹腔镜手术视频进行训练，采用多阶段持续学习策略以缓解灾难性遗忘和任务间干扰。该模型学习多模态视觉表示，并支持烟雾去除、手术阶段识别、器械和息肉分割、病灶识别等任务。模型在来自不同成像设备的 13 个回顾性队列和 2 个前瞻性队列中进行评估。
AI.result: LapaFM 在多个数据集上持续优于任务专用模型和现有基础模型，并可泛化到胃肠内镜任务，如息肉检测和分类。模型可恢复超过 90% 的烟雾遮挡帧，并在淋巴结转移预测和前瞻性息肉分类中达到临床医生水平或更优表现。
AI.conclusion: LapaFM 表明，基于大规模手术视频和多阶段持续学习训练的手术基础模型能够兼顾多任务性能与跨设备、跨术式泛化能力，为术中智能辅助和内镜 AI 应用提供了可扩展的技术路线。

title: Hyperparameter-Free Boundary-Interior t-vMF Dice Loss for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Class imbalance and errors near anatomical boundaries remain challenges in medical image segmentation, motivating loss functions that account for these difficulties. Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss adjusts the similarity function during training but requires hyperparameter tuning. We propose Self-Tuned Boundary-Aware t-vMF Dice Loss (STB-tvMF Dice), which adapts the function separately for boundary and interior regions without tuning shape-adaptation parameters. Each region's shape parameter of t-vMF function is determined from its mean prediction-target cosine similarity in the preceding epoch and remains fixed throughout the current epoch. This rule maximizes the slope of the similarity function at the observed mean similarity, providing a principled basis for adaptation without validation-based parameter selection. Experiments on three datasets and architectures demonstrated its effectiveness. On Synapse with U-Net, STB-tvMF Dice achieved a mean DSC of 70.75%, compared with 63.03% for Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss. Our code will be available soon.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Self-Tuned Boundary-Aware t-vMF Dice Loss（STB-tvMF Dice），通过按区域自适应t-vMF相似函数的形状参数，无需额外超参数调优，即可缓解医学图像分割中的类别不平衡和边界区域误差问题，并在实验显示出显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割常面临类别不平衡和解剖边界附近预测误差较大的挑战。已有Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss能自适应调整相似函数，但需要设置和调优形状相关超参数，增加了使用复杂度，因此需要一种更自动、更具原则性的损失函数。
AI.method: 作者提出STB-tvMF Dice Loss，将边界区域和内部区域分别处理。每个区域的t-vMF形状参数由上一轮训练过程中预测值与目标值的平均余弦相似度确定，并在当前轮训练中保持不变。该规则旨在使相似函数在观测到的平均相似度处具有最大斜率，从而自适应地强化当前模型表现较弱区域的监督，且不依赖验证集调参。
AI.result: 在三个数据集和不同网络架构上的实验表明，所提出方法具有有效性。在Synapse数据集上使用U-Net时，STB-tvMF Dice取得平均DSC 70.75%，明显优于Adaptive t-vMF Dice的63.03%。
AI.conclusion: STB-tvMF Dice通过区域感知和自调节形状参数，提供了一种无需手动调参的Dice类损失设计方式，能更好处理医学图像分割中的边界误差和类别不平衡问题，具有一定实用性和性能优势。

title: RVG-Bench: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Driven Audio-Visual Temporal Grounding
summary: Existing temporal video grounding (TVG) benchmarks primarily focus on localizing target video segments according to descriptive text queries of the visual content. However, real-world queries are more diverse and often require the model to first understand the user's intent before localization, such as finding visual evidence, identifying the cause of an event, or recalling a remembered moment, yet such queries remain largely overlooked. To mitigate this gap, we introduce RVG-Bench, a benchmark for reasoning-driven audio-visual temporal grounding, where every query is constructed such that the target segment can only be identified through reasoning about the query's underlying intent. We carefully construct the benchmark and rigorously verify its data quality to ensure models truly comprehend the audio-visual content. RVG-Bench comprises 1,255 videos and 1,890 query-interval pairs across eight reasoning types. We evaluate 22 models and find that the strongest, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, achieves only 49.6 mIoU. Through a series of controlled analyses, including oracle-grounding probes and test-time scaling experiments, we systematically examine where and why current models struggle, providing insights for future model development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RVG-Bench，一个面向推理驱动的音视频时间定位基准，要求模型先理解查询背后的用户意图，再定位目标片段；实验显示当前最强模型仅取得49.6 mIoU，说明该任务仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有时间视频定位基准主要关注根据视觉内容描述定位目标片段，但真实查询往往更复杂，需要模型理解证据寻找、事件原因判断、记忆回溯等隐含意图。此类推理驱动的音视频时间定位长期被忽视，因此需要新基准以弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 作者构建RVG-Bench基准，包含1,255段视频和1,890个查询—区间对，覆盖8种推理类型；每个查询被设计为必须通过推理其底层意图才能确定目标片段。基准经过严格数据质量验证，以确保模型确实理解音视频内容。随后评估22个模型，并通过oracle-grounding探针、测试时扩展等受控分析研究模型失败原因与能力瓶颈。
AI.result: 在RVG-Bench上，表现最强的模型Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash仅达到49.6 mIoU，表明即使先进模型也难以可靠完成需要意图理解和推理的音视频时间定位任务。
AI.conclusion: RVG-Bench揭示了现有模型在推理驱动音视频时间定位上的明显不足，并提供了诊断分析，为后续模型设计与能力提升提供了重要参考。

title: RootDown: Deploying and Benchmarking Models for Beet-Root Detection on Edge Devices
summary: Quality inspection of sugar beets after harvest and storage is critical to preserve sugar content and ensure optimal processing efficiency. The transfer of harvested beets to field clamps or trucks provides an opportunity to visually inspect individual beets automatically on loader conveyors. However, this is a challenging task as the large number of beets causes partial overlap and occlusion, complicating both annotation and detection. In this work, we propose an end-to-end image-based pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets in loading scenarios as a first step toward automated quality inspection. We introduce a dedicated benchmark and present an automatic annotation strategy that leverages the SAM 3 foundation model to generate bounding boxes. We compare models trained on manually annotated and automatically generated labels. Additionally, we investigate deployment considerations by benchmarking multiple inference configurations, including execution on an edge device, under realistic operational constraints regarding precision, inference time and power consumption. Our results show that, despite substantial occlusion and inherent annotation ambiguity, foundation-model-based labels can substitute for a substantial share of manual annotation, trading labeling effort for data volume at a modest accuracy cost. Furthermore, we demonstrate that a Raspberry Pi 5 equipped with a Hailo accelerator enables high-performance, low-power inference, making it a practical solution for mobile outdoor deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种面向收获后装载场景的部分遮挡甜菜自动检测流程，用于甜菜质量检查的前端视觉分析；通过自动标注和边缘端部署验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 收获和储存后的甜菜质量检查对保持含糖量和加工效率至关重要。装载传送带上的甜菜数量多、遮挡严重，人工检测成本高，同时大量重叠目标也使数据标注困难，因此需要自动检测与低成本标注方案，并验证移动户外场景下的实际部署能力。
