title: Polyp-VSSD: A Pre-trained Transformer with Local-Global Joint VSSD Decoding for Polyp Segmentation
summary: Early detection of colorectal polyps is essential for preventing colorectal cancer, making accurate polyp segmentation a key component in computer-aided diagnosis systems. However, existing endoscopic segmentation methods often exhibit limited representational capacity and insufficient integration of global and local contextual information. To address these limitations, we propose Polyp-VSSD, a novel local-global joint decoding framework built upon a pre-trained Transformer backbone for high-precision polyp segmentation. Polyp-VSSD leverages the strong feature expressiveness of large-scale visual pre-training and unifies global semantic modeling with local fine-grained reconstruction to enhance segmentation fidelity. Extensive experiments on multiple public endoscopic datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both Dice and IoU. On the EndoScene dataset, Polyp-VSSD achieves mIoU and mDice scores of 0.903 and 0.946, respectively, highlighting its robustness and strong generalization capability. This work presents an effective and scalable solution for intelligent endoscopic image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Polyp-VSSD，一种基于预训练Transformer的局部-全局联合解码框架，用于提升结肠镜息肉分割精度，并在多个公开数据集上取得优于SOTA的Dice和IoU性能。
AI.motivation: 早期发现结直肠息肉对预防结直肠癌至关重要，但现有内镜息肉分割方法往往表征能力有限，且难以充分融合全局语义与局部细节上下文信息，导致分割精度和泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 作者提出Polyp-VSSD局部-全局联合解码框架，利用大规模视觉预训练Transformer的强特征表达能力，并将全局语义建模与局部细粒度重建统一起来，以增强息肉分割的保真度。
AI.result: 在多个公开内镜数据集上，Polyp-VSSD在Dice和IoU指标上显著优于当前最先进方法；在EndoScene数据集上达到mIoU 0.903和mDice 0.946，表现出较强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Polyp-VSSD为内镜图像智能分析提供了一种有效且可扩展的高精度息肉分割方案，有助于提升计算机辅助诊断系统对结直肠息肉的检测与分割能力。

title: ReLEAP: Upcycling Vision Datasets through Cross-Task Unification and Semi-Supervised Annotation
summary: Developing robust vision models requires large amounts of annotated data, especially for tasks involving fine-grained class distinctions under variable environmental conditions. Even in domains with numerous existing datasets, differences in annotation formats, label definitions and targeted learning tasks hinder data reuse and integration. To address this challenge, we introduce ReLEAP, a scalable Python framework for unifying heterogeneous image datasets through data-source abstraction, systematic reuse of annotations across learning tasks, and mapping of labels to a shared hierarchical taxonomy. We demonstrate its applicability in precision agriculture by integrating fifteen diverse datasets covering a broad range of plant species and annotation types. Beyond unification, ReLEAP enables systematic recycling of existing data and provides a robust foundation for learning-based annotation upcycling. Leveraging this foundation, we conduct extensive cross-dataset and fine-tuning experiments to investigate how domain-specific models trained on unified data and foundation models can be used to automatically generate higher-level annotations under unsupervised, weakly supervised and semi-supervised settings, and how dataset characteristics influence their effectiveness. Our results show that unified data access and annotation upcycling substantially expand the pool of reusable training data and annotations while improving data transparency, enabling more sustainable and resource-efficient use of existing datasets. We release the framework and trained models for academic use to support accessible and collaborative research, particularly in data-scarce and heterogeneous domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReLEAP，一个可扩展的Python框架，用于统一异构图像数据集、复用标注并映射到共享层级标签体系，并通过精准农业中的多数据集实验支持自动标注上采与高效训练数据扩展。
AI.motivation: 稳健视觉模型需要大量高质量标注数据，但现有数据集在标注格式、标签定义和学习任务目标上存在差异，导致数据难以复用和整合，尤其在细粒度类别识别和环境变化任务中问题更突出。
AI.method: 作者构建ReLEAP框架，通过数据源抽象实现多数据集统一访问，系统性复用跨任务标注，并将标签映射到共享层级分类体系；在精准农业场景中整合15个涵盖多种植物物种和标注类型的异构数据集，并开展跨数据集与微调实验，在无监督、弱监督、半监督设置下利用统一数据和基础模型自动生成更高层级标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，统一数据访问与标注上采显著扩大了可复用训练数据和标注规模，提高数据透明度，并支持更可持续、更节省资源的已有数据集利用。
AI.conclusion: ReLEAP为异构视觉数据集的统一、复用和标注增强提供了可扩展基础，尤其适用于数据稀缺且标注高度异质的领域，有助于降低高质量训练数据获取成本并推动协作研究。

title: Complementing DINO Features with Image Structure for Part Discovery
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) like DINO encode rich semantics, enabling training-free segmentation of objects from the background and discovery of their parts via feature clustering. This paper focuses on part discovery: partitioning a foreground object into semantic parts. Existing approaches produce imprecise part boundaries. We trace this to the rigid ViT patch grid used in training DINO, where patches straddling boundaries contain pixels from multiple parts. While DINO's invariance-based training could absorb this pixel-level mixing into clean features, experiments with over 26K foreground patches show it does not: boundary-overlapping patches produce features with higher entropy and lower assignment confidence, blurring predicted part boundaries. Rather than make the massive effort of retraining DINO over geometrically coherent regions, an easier approach is to take boundaries directly from a boundary detector, which supplies the geometric information DINO's features lack. Motivated by this, we introduce Part-DINO, a training-free framework that combines boundaries from low-level image segmentation with DINO's semantic features. We use the boundaries to partition the image into regions, pool DINO features within each region, and group them to discover parts. Without any training, Part-DINO produces structurally coherent part assignments, outperforming training-free baselines across four standard benchmarks (CUB, CelebA, PartImageNet-OOD, PartImageNet-Seg) and remaining competitive with weakly-supervised and unsupervised methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的Part-DINO框架，通过将低层图像分割得到的边界信息与DINO自监督ViT语义特征结合，实现更准确、结构一致的物体部件发现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DINO等自监督ViT的部件发现方法在部件边界预测上不够精确。作者认为问题源于ViT训练中固定的patch网格：跨越边界的patch会混合来自多个部件的像素，导致其DINO特征在语义上不够纯净。实验表明，即使DINO具有不变性训练，这类边界重叠patch仍会产生更高熵、更低分配置信度的特征，从而模糊预测出的部件边界。相比重新训练DINO，引入显式边界信息是更低成本、更直接的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Part-DINO这一training-free框架。该方法首先利用边界检测器或低层图像分割结果生成图像区域，将图像划分为几何上更一致的区域；随后在每个区域内池化DINO特征；最后对这些区域级特征进行聚类或分组，以实现前景物体的语义部件发现。整体流程不需要训练，核心思想是用显式边界补偿DINO patch特征在空间几何上的不足。
AI.result: 在CUB、CelebA、PartImageNet-OOD和PartImageNet-Seg四个标准基准上，Part-DINO无需训练即可产生结构一致的部件划分，并优于现有training-free基线方法，同时与弱监督或无监督方法相比仍具有竞争力。作者还基于超过26K前景patch的实验，验证了边界重叠patch会显著降低特征分配置信度。
AI.conclusion: 部件发现中边界模糊的主要瓶颈不是DINO语义能力本身，而是其刚性patch网格导致的像素级混合。Part-DINO通过引入低层分割边界并将DINO特征进行区域级聚合，有效提升了部件划分质量，提供了一种简洁、免训练且高效的部件发现路径。

title: OlmoEarth v1.3: Embeddings
summary: We make some OlmoEarth embeddings. To do this, we train a new model: OlmoEarth v1.3. OlmoEarth v1.3 is designed to condense multimodal, multitemporal remote sensing data into a single digestible 64 or 128-dimensional vector. OlmoEarth v1.3 produces state-of-the-art embeddings. In addition, OlmoEarth v1.3 is a strong encoder backbone -- competitive with OlmoEarth v1 and v1.2 -- while requiring 18% and 53% of the GPU hours to train, respectively. We use OlmoEarth v1.3 to compute global, annualized 10m embeddings, which we release under the OlmoEarth artifact license.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 OlmoEarth v1.3，一种将多模态、多时相遥感数据压缩为64或128维向量的新模型，并基于该模型发布全球年度10米尺度嵌入数据。
AI.motivation: 遥感数据具有多模态和多时相特点，传统表征往往高维且计算成本较高。该工作旨在通过更高效、更低成本的模型学习紧凑的遥感嵌入，以便支持下游全球尺度分析与开放共享。
AI.method: 作者训练了 OlmoEarth v1.3 模型，将多模态、多时相遥感数据聚合为单一可处理的64维或128维向量。该模型既用于生成高质量嵌入，也被评估为通用编码器主干。随后，作者使用 OlmoEarth v1.3 计算全球范围、按年度组织的10米尺度遥感嵌入，并按 OlmoEarth artifact license 发布。
AI.result: OlmoEarth v1.3 产生了 state-of-the-art 的嵌入结果，同时保持较强的编码器主干性能，可与 OlmoEarth v1 和 v1.2 相竞争。其训练所需 GPU 时长分别仅为 v1 的18%和 v1.2 的53%，显著降低了训练成本。
AI.conclusion: OlmoEarth v1.3 在保持较强遥感表征能力的同时实现了显著的训练效率提升，并生成了可开放使用的全球年度10米尺度嵌入数据，为大规模遥感建模和下游应用提供了更高效的表征基础。

title: GeoLEON-CLIP: Graph-Anchored Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Geographic Region Representation
summary: Geographic regions are multimodal: satellite imagery captures visual morphology, text conveys human-interpretable semantics, and map structures describe urban context. Existing geospatial contrastive methods typically align image-text or image-location pairs, underusing structured map data. We introduce GeoLEON-CLIP, a graph-anchored contrastive framework that aligns three views of each H3-indexed region: an OpenStreetMap-derived graph embedding, a satellite image crop, and a textual description. Frozen pretrained LEON graph embeddings provide a semantic anchor between vision and language. Frozen graph, image, and text encoders are connected by trainable residual projection heads and trained with a symmetric tri-modal contrastive objective. Experiments show strong graph-image and graph-text alignment; graph-image retrieval achieves the best cross-modal performance in a mixed-resolution pool. To evaluate the anchoring hypothesis, we propose chained cross-modal recall $\mathrm{R}@A@B$, which routes retrieval through the graph modality and compares it with direct retrieval under a matched candidate budget. At $\mathrm{R}@1@1$, image$\rightarrow$graph$\rightarrow$text and text$\rightarrow$graph$\rightarrow$image outperform direct image-text retrieval by 4.8 and 4.4 points, respectively, despite using a single intermediate cell. Downstream probes show task-dependent gains, with the largest improvements on Airbnb and Beijing housing. These results indicate that OpenStreetMap graph structure can anchor multimodal representations combining maps, imagery, and language.
comment: Accepted at the 9th International Workshop on AI for Geographic Knowledge Discovery (GeoAI 2026), co-located with the 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems (SIGSPATIAL 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoLEON-CLIP，一种面向 H3 区域单元的图锚定三模态对比学习框架，利用冻结的 OSM 图嵌入作为视觉与语言之间的语义锚点，实现卫星图像、地图结构和文本描述的联合对齐。
AI.motivation: 地理区域本身具有多模态特性：卫星影像反映视觉形态，文本提供人类可解释语义，而地图结构刻画城市上下文。然而现有地理空间对比方法大多只对齐图像与文本或图像与位置，未能充分利用结构化的地图数据，导致多模态表征中缺失关键的城市结构信息。
AI.method: 作者以 H3 索引区域为基本单元，构建包含三种视图的多模态表示：来自 OpenStreetMap 的图嵌入、卫星图像裁剪和文本描述。模型采用冻结的预训练 LEON 图嵌入作为图模态锚点，并连接冻结的图、图像和文本编码器，仅训练残差投影头。训练目标为对称的三模态对比损失，使同一区域的不同模态在共享嵌入空间中相互靠近。为检验“图锚定”假设，作者提出链式跨模态检索指标 R@A@B，即通过图模态中转完成跨模态召回，并与候选预算相同的直接检索进行比较。
AI.result: 实验表明 GeoLEON-CLIP 在图-图像和图-文本对齐上表现较强，并在混合分辨率候选池中取得最佳的跨模态图-图像检索性能。在 R@1@1 设定下，图像到图再到文本、文本到图再到图像的链式检索分别比直接图像-文本检索提升 4.8 和 4.4 个百分点，说明图结构可作为跨模态语义桥梁。下游探测任务显示增益具有任务依赖性，在 Airbnb 和北京住房相关任务上提升最明显。
AI.conclusion: OpenStreetMap 图结构能够有效充当地图、遥感影像和自然语言之间的语义锚点，增强地理区域多模态表征对齐与跨模态检索能力。GeoLEON-CLIP 证明了将结构化地图数据引入地理多模态学习的价值，为城市场景下的视觉、语言和空间结构联合表征提供了可解释且实用的框架。

title: Organizing Temporal Evidence in Hyperbolic Space for Video Moment Retrieval
summary: Video moment retrieval aims to localize a query-relevant temporal segment in an untrimmed video. Existing methods typically perform video-text alignment in Euclidean space, where representations are embedded in a flat geometry. However, accurate moment localization requires organizing query-relevant evidence across multiple grounding states, where target regions, boundary transitions, and contextual distractors exhibit distinct temporal structures and relevance patterns. Such Euclidean representations lack an explicit geometry to jointly capture these relationships, motivating us to explore structured temporal evidence organization from a geometric perspective. Specifically, we propose Hyperbolic Temporal Evidence Organization (HTEO), a geometric framework that organizes query-aware temporal memory in hyperbolic space. HTEO maps temporal representations into a Poincaré ball and organizes temporal evidence through Radial Evidence Organization (REO) and Orthogonal Angular Refinement (OAR). REO adjusts temporal tokens' radial positions to encode the structural differences among temporal evidence, while OAR enhances query-conditioned semantic alignment through orthogonal rotation. The organized representation is then projected back to the Euclidean tangent space and injected into the decoder through a lightweight residual memory update, enabling hyperbolic geometric cues to be incorporated into standard Transformer decoders while preserving the original cross-modal memory. Furthermore, we introduce radial structure regularization and angular relevance supervision to explicitly guide temporal evidence organization and query-conditioned semantic alignment, respectively. Extensive experiments and analyses across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that HTEO improves temporal localization while providing an interpretable geometric organization of temporal evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyperbolic Temporal Evidence Organization（HTEO），将视频片段检索中的时间证据组织到双曲空间中，通过径向证据组织和正交角向精化提升查询相关的时间片段定位性能，并增强几何可解释性。
AI.motivation: 视频片段检索需要在未裁剪视频中找到与查询相关的片段。现有方法多在欧氏空间进行视频文本对齐，但查询相关的证据包含目标区域、边界转换和上下文干扰等多种时间结构，欧氏几何难以显式刻画这些不同相关性层次。作者因此从几何视角探索时间证据的结构化组织。
AI.method: 提出HTEO几何框架：将时间表示映射到Poincaré ball中，并用Radial Evidence Organization调整时间token的径向位置以编码不同时间证据结构，用Orthogonal Angular Refinement通过正交旋转增强查询条件语义对齐。随后将组织后的表示投影回欧氏切空间，以轻量残差记忆更新注入Transformer解码器。同时引入径向结构正则化和角向相关性监督，指导证据组织与语义对齐。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验和分析表明，HTEO能够提升时间片段定位性能，并提供时间证据的可解释几何组织方式，在标准Transformer解码器中融入双曲几何线索且保留原有跨模态记忆。
AI.conclusion: 双曲空间的结构化几何表示有助于显式建模视频片段检索中复杂的时间证据关系。HTEO通过径向与角向机制组织时间记忆，并以残差方式兼容现有解码器，为视频文本对齐提供了一种可解释、有效的几何组织方案。

title: DeformStruct: Deformable Structure Modeling for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point-supervised Temporal Action Localization (PTAL) aims to localize action instances using only a single annotated timestamp for each instance. Such sparse supervision offers limited guidance for modeling the structural organization of an action instance. Existing PTAL methods primarily infer action regions from classification responses, leaving the structural organization of multiple action-related parts within each instance insufficiently modeled. To address this problem, we propose DeformStruct, an instance-level deformable structure modeling framework for PTAL. DeformStruct progressively constructs the structure of each action instance through three stages. First, Structural Anchor Mining discovers multiple anchors from annotated points and action-responsive regions, providing structural nodes grounded in the current instance. Second, Deformable Part Alignment associates latent structural parts with these anchors through deformation-aware matching, allowing their temporal supports to adapt to instance-dependent variations. Third, Relational Structural Organization explicitly models the relative temporal relations among the aligned parts, forming a relational representation that characterizes how different action-related parts are organized together. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14, ActivityNet-v1.3, GTEA, and BEOID demonstrate consistent improvements in point-supervised temporal localization and validate the effectiveness of deformable structural modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DeformStruct，通过实例级可变形结构建模，在仅有点监督的时间动作定位中显式刻画动作实例内部多个部分的组织关系。
AI.motivation: 现有 PTAL 方法主要依赖分类响应推断动作区域，难以充分利用单点标注建模动作实例内部结构，导致对多个动作相关部件及其组织关系的刻画不足。
AI.method: 方法分三阶段：1）Structural Anchor Mining 从标注点和动作响应区域发现结构锚点；2）Deformable Part Alignment 通过形变感知匹配将潜在结构部件与锚点对齐，适应实例差异；3）Relational Structural Organization 建模对齐部件间的相对时序关系，形成关系化结构表示。
AI.result: 在 THUMOS14、ActivityNet-v1.3、GTEA 和 BEOID 上实验表明，该方法在点监督时间定位中持续提升性能，验证了可变形结构建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DeformStruct 表明，在稀疏点监督下显式建模动作实例内部的可变形结构和部件关系，可弥补分类响应驱动方法的不足，提高时间动作定位精度与鲁棒性。

title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
summary: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向长时域、细粒度时空记忆与推理的评测基准 4DMemoryBench 和大规模视频数据集 LongVideo，并设计 4DMemory Harness 系统框架；实验表明独立基础模型在长时域任务上表现显著下降，而借助 Harness 可提升所有被评测模型超过 50%。
AI.motivation: 人类能够高效处理持续数小时甚至数年的多模态信息流，并形成持久、细粒度的时空记忆以支持长期事件预测与推理。现有基准主要关注短中上下文任务，多数基础模型难以在长时域中保留细粒度信息，因此缺少能够系统评估和改进长时域时空推理能力的工具与数据集。
AI.method: 作者构建 LongVideo 数据集，包含约 900 小时视频和超过 5000 道人工审核问题，覆盖视觉、文本及不同上下文长度下的时空推理任务；同时提出 4DMemoryBench 作为评测基准。为增强模型能力，作者开发 4DMemory Harness，整合四项互补技能、22 个以上专用工具模型，以及面向不同模型的检索增强生成系统，用于支持长时域多模态记忆检索与时空推理。研究对 13 个领先模型进行评测，比较其作为独立模型与接入 Harness 后的性能，并对比该基准与先前基准上的表现差异。
AI.result: 实验显示，独立基础模型在长时域时空推理任务上普遍表现不佳；相比先前基准，这些模型在 4DMemoryBench 上的性能下降超过 10%，说明该基准能更严格暴露长时域细粒度记忆与推理短板。引入 4DMemory Harness 后，所有被评测模型的性能均提升超过 50%，表明工具集成、检索增强和专用技能组合能够显著缓解长上下文信息保持与推理问题。
AI.conclusion: 4DMemoryBench 和 LongVideo 为评估长时域、细粒度、多模态时空推理提供了更具挑战性的基准，而 4DMemory Harness 展示了通过检索增强与多工具协同提升基础模型长期记忆能力的有效性。该工作有望推动能够处理复杂长时域任务的时空智能体研究。

title: Search-Based Testing of Modality Sensitivity in Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) process images and text jointly, yet robustness evaluations often perturb these inputs separately or assess only predefined corruption levels. Such evaluations provide limited evidence of which modality is more susceptible to perturbations and whether smaller changes across both modalities can jointly expose failures. We present MoST, a black-box testing framework that characterizes modality sensitivity by comparing image-only, text-only, and joint perturbations. MoST uses multi-objective search to select and combine perturbations and adjust their severity, seeking prediction degradation while limiting changes to images and prompts. We evaluate MoST on four VLMs performing object localization on ImageNet and driving images. The models exhibit distinct sensitivities: textual perturbations dominate for some, whereas others are susceptible across both modalities. In several configurations, joint perturbations match or exceed the effectiveness of single-modality perturbations with smaller modifications to each input. In a human study, 60-76% of assessments across models judge the perturbed inputs sufficiently understandable to perform the task, and human localization is more accurate than that of the corresponding VLMs. These results show that evaluating modalities separately can overlook failure-inducing combinations and that modality sensitivity provides a more detailed account of VLM robustness than aggregate failure rates alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MoST框架，通过图像、文本及联合扰动测试视觉语言模型对不同模态扰动的敏感性，揭示单独评估模态可能遗漏由小幅联合扰动导致的失败。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM鲁棒性评估通常单独扰动图像或文本，或只测试预设损坏等级，难以判断哪个模态更敏感，也无法发现跨模态小扰动组合是否共同暴露模型缺陷。
AI.method: MoST是黑盒测试框架，比较仅图像扰动、仅文本扰动和联合扰动；利用多目标搜索选择并组合扰动类型，同时调节扰动强度，在尽量限制图像和提示改动幅度的前提下最大化预测性能下降。作者在ImageNet和驾驶图像上的四个VLM目标定位任务中进行评估，并开展人类可读性与定位性能研究。
AI.result: 不同VLM呈现不同模态敏感性：部分模型主要受文本扰动影响，部分模型在图像和文本扰动下均脆弱。若干配置中，联合扰动仅以更小的单模态改动即可达到甚至超过单模态扰动的失效效果。人类研究中，60%-76%的扰动输入仍被认为足以完成该任务，且人类定位准确率高于相应VLM。
AI.conclusion: 单独评估某一模态的扰动可能遗漏能诱发失败的跨模态组合；模态敏感性分析比总体失败率能更细致地刻画VLM鲁棒性。

title: A Regularity Condition Under Which a CPAB Transformation is a Diffeomorphism
summary: Continuous Piecewise-Affine Based (CPAB) transformations, introduced by Freifeld et al. (2015, 2017), are flows obtained by integrating continuous piecewise-affine (CPA) velocity fields. These expressive transformations have proven useful in applications including nonlinear temporal warping and trainable activation functions in 1D, as well as nonrigid spatial deformations in 2D and 3D. While computational costs were not an issue in 1D, they originally limited the practical expressiveness of CPAB transformations in higher dimensions, especially in 3D. Our recent work (Aflalo et al., 2026) removed this bottleneck, enabling efficient optimization with much finer tessellations and substantially greater expressiveness. There is, however, a mathematical subtlety that was overlooked in the original CPAB papers (Freifeld et al., 2015, 2017). CPAB transformations are always bi-Lipschitz homeomorphisms, implying that both the transformations and their inverses are differentiable almost everywhere. They are not, however, necessarily diffeomorphisms. This note remedies the omission by identifying sufficient regularity conditions under which a CPAB transformation is guaranteed to be a diffeomorphism. We explain how differentiability can fail and how the proposed conditions prevent this failure. In 1D and 2D, we show that these conditions can be easily enforced and, for commonly used tessellations, hold with probability one under standard sampling assumptions. We expect analogous behavior in 3D.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出并修正了 CPAB 变换中的一个关键数学疏漏：CPAB 变换虽为双 Lipschitz 同胚且几乎处处可微，但未必是微分同胚；作者给出了保证 CPAB 变换成为微分同胚的充分正则性条件，并说明其在 1D/2D 中易于满足，预期在 3D 中也类似成立。
AI.motivation: CPAB 变换通过积分连续分段仿射速度场构造，在非线性时间对齐、可训练激活函数以及 2D/3D 非刚性空间形变中具有重要应用价值。已有研究主要关注其表达能力与计算效率，但忽略了其可微结构中的数学细节：双 Lipschitz 同胚并不等价于可微同胚。由于许多应用可能依赖变换及其逆的光滑性或可微性，因此需要明确 CPAB 变换成为微分同胚的条件。
AI.method: 作者首先指出 CPAB 变换的固有性质：它们总是双 Lipschitz 同胚，因此变换及其逆在几乎所有点可微，但不能保证处处可微，即不一定是微分同胚。随后分析微分性在哪些情形下会失效，并提出一组充分正则性条件，使得满足这些条件的 CPAB 变换必然成为微分同胚。进一步在 1D 和 2D 中验证这些条件的可执行性，并针对常用三角剖分在标准采样假设下分析其概率成立情况。
AI.result: 在 1D 和 2D 中，所提出的正则性条件容易被施加或验证，并且在常见使用的三角剖分下，在标准采样假设中几乎必然成立。作者预期类似性质在 3D 中也成立，尽管论文摘要主要明确验证了低维情形。
AI.conclusion: 该论文修补了早期 CPAB 变换文献中的数学疏漏，明确了 CPAB 变换从“几乎处处可微的同胚”提升为“微分同胚”的充分条件。这一结果增强了 CPAB 变换在理论上的严谨性，并为其在图像处理、空间形变建模、可微变形场等需要光滑或近似光滑变换的应用中提供了更可靠的基础。

title: Past as State, Present as Attention: Persistent-State Blockwise Flow Matching for Long-Horizon Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Co-speech motion generation remains challenging over long horizons due to the need for temporal coherence and consistent style. Existing methods typically generate long motions segment by segment, either conditioning on a short seed of recent frames, which gradually drifts, or retaining ever-longer explicit histories, which are costly to maintain and hard to learn from limited data. We trace these limitations to a key asymmetry between past and present: past motion carries slowly varying style that should be compactly summarized, whereas the current segment exhibits fast-changing local dynamics that require fine-grained modeling. This asymmetry motivates a simple Past-As-State, Present-as-Attention principle for long-horizon co-speech motion generation. Following this principle, we propose PASPA, which summarizes past history with an inter-block persistent state and models the current segment with intra-block bidirectional self-attention. We instantiate PASPA within a blockwise flow matching framework, with multi-block supervision for effective training over variable histories, prefill-decode state caching for efficient rollout, and hybrid classifier-free guidance for enhanced history and speech conditioning. Extensive public-benchmark experiments show that PASPA achieves state-of-the-art FGD performance and preserves motion style across long-sequence generation.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PASPA，通过“过去即状态、当前即注意力”的非对称建模原则，利用跨块持久状态压缩历史、块内双向自注意力建模局部动态，在长时程协同语音动作生成中实现更稳定、风格一致的状态保持生成。
AI.motivation: 长时程协同语音动作生成需要同时保持时间连贯性和风格一致性。现有方法通常分段生成：一种只以最近少量帧作为种子条件，容易导致漂移；另一种保留越来越长的显式历史，推理成本高且在小数据上难学习。作者认为问题源于过去与当前信息的不对称性：过去动作包含慢变风格，应被紧凑总结；当前片段包含快变局部动态，需要细粒度注意力建模。
AI.method: PASPA 将历史运动建模为跨块持久状态（inter-block persistent state），用于概括慢变风格；将当前运动段建模为块内双向自注意力（intra-block bidirectional self-attention），以捕捉局部时序动态。整个框架建立在分块 flow matching 上，并加入多块监督以支持不同长度历史的训练、prefill-decode 状态缓存以高效长程 rollout，以及混合 classifier-free guidance 以增强对历史和语音条件的利用。
AI.result: 在公开基准上的大量实验表明，PASPA 达到 state-of-the-art 的 FGD 表现，并且能够在长序列生成过程中保持动作风格一致性。
AI.conclusion: 长时程协同语音动作生成的关键不是简单保留全部历史或仅看最近帧，而是区分“慢变风格历史”和“快变局部动态”。PASPA 的 Past-As-State, Present-as-Attention 原则结合分块 flow matching、多块监督、状态缓存和混合 CFG，有效缓解漂移问题，为高效且风格一致的长程动作生成提供了实用方案。

title: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth: Enhancing Explainability and Precision in Multi-Stage Alzheimer's Disease Detection
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurological disorder associated with memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral disturbances. Early and accurate diagnosis is essential, yet MRI-based deep learning models often lack interpretability, limiting their clinical use. This study presents an explainable deep learning approach for four-class AD staging using 2D axial MRI images. The method combines eigenvector-based Grad-CAM with gradient smoothing to improve saliency localization and heatmap stability. Principal component analysis is applied to gradient-weighted convolutional layers, while Gaussian noise is added to saliency weights before decomposition. To address class imbalance in the Moderate Dementia category, Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) generates synthetic samples to balance the four-stage training distribution. Custom convolutional neural networks are trained on the Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset, achieving 97.2% test accuracy, 97.0% balanced accuracy, and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.944. The area under the ROC curve ranges from 0.96 to 0.99 across classes. Generated heatmaps highlight the hippocampus and entorhinal cortex, regions associated with Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. These findings suggest that the proposed approach combines strong classification performance with improved model interpretability, although further clinical validation is needed.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种结合可解释性增强、梯度平滑、PCA分解与WGAN-GP数据生成的深度学习框架，用于基于2D轴向MRI图像的阿尔茨海默病四阶段分类，在保持高准确率的同时提升病灶定位可视化效果。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病早期精准诊断至关重要，但现有基于MRI的深度模型常因缺乏可解释性而限制临床应用；同时中度痴呆类样本不平衡也影响模型性能。
AI.method: 使用2D轴向MRI图像进行四类AD分期；在Grad-CAM中引入基于特征向量的梯度平滑以增强显著图稳定性；对梯度加权卷积层进行PCA分解，并在分解前向显著性权重加入高斯噪声；采用WGAN-GP生成合成样本缓解中度痴呆类别不平衡；训练定制CNN模型于Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset。
AI.result: 模型达到97.2%测试准确率、97.0%平衡准确率和0.944的MCC；各类别AUC范围为0.96–0.99；生成热力图突出海马体和内嗅皮层等与阿尔茨海默病生物标志物相关的脑区。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在四阶段阿尔茨海默病MRI分类中兼具较强判别性能与可解释性，但尚需更多临床验证以确保实际医疗应用可靠。

title: Sam-Correction: Fully Adaptive Label Noise Reduction for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: The quality of the teacher label has a dramatic impact on the outcome of the machine learning process. Medical image segmentation often suffers from a noisy ground truth (GT) mask due to difficulties in consistent annotation. Although a recent study has proposed a promising method to curate the noisy GT mask, this requires additional well-curated GT masks that are not always accessible without the aid of multiple medical experts. As an alternative, we propose SAM-Correction, which utilizes a foundation model to correct the noisy GT mask in a fully adaptive manner instead of manually preparing well-curated masks. In our approach, we progressively mitigate label noise via the segment anything model (SAM), where prompts are given from another segmentation network that we train concurrently. Experiments with various types of label noise derived from actual human annotations demonstrate that SAM-C achieves precise noise reduction and high-performing segmentation models trained thereby. Our method paves the way for robust model training even when clean labels are entirely unavailable.
comment: 5 pages, accepted to IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2024

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAM-Correction，利用SAM基础模型联合训练辅助分割网络，自适应校正医学图像分割中的噪声标注，无需额外高质量标注。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割常因人工标注不一致而产生含噪的ground truth，影响模型训练效果；已有方法依赖额外清洗后的标注，而这类数据往往需要多位医学专家投入大量精力，难以获得。
AI.method: 提出SAM-Correction：以Segment Anything Model（SAM）为基础模型，与另一分割网络并行/联合训练；该网络生成prompt引导SAM，对噪声GT进行渐进式、自适应校正，从而在训练过程中持续降低标签噪声。
AI.result: 在多种来自真实人工标注的噪声类型上，SAM-C能够精确减少标签噪声，并显著提升由此训练的分割模型性能，即使没有完全干净的标签也能实现鲁棒训练。
AI.conclusion: SAM-Correction通过基础模型自适应修正医学图像分割中的噪声标注，为缺乏干净标签场景下的鲁棒模型训练提供了新路径。

title: UniWorld: A Unified World Model for Real-Time Visual World Simulation
summary: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation.

AI.tldr: UniWorld 提出一个统一的视频生成框架，将场景几何的连续深度轨迹与时间上持久的外观信息整合到同一生成模型中，以支持实时、连续的视觉世界模拟。
AI.motivation: 连续视觉世界模拟需要同时处理不断变化的场景几何和长时间稳定的外观表现，传统方法难以将二者在共享时间线上耦合维护，并在持续生成中避免历史外观被破坏或几何条件失效。
AI.method: UniWorld 在共享视频生成模型中统一维护视觉历史与几何历史，并采用两个核心机制：一是噪声对齐的重叠式续写，将已生成历史放置到指定采样噪声水平，仅提交新生成的潜变量；二是滚动式深度潜状态，在采样窗口内保持条件固定，增量读取新几何信息，同时将活动深度状态限制在窗口大小内。
AI.result: 实验在连续生成、成对历史干预和跨场景长时程生成中验证了框架有效性。该生成器支持估计深度、原生深度和按需仿真深度，缓存与增量执行路径可产生逐位一致的结果，外观变化与几何控制分支通过同一接口工作且不修改已提交历史；稳态 DiT 执行路径实现实时生成吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: UniWorld 通过时间线统一的视觉—几何建模机制，实现了精确历史保持、可控深度条件输入和高效连续生成，为实时、长时程、可持续干预的视觉世界模拟提供了统一框架。

title: PASTA: Prompt-Aware Annealed Diffusion Sampling
summary: While Diffusion models produce high-quality images, real-world visual design requires intentionally preserving clean regions for headlines, logos, or UI elements. Existing layout-aware text-to-image methods struggle to strictly preserve reserved regions, often introducing unwanted content that complicates downstream editing. Existing approaches either manipulate attention to displace content or suppress conditioning via noise-level interventions. However, these methods sacrifice visual coherence, producing flat regions or noticeable style inconsistencies between reserved and non-reserved areas. To address this limitation, we propose a Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling (PASTA), a training-free framework that enforces reserved-region constraints by selectively applying semantic guidance to object-allowed regions during sampling. PASTA operates on a shared latent trajectory, where full-prompt and context-prompt guidance are fused through mask-guided sampling. An annealed schedule suppresses semantic leakage during early denoising stages while gradually restoring visual consistency in later stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PASTA improves reserved-region fidelity while preserving overall image realism and perceptual consistency.
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to ICONIP2026

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PASTA——一种免训练的扩散采样框架，通过在共享隐空间轨迹中结合全提示与上下文提示的语义引导，并按掩码选择性地作用于允许放置对象的区域，从而更严格地保留标题、Logo、UI 等预留区域，同时保持整体图像的真实感与视觉一致性。
AI.motivation: 真实视觉设计不仅要求生成高质量图像，还需要有意保留干净区域用于排版或叠加元素。现有布局感知文生图方法虽然能控制对象分布，但难以严格保留预留区域，常引入 unwanted content 或造成平坦区域、风格不一致等视觉连贯性问题。
AI.method: 论文提出 Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling（PASTA）。该方法在扩散采样阶段维护一条共享隐空间轨迹，将完整提示生成的语义引导与仅包含背景/上下文提示的引导融合；通过掩码控制语义引导只作用于允许对象出现的区域。进一步采用退火（annealed）调度：在早期去噪阶段抑制语义内容向预留区域泄漏，在后期阶段逐步恢复视觉一致性。整个过程无需模型训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PASTA 相比现有布局感知方法能够提高预留区域的保真度，更有效地保持标题、Logo、UI 等区域干净，同时在整体图像真实感、感知一致性和区域间风格协调方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: PASTA 是一种实用的免训练扩散采样框架，能够在不牺牲视觉连贯性的前提下增强预留区域控制能力，适用于需要严格保持干净区域的实际视觉设计任务。

title: Interactive image diagnosis using test-time backpropagation from the auxiliary task
summary: Multi-task deep learning has been developed to ensure explainability in computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems. These systems simultaneously predict interpretable characteristics of findings in auxiliary tasks to help radiologists assess the reliability of the diagnostic prediction. However, the CAD's opinion would not be referred to when the auxiliary task prediction deviates from the radiologist's expectation. To further leverage CAD's knowledge in the above situation, we proposed a multi-task gradient assist (MGA) method that brings interactivity to multi-task models without additional training. MGA allows radiologists to give feedback to the CAD and ask for additional diagnostic suggestions. Using two datasets of mammography and CT, we show that MGA successfully improves diagnostic accuracy upon feedback on various auxiliary tasks. Compared to an existing method using forward propagation only, MGA performs more robustly and can be combined to further improve accuracy. Our method paves a promising way for integrating artificial intelligence into image diagnosis.
comment: 8 pages, accepted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2025

AI.tldr: 该研究提出多任务梯度辅助（MGA）方法，使放射科医师能够基于辅助任务预测向CAD系统提供反馈，在不额外训练模型的情况下提升诊断准确性与交互性。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机辅助诊断系统通过多任务学习提高可解释性，但当辅助任务预测偏离放射科医师预期时，其诊断意见容易被忽略。为在医师不信任辅助结果时仍能利用CAD的知识，需要一种可交互、无需额外训练的机制。
AI.method: 作者提出多任务梯度辅助（MGA）方法，通过梯度信息实现辅助任务与诊断任务之间的交互，允许放射科医师针对辅助任务给出反馈并请求额外诊断建议，且不需要重新训练模型。方法在乳腺X线摄影和CT两个数据集上进行验证，并与仅使用前向传播的已有方法比较。
AI.result: 实验表明，MGA在不同辅助任务反馈下能够提升诊断准确率，相比仅依赖前向传播的方法更鲁棒，并且可以与该方法结合以进一步提高诊断性能。
AI.conclusion: MGA为医学图像计算机辅助诊断提供了增强可解释性与医师交互的有效途径，有助于在不增加训练成本的情况下更充分地利用AI诊断知识，推动人工智能融入影像诊断流程。

title: An Error Budget for Shuffled Multimodal Windows in the 3rd WEAR Challenge: Stacking, Count Constraints and Seam Matching
summary: The 3rd WEAR Dataset Challenge asks for an activity label for every one-second window of four unseen participants. Each window has 15 VideoMAEv2 frame embeddings, the accelerometer signal of one random limb, and the windows are shuffled. This report is an empirical analysis of one system built after the challenge deadline. Window classifiers are stacked with features averaged over per-participant graphs of video neighbours and scored successor candidates, and a mean-field style decoder with a soft count constraint per activity labels all windows of a participant together. The setting is offline and transductive, and the count constraint relies on each activity being performed once. In a participant-wise simulation with participant-level bootstrap intervals, stacking added 0.051 macro F1 over stage-1 fusion and the count constraint 0.011 (95% interval 0.006 to 0.017). A quadratic seam distance ranks the true same-limb successor first among about 720 candidates in 83.9% of cases, but adding it to the link model changed macro F1 by -0.0001 (-0.0006 to 0.0005). With the decoder settings and the mixing weight chosen inside the folds and the mislabelled spans left out of training, the system scores 0.936 in simulation (0.940 for participants who performed each activity once); the submitted configuration scores 0.938 (0.943). Per-participant scores range from 0.80 to 0.97. These results come from a non-nested stacking protocol that uses unlabelled features transductively, so they are not a fully inductive estimate. An oracle that averages the final unary scores over the true segments reaches 0.973, and 79% of the remaining errors involve the null class. On the private leaderboard, which no choice used, the selected Kaggle submission scored 0.9231 (public 0.9254, with bounds partly tuned there), and a later one with bounds chosen in simulation scored 0.9247 (public 0.9253).
comment: 12 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Technical report on a post-deadline system for the 3rd WEAR Dataset Challenge at HASCA 2026. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该报告针对第3届WEAR数据集挑战赛，提出并实证分析了一种离线、转导式活动识别系统：对每个1秒窗口预测活动标签，并结合视频近邻图、加速计后继线索和带软计数约束的均值场解码器进行全局校正。
AI.motivation: 挑战要求为四位未见参与者的每个随机打乱的一秒视频窗口分配活动标签。窗口级分类容易受到单窗口噪声和局部不连续性影响，而真实活动序列具有时序结构和活动出现次数约束，因此需要一种能利用参与者内部关系、邻域特征和全局计数信息的方法。
AI.method: 系统以窗口级分类器为基础，首先对每个参与者构建视频近邻图和后继候选图，对特征进行平均并用于堆叠模型。随后使用类均值场解码器，对同一参与者的所有窗口联合标注，并加入软计数约束，要求每种活动大致只执行一次。实验采用参与者级模拟和bootstrap区间评估。还测试了二次型缝距作为同肢后继排序特征，以及是否将其加入链接模型。
AI.result: 堆叠阶段相比第一阶段融合提升0.051宏F1；计数约束额外提升0.011宏F1。二次型缝距能在约720个候选中将真实同肢后继排第一的比例达83.9%，但加入链接模型后宏F1变化接近零。模拟中最终系统得分0.936，对每种活动只执行一次的参与者为0.940；提交配置为0.938。私有排行榜得分0.9231至0.9247，公开排行榜约0.925。若使用真实分段对一元得分进行平均，神谕上界为0.973，且79%剩余错误与空类相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明全局解码、特征堆叠和计数约束能显著提升WEAR窗口级活动标注性能，但私有榜结果低于模拟分数，且协议为非嵌套、转导式，因此整体估计并非完全归纳式，实际泛化能力需谨慎看待。后续优化重点可能在于减少空类误判和改进未标注特征下的稳健建模。

title: TIE: Training-free CLIP Embedding Guidance for Compositional Text-to-Image Alignment
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have advanced notably, but still fail to satisfy prompt conditions, resulting in attribute mismatches and missing objects. These errors normally fall into two categories: concept loss, when an object or attribute (i.e., concept) goes missing, and concept confusion, when an attribute is assigned to the wrong object or multiple objects blend together. Recent studies suggest that these challenges are caused by the limited capacity of CLIP text encoder to capture fine-grained semantic details. Although several methods have been proposed, concept loss and concept confusion persist in recent T2I models when handling multi-object, multi-attribute prompts. In this paper, we conduct an embedding-level analysis to develop a training-free, inference-time solution for concept loss and concept confusion across CLIP-based T2I models. We find that (1) concepts mentioned later exhibit higher embedding entropy, reflecting less concentrated representations that are more often associated with concept loss, and (2) the first CLIP attention layer captures the strength of binding between each object and its attribute. Guided by our findings, we introduce TIE, a method that improves semantic alignment through a single text-embedding update. TIE addresses concept loss via entropy-aware singular value amplification and resolves concept confusion through interpolation-extrapolation binding based on CLIP attention scores, all in a training-free manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIE enhances semantic fidelity in multi-concept scenarios with minimal sampling overhead. The project page is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIE，一种训练无关、推理时的文本嵌入修正方法，用于缓解CLIP文本编码器在文生图扩散模型中导致的概念丢失与概念混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型常无法严格满足提示词条件，表现为对象或属性缺失、属性绑定错误或对象混合。已有研究认为这与CLIP文本编码器对细粒度语义的表征能力有限有关，但多对象、多属性场景下问题仍存在。
AI.method: 作者从嵌入层面分析发现：提示词中较晚出现的概念具有更高嵌入熵，表征更分散，更易引发概念丢失；CLIP第一层注意力可反映对象与属性之间的绑定强度。基于此，TIE通过一次文本嵌入更新进行校正：利用熵感知奇异值放大缓解概念丢失，并基于CLIP注意力分数进行插值—外推绑定以解决概念混淆。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TIE能在多概念文生图场景中提升语义忠实度，同时只带来极小的采样开销，并适用于基于CLIP的文生图模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明通过推理时文本嵌入分析与修正，可在无需训练的情况下改善CLIP文本编码器的语义对齐能力，从而减少概念丢失和概念混淆。

title: AlphaAnything: Extending Pretrained RGB Generators to RGBA
summary: Existing RGBA generation methods commonly learn a transparency-specific representation through reconstruction, introducing an additional training stage and potentially altering the RGB decoding function inherited from pretrained models. We present AlphaAnything, a lightweight framework that extends pretrained RGB generators to RGBA directly in their original latent space, without RGBA reconstruction pretraining. AlphaAnything inserts LoRA modules into the generative transformer and attaches an alpha branch to the frozen RGB VAE decoder. Unidirectional RGB-to-alpha feature sharing allows opacity supervision to shape the generative latent while guaranteeing that, for any fixed latent, RGB decoding remains identical to that of the pretrained decoder. We further introduce Endpoint-Aware Alpha Loss (EA Loss), which derives opacity supervision from the complementary foreground--background weights used in compositing. It supports exact opacity endpoints and continuous partial transparency while emphasizing localized alpha errors. Experiments on text-to-RGBA and image-to-RGBA tasks across multiple pretrained RGB backbones demonstrate competitive generation quality, and controlled ablations validate the shared-latent training design and EA Loss.

AI.tldr: 提出 AlphaAnything，一种轻量框架，可在不新增 RGBA 重建预训练的情况下，将预训练 RGB 生成器直接扩展到 RGBA 生成，并保持原 RGB 解码行为不变。
AI.motivation: 现有 RGBA 生成方法通常需要通过重建学习透明度专属表示，这不仅增加训练阶段，还可能改变预训练模型中原有的 RGB 解码函数，影响生成器继承的 RGB 能力。
AI.method: AlphaAnything 在原始潜在空间中扩展预训练 RGB 生成器：向生成式 Transformer 插入 LoRA 模块，并在冻结的 RGB VAE 解码器上附加 alpha 分支；采用单向 RGB-to-alpha 特征共享，使透明度监督能够塑造生成潜在表示，同时保证固定潜在变量下的 RGB 解码与原解码器一致。另提出 Endpoint-Aware Alpha Loss，从前景与背景互补权重中导出透明度监督，支持精确不透明端点与连续半透明，并强化局部 alpha 误差。
AI.result: 在多个预训练 RGB 骨干上的文本到 RGBA 和图像到 RGBA 任务中取得有竞争力的生成质量，受控消融实验验证了共享潜在空间训练设计和 EA Loss 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AlphaAnything 通过共享潜在空间的轻量适配和端点感知透明度损失，实现了对预训练 RGB 生成器到 RGBA 的高效扩展，同时避免额外重建预训练并保持 RGB 解码一致性。

title: Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks demonstrate that Self-RefineVQA yields consistent accuracy gains in monolingual and cross-lingual understanding, with a particularly significant boost for small models, enabling lightweight models (e.g., 2B-7B parameters) to rival the performance of significantly larger counterparts. Furthermore, we provide a comparative complexity analysis demonstrating that while inference cost increases linearly, our framework offers superior data efficiency and a lower cumulative cost by eliminating the prohibitive annotation bottleneck of human labeling required for fine-tuning. Our results highlight the potential of prompt-based self-improvement as a scalable, accessible paradigm for reliable table reasoning in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Self-RefineVQA，一种免训练、推理时自我修正的表格视觉问答框架，通过让单个 VLM 迭代扮演生成者、评审者和修正者来提升表格推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在表格等结构化内容上的 VQA 推理仍存在空间错位和逻辑幻觉问题，而改进方法通常依赖模型结构修改或昂贵监督微调，需要大规模专家标注和高算力，门槛较高。
AI.method: 受人类修订行为启发，Self-RefineVQA 在推理阶段构建闭环自我反馈：同一个 VLM 先作为生成者回答，再作为评审者检查错误，最后作为修正者基于提示引导的重新评估迭代改进答案，无需额外标注数据或模型更新。
AI.result: 在多个表格 VQA 基准上，该方法在单语和跨语言理解中均带来稳定准确率提升，尤其显著改善小模型表现，使 2B–7B 参数的轻量模型接近更大模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 尽管推理成本随迭代线性增加，但该框架数据效率更高、累计成本更低，因为避免了微调所需的人工标注瓶颈，展示了基于提示的自我改进作为可扩展、易获取的表格推理增强范式的潜力。

title: Tempo-Zero: Recursive Self-Play in Executable Worlds for Video Reasoning
summary: Video reasoning requires understanding how events unfold over time, yet videos with accurate temporal annotations are expensive to collect. Self-play offers an alternative by letting a model generate and solve its own tasks without manual annotation. However, existing video self-play methods train on fixed sets of recorded videos, so they cannot alter the underlying event dynamics and rely on noisy pseudo-labels derived from the model's own outputs, such as majority voting, that risk reinforcing shared model errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Tempo-Zero, a self-improvement framework that closes a loop of executable environments, execution-verified self-play, and environment evolution, where executing a program renders a video with the ground-truth option and interval of every question. A single policy plays both Questioner and Solver, proposing questions and answering them with timestamped evidence lines, and is trained on execution-grounded rewards instead of model consensus. The Solver's performance steers a curriculum over tasks and difficulty levels, and the policy selects rule changes that enrich the event dynamics of later rounds. Despite being trained solely on simple programs, without supervised fine-tuning or external video data which prior methods typically require, Tempo-Zero outperforms the base models and recent self-play baselines on average across twelve real-world video benchmarks at different model scales, with particularly strong gains on temporal grounding tasks. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: Tempo-Zero提出一种“可执行环境—执行验证式自我对弈—环境进化”的视频推理自提升框架，使模型在无外部视频监督数据的条件下生成并解决带真实时间戳标签的视频问答任务，并在12个真实世界视频基准上取得优于基线模型和近期自我对弈方法的平均性能，尤其在时间定位任务上提升明显。
AI.motivation: 视频推理依赖对事件随时间演化的理解，但人工提供准确时间标注的视频数据成本高。现有视频自我对弈方法通常只在固定录制视频上训练，无法主动改变事件动态，且依赖模型自身输出生成的伪标签（如多数投票），容易强化模型共享的错误。
AI.method: 方法核心是构建一个闭环：模型在可执行程序中生成视频环境，程序执行时同时渲染出视频以及每个问题的真实选项和时间区间，从而实现执行验证。单一策略同时扮演Questioner和Solver：Questioner提出关于视频动态的问题，Solver用带时间戳的证据线回答。训练奖励不来自模型间共识，而来自程序执行给出的客观监督。Solver表现进一步指导任务和难度课程选择，策略还通过选择规则变化来丰富后续轮次的事件动态。整个过程仅使用简单程序生成训练数据，不需要监督微调和外部视频数据。
AI.result: 尽管训练数据只来自简单程序且不使用人工标注视频或外部视频数据，Tempo-Zero在多个模型规模下于12个真实世界视频基准上平均优于基础模型和近期自我对弈基线，尤其在时间定位/时间接地任务上表现提升显著。
AI.conclusion: Tempo-Zero表明，通过可执行环境产生具有真实时间监督的视频任务，并用执行验证奖励替代不可靠伪标签，可以缓解现有视频自我对弈中的标签噪声和事件动态受限问题，为低资源、自进化视频推理训练提供了有效路径。

title: PROVE: Probabilistic Visual Grounding via Patch-Level Evidence for Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual grounding with vision-language models such as CLIP typically produces a single deterministic relevance map for an image-query pair, without indicating whether the localisation is reliable or whether the referent is present at all. We introduce \textbf{PROVE} (\textbf{Pro}babilistic \textbf{V}isual Grounding via Patch-Level \textbf{E}vidence), a post-hoc evidential adapter that maps frozen CLIP patch features to per-patch Beta distributions without modifying the backbone. PROVE casts grounding as per-patch membership: each patch accumulates positive and negative evidence for whether it belongs to the referent, so a query may match zero, one, or many patches. We train PROVE with an evidential objective on soft patch-coverage targets, and define a prior-pull objective that keeps absent-referent examples near an uninformative prior, so that vacuity serves as an absence signal without a dedicated presence classifier. During inference, a single forward pass yields, in closed form, a posterior-mean grounding map, a spatial vacuity map, and an image-level absence score. We evaluate PROVE on referring-expression benchmarks: it is competitive in localisation with state-of-the-art CLIP grounding methods, its uncertainty tracks localisation error and supports selective prediction under abstention, and its image-level score detects when the referent is absent altogether. Our evidential patch-membership modelling offers a simple, drop-in mechanism for probabilistic verification in frozen vision-language grounding systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PROVE，一种面向冻结 CLIP 视觉语言模型的概率视觉定位适配器，通过 patch 级 Beta 证据分布同时输出定位图、不确定性和指称对象是否存在。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 CLIP 的视觉定位方法通常只能产生确定性的相关性图，难以判断定位是否可靠，也无法识别图像中是否根本不存在查询所指对象。
AI.method: PROVE 是一个后验式证据适配器，在不修改 CLIP 主干网络的情况下，将冻结的 patch 特征映射为每个 patch 的 Beta 分布。该方法把视觉定位建模为 patch 级成员归属问题，使每个 patch 累积属于或不属于指称对象的正负证据。训练时采用证据目标函数和软 patch 覆盖目标，并引入 prior-pull 目标，使不存在指称对象的样本保持接近无信息先验，从而将空无性作为存在性缺失信号。推理时单次前向传播即可闭式输出后验均值定位图、空间空无性图和图像级不存在分数。
AI.result: 在指称表达基准上，PROVE 的定位性能可与先进 CLIP 定位方法竞争，其不确定性能够反映定位误差并支持拒绝预测场景下的选择性决策，图像级分数也能有效检测指称对象完全不存在的情况。
AI.conclusion: PROVE 通过证据化 patch 成员建模为冻结视觉语言定位系统提供了简单、可插拔的概率验证机制，使视觉定位从单一相关性图扩展为具有可靠性判断和不存在检测能力的概率预测。

title: Learning Fine-Grained Visual Classification with Text as Privileged Information via Multimodal Distillation
summary: Fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) requires distinguishing between highly similar categories by focusing on subtle, localized visual differences. Recent multimodal methods have demonstrated that textual attribute descriptions can provide valuable semantic supervision by explicitly describing discriminative object characteristics. However, these descriptions are typically unavailable at test time, limiting their direct use in deployment. We propose FG-LUPI, a Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI)-based framework that leverages attribute descriptions during training. We train a multimodal teacher that integrates image patches and textual attributes via gated cross-attention, allowing semantic attributes to condition visual representations. We distill this knowledge into an image-only student using multi-level distillation at the prediction, patch, and attention levels, aligning global predictions, patch representations, and attention patterns with the teacher. This encourages the student to inherit attention structure learned from multimodal supervision while maintaining image-only inference. Experiments on multiple FGVC benchmarks show consistent improvements in classification accuracy over strong ViT-based baselines. Furthermore, evaluation using Expected Calibration Error (ECE) shows that FG-LUPI also produces better-calibrated predictions across all six benchmarks. These results suggest that textual attribute supervision can benefit not only fine-grained recognition performance but also the reliability of model confidence, while preserving the efficiency and practicality of image-only inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 FG-LUPI，将训练期的文本属性描述作为特权信息，通过多模态教师模型监督仅图像输入的视觉 Transformer 学生模型，从而提升细粒度图像分类精度与预测置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉分类需要识别高度相似类别之间的细微局部差异。文本属性描述能提供明确的语义监督，但通常仅在训练阶段可得、测试时不可用。因此，需要在不依赖测试时文本输入的前提下，把属性语义知识迁移到纯图像模型中。
AI.method: 采用 LUPI 框架：训练多模态教师模型，通过门控交叉注意力融合图像 patch 与文本属性，使视觉表示受语义属性条件调制；再通过预测级、patch 级和注意力级多层知识蒸馏，将教师的全局预测、局部特征表示和注意力模式迁移给仅使用图像输入的学生模型。
AI.result: 在多个 FGVC 基准上，FG-LUPI 相比强 ViT 基线取得一致的分类准确率提升；同时，基于 ECE 的评估表明模型在六个基准上的置信度校准均更好。
AI.conclusion: 文本属性监督不仅有助于提升细粒度识别性能，还能增强模型置信度可靠性；蒸馏机制使纯图像推理模型保留多模态监督带来的注意力结构与语义收益，同时保持测试阶段仅图像输入的高效部署优势。

title: AutoMIL: Automated Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Classification
summary: Developing multiple instance learning pipelines for the classification of whole-slide images involves many interdependent design decisions and expertise in both pathology and machine learning. We present AutoMIL, an open-source framework that applies principles from the field of automated machine learning to tackle this task by automating integral pipeline steps, such as preprocessing, training and evaluation. In a benchmark evaluation with default settings, AutoMIL reached ROC-AUC scores of 0.94 on UBC-OCEAN, 0.99 on PCam and 0.93-0.96 on a TCGA-NSCLC subset, comparable to specialised pipelines in related work. Ensembling mainly improved performance on imbalanced data, showing that an automated pipeline must adapt to dataset characteristics. AutoMIL thus provides an accessible baseline for whole-slide image classification without manual pipeline configuration.

AI.tldr: AutoMIL 是一个面向全切片图像分类的开源多示例学习自动化框架，通过自动执行预处理、训练和评估等流程，提供易用且性能接近专用流水线的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像的全切片图像分类通常需要构建多示例学习流水线，并涉及大量相互依赖的设计决策，同时需要病理学和机器学习双重专业知识。该工作旨在降低这一流程的构建门槛，减少对人工配置流水线的依赖。
AI.method: 作者提出 AutoMIL 框架，将自动化机器学习中的思想应用于多示例学习流水线，对预处理、训练和评估等关键步骤进行自动化处理，并在默认设置下与多个数据集进行基准评测。
AI.result: 在默认设置下，AutoMIL 在 UBC-OCEAN 上达到 0.94 的 ROC-AUC，在 PCam 上达到 0.99，在 TCGA-NSCLC 子集上达到 0.93–0.96，性能与相关工作专用流水线相当。集成方法主要在类别不平衡数据上提升性能，表明自动化流水线需要适应数据集特征。
AI.conclusion: AutoMIL 为全切片图像分类提供了一种无需人工配置流水线的可访问基线，有助于推动多示例学习在数字病理分析中的低门槛应用与复现。

title: MDMR-Bench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Image generation models have rapidly advanced, with many models now supporting generation conditioned on multiple reference images and textual instructions. Such models enable a wide range of applications, including entity fusion and attribute transfer across images. However, existing benchmarks for multi-reference image generation rely on limited evaluation dimensions and fail to capture the diverse challenges of the task. To address this limitation, we propose MDMR-Bench, a Multi-Dimensional benchmark for Multi-Reference image generation. MDMR-Bench is organized around representative capability settings and consists of multiple evaluation subsets spanning diverse dimensions of multi-reference image generation, including (1) common entity fusion and attribute transfer, (2) multi-element extraction from a single image, (3) infographic manipulation, and (4) visual reasoning-intensive generation. This design enables systematic analysis of model capabilities and failure modes across different challenge dimensions. Furthermore, to achieve more reliable and interpretable evaluation, we introduce a checklist-based evaluation protocol that decomposes generation quality into fine-grained evaluation aspects. Instead of relying solely on holistic scoring, our framework uses structured checklists composed of both global-level and atomic-level queries, enabling more diagnostic assessment of model performance. By benchmarking both open-source and proprietary models, we demonstrate that MDMR-Bench provides fine-grained insights into model performance across different dimensions. The dataset and code are publicly available.
comment: Bowen Zheng and Jintao Lin contributed equally to this work. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MDMR-Bench，一个面向多参考图像生成的多维度评测基准，并引入基于检查清单的细粒度、可解释评估协议，用于系统分析模型在不同生成挑战维度上的能力与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型虽已支持基于多张参考图像和文本指令的生成，并能用于实体融合与属性迁移等任务，但已有评测基准维度有限，难以反映多参考图像生成任务中的多样化挑战，也无法充分揭示模型能力边界和失败原因。
AI.method: 作者构建 MDMR-Bench，围绕代表性能力场景组织多个评测子集，覆盖常见实体融合与属性迁移、从单张图像中提取多个元素、信息图编辑、以及视觉推理密集型生成等维度。进一步提出检查清单式评估协议，将整体质量判断分解为全局级和原子级查询，实现更结构化、可诊断的细粒度评估。
AI.result: 通过对开源和专有模型进行基准测试，论文表明 MDMR-Bench 能够在不同挑战维度上提供细粒度的模型性能分析。数据集和代码已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: MDMR-Bench 通过多维度任务设计和检查清单式评估框架，提升了多参考图像生成评测的系统性、可靠性和可解释性，有助于更全面地诊断模型能力与不足。

title: PathJev: Decision-Native Vision-Language Modelling for Histopathology
summary: Vision-language models used for decisions in histopathology rarely return calibrated probabilities over the candidates a user cares about. Decision-native models write a question and a candidate set chosen at run time into the input and return a normalised distribution from a small decision head in one forward pass. We build PathJev-P, a decision-native model for histopathology: MedGemma-1.5-4B with LoRA adapters and a decision head, trained on 40,000 patch states from three public collections whose expert labels are turned into typed questions with organ-specific candidate sets and a "none of these" option. In a comparison over 3 seeds with an analysis plan fixed before testing, on test sets without documented overlap with the training data of the backbone, PathJev-P is more accurate than a generative model trained with the same backbone, data and selection rule, the zero-shot pathology model CONCH and a general medical decision model (balanced accuracy 0.541 against 0.492, 0.345 and 0.213); its advantage over the generative model comes from two organs absent from training. The calibration advantage depends on how the generative model's probabilities are read out. With the summed candidate log-likelihood used in previous work, PathJev-P has the lower calibration error (ECE 0.204 against 0.279); with a length-normalised read-out of the same generative model, examined post hoc, the two have similar mean calibration error (0.201) and the generative model is better calibrated on the unseen organs, where PathJev-P remains over-confident. A supervised linear probe on a pathology foundation model is better calibrated in every setting. In a qualitative whole-slide demonstration, PathJev-P labels unsupervised tissue clusters with abstention and separates carcinoma from other tissue while running the model on a fraction of the tiles.

title: PCFBench: How Far Can Large Vision-Language Models Go in Physics-aware Photonic Inverse Design?
summary: Photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) underpin critical applications in telecommunications, sensing, and high-power laser delivery, yet their design remains a manual, expert-intensive process that couples geometric intuition with deep waveguide physics. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising path toward automating PCF design, but can they truly reason about photonic physics from microscopy images, or do they merely recognize visual patterns? We introduce PCFBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs on the perception, reasoning, and decision steps of the photonic inverse-design loop. PCFBench spans 26 tasks organized into six categories of increasing cognitive demand (Geometry Perception, Physics Understanding, Text Generation, Multi-modal Reasoning, Inverse-Design Decision, and Code Generation), built from over 220K FDTD simulation samples across 18 structurally diverse fiber families. We evaluate both individual VLMs on isolated tasks and multi-agent systems (MAS) on the full sequential pipeline from perception to design. Our results reveal a striking perception-design gap: current models can identify fiber geometry with moderate success, yet consistently fail to translate that visual understanding into physics-aware design actions. Moreover, cascading agents through the pipeline exposes significant error propagation, where upstream perception mistakes compound into downstream design failures. These findings suggest that neither model scaling nor naive agent chaining suffices, and that closing the loop demands explicit physical grounding. PCFBench provides the community with a rigorous, multi-dimensional testbed to measure progress toward AI-assisted photonic engineering. The project is available at this https URL.

title: Efficient Zero-Shot Video Anomaly Detection via Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF)
summary: Deploying Vision-Language Models for video anomaly detection confronts a fundamental constraint. Their semantic reasoning demands computational budgets incompatible with the scale of real-world video streams. We present Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF), a framework that achieves efficient zero-shot anomaly detection through three key innovations. First, we introduce a dual-signal adaptive sampler operating in semantic embedding space: a delta signal captures sudden events via frame-to-frame cosine distance, while a drift signal detects static and gradual anomalies through deviation from rolling temporal context. Their OR-gated combination with adaptive EMA-based thresholding provides comprehensive anomaly coverage without training data. Second, we propose a threshold-gated cascaded architecture where lightweight frame-level scoring precedes expensive video-level temporal analysis, invoking it only when confidence warrants additional context. Third, we design a signal-aware weighted fusion mechanism that dynamically adapts score combination based on which signal triggered frame selection. Across four benchmarks, SAAF delivers competitive accuracy at substantially lower cost. Among training-free zero-shot methods, SAAF sets a new state of the art on XD-Violence (92.07%), MSAD (86.70%), and ShanghaiTech (80.54%) AUC-ROC, with XD-Violence and MSAD also surpassing supervised baselines. SAAF sustains 44.95, 48.61, and 41.06 FPS on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and MSAD, a 2.43$\times$, 2.63$\times$, and 2.22$\times$ throughput improvement over the prior best zero-shot method. title: L0-Norm-Based CycleGAN for Unpaired Brain CT-to-MR Synthesis
summary: Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance (MR) imaging provide complementary information for the brain, but acquiring both modalities is not always possible. The cycle-consistent adversarial network (CycleGAN) enables unpaired CT-to-MR synthesis, but because the standard L1-norm cycle?consistency penalty grows linearly with the residual magnitude, the network tends to focus on large residuals. This paper introduces an L0-norm-based cycle?consistency term, in which the L0-norm is approximated by a smooth and bounded function. This approximation not only increases sensitivity to small residuals but also effectively suppresses the influence of large residuals. The proposed model and an otherwise identical L1-norm baseline were trained on 102 images and evaluated on 9 test images. The proposed model achieves a lower mean squared error (0.02746 versus 0.03464, a 20.7% reduction), a higher mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (15.80 versus 14.77 dB), and a higher mean structural similarity index (0.5689 versus 0.5407). It also has a lower maximum MSE and higher minimum PSNR and SSIM than the baseline. These results indicate that modifying the cycle-consistency penalty can improve reconstruction accuracy on this dataset.

title: K-CLUE: A Segmentation-to-Clustering Framework for Ki67 Cell Typing
summary: Ki67 is a key marker of tumor proliferation in breast cancer, but its quantification from immunohistochemistry images normally depends on supervised classifiers trained per dataset. We examine the role of frozen pretrained visual representations in annotation-free Ki67 cell typing. To this end, we use K-CLUE, a framework that segments individual nuclei, represents each nucleus with a pretrained encoder, reduces the resulting embeddings with principal component analysis, and separates Ki67-positive from Ki67-negative nuclei using k-means clustering, without task-specific training or manual annotations. Clustering the raw components is highly sensitive to the choice of encoder: across seven encoders, the Ki67-positive F1-score on matched MIST nuclei varies by 44 points, although Ki67 status remains linearly decodable from every representation, with supervised probe AUCs above 0.98. Analysis of the embedding spaces shows that clustering succeeds when DAB-related variation occupies the leading directions of variance. Whitening the retained principal components removes this dependence, reducing the spread across encoders to 1.00 F1-score point. Handcrafted color representations are also competitive, confirming that Ki67 status is strongly reflected in chromatic information, but they require an explicit choice of color space. In end-to-end evaluation, K-CLUE reaches F1-scores of 85.00% and 81.91% for Ki67-positive and Ki67-negative nuclei on MIST, and 79.59% and 81.16% on BCData, outperforming DeepLIIF and IHCScoreGAN on both datasets. These results show that pretrained representations can support annotation-free Ki67 typing when their variance structure is accounted for.

title: Distortion-Aware Spatiotemporal Learning for Real-Time Wide-Angle Video Rectification
summary: While wide-angle lenses provide an expanded field of view (FoV), they exhibit severe nonlinear distortion near image boundaries, unnaturally stretching people in these regions. Existing methods mostly focus on facial regions, require high computational costs, and lack temporal modeling, resulting in incomplete full-body rectification, impractical real-time deployment, and noticeable inter-frame shakes. To tackle these issues, we propose \textbf{FastVC}, an efficient full-body video rectification framework driven by distortion-aware spatiotemporal learning. Grounded in lens physics, FastVC introduces a distortion-aware thin-plate spline (DA-TPS) module that nonlinearly remaps control points into a peripheral-dense layout, enabling more accurate geometric fitting without additional computational cost. We further develop a dual-level spatiotemporal learning scheme for causal and stable video rectification. At the model level, neighborhood spatiotemporal attention (NST) aggregates local context and selectively fuses historical features with low overhead. At the optimization level, sparse spatiotemporal supervision applies spatial alignment only to anchor frames, decoupling frame-wise accuracy from temporal stability. Besides, we contribute the first benchmark dataset for wide-angle full-body video correction. Extensive experiments show that FastVC achieves state-of-the-art rectification fidelity and visual stability at 57.0 FPS.

title: Augmentation Strategy for DINO in Glaucoma Classification
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising approach to medical image representation learning, yet augmentation strategies of SSL frameworks validated on natural images do not reliably transfer to specialized medical imaging domains. We analyze DINO, a knowledge-distillation based SSL framework, and empirically demonstrate that its default augmentation strategy produces unreliable representations for retinal fundus images, degrading downstream glaucoma classification performance. Guided by the principle that effective cropped views should share minimal redundant information while retaining clinically relevant signal, we redesign DINO's augmentation strategy. Our approach biases the learned representations toward diagnostically critical features rather than low-level image statistics. We evaluate our method for glaucoma classification by training a linear classifier on the frozen representations, achieving strong generalization across seven benchmark datasets. title: VERA-Hand: A Verified Multidimensional Benchmark for 2D Hand Pose Estimation in Third-Person Dynamic Gesture Videos
summary: Hand landmarks serve as input for gesture recognition, sign language understanding, and touchless human-computer interaction. Yet hand pose estimators are typically evaluated with frame-wise localization metrics such as PCK or MPJPE, which are computed over matched predictions and overlook missed or spurious hands, handedness errors, and temporal instability. To address these limitations, we present VERA-Hand, a benchmark that evaluates estimators using manually verified, frame-level 2D annotations for 10,690 hands across four complementary dimensions (detection, localization, identification, and temporal stability), as well as a joint Pose-F1 metric that requires both correct detection and accurate localization. Evaluating six estimators spanning hand-specific, whole-body, reconstruction-based, and foundation-model paradigms, we find that no estimator dominates: rankings reorder sharply across dimensions. VERA-Hand also exposes failures that localization-only and downstream evaluations may not reveal, including cross-hand overlap in over 85% of frames for a recent foundation model. A post-hoc cleanup case study demonstrates how the benchmark can validate corrective interventions, while stratified analyses show that robustness varies across motion-blur classes and hand regions. We release the verified annotations, protocol, and code at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VERA-Hand 基准，用于从检测、定位、识别和时间稳定性四个维度评估手部姿态估计器，并强调仅靠逐帧定位指标会漏检缺失手、误检手、左右手混淆和时序不稳定等关键问题。
AI.motivation: 现有手部姿态估计评测多采用 PCK、MPJPE 等逐帧定位指标，只针对已匹配预测进行误差计算，忽略未检出的手、误检出的手、handeness 错误以及视频中的时间不稳定性。这些缺陷使评测难以全面反映估计器在手势识别、手语理解和非接触式人机交互等实际应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者构建 VERA-Hand 基准，使用人工核验的帧级 2D 标注，覆盖 10,690 只手，并从四个互补维度进行评测：检测、定位、识别和时间稳定性。该方法还提出联合 Pose-F1 指标，要求预测同时满足正确检测与准确定位。基准对六类估计器进行评估，包括手部专用模型、全身模型、基于重建的模型和基础模型范式。此外，论文通过事后清理案例研究和按运动模糊类别、手部区域的分层分析来检验干预效果与鲁棒性差异。
AI.result: 实验表明没有单一估计器在所有维度上全面领先，不同维度下的排名会显著变化。VERA-Hand 还揭示了传统定位指标和下游评测可能忽略的失败模式，例如某近期基础模型在超过 85% 的帧中出现跨手重叠问题。分层分析显示鲁棒性在运动模糊程度和手部位置区域之间存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: VERA-Hand 提供了一个更全面、更贴近实际应用的手部姿态估计评测框架，能够暴露检测、识别和时序稳定性等关键失败原因，并支持验证纠正措施。论文开源经过核验的标注、评测协议和代码，有助于推动更可靠的手部姿态估计研究。

title: HEALPix-Based Implicit Neural Compression of Omnidirectional Images
summary: Real-time decoding of omnidirectional images is essential for immersive virtual reality (VR) experiences. Compared with conventional transform-based learned image compression (LIC), overfitted codecs offer lower decoding complexity by representing each image with a lightweight implicit neural representation (INR). However, existing approaches typically operate on the equirectangular projection (ERP), which introduces nonuniform spherical sampling and spatial distortion, leading to redundant sampling near the poles and latitude-dependent receptive fields. To address these limitations, we propose a spherical overfitted codec based on a multi-scale Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelization (HEALPix) representation, which enables equal-area sampling and efficient hierarchical modeling of spherical signals. Building on this representation, we develop a Spherical Inter-Scale Conditional entropy model that exploits spatial dependencies and cross-scale correlations among HEALPix latents to improve coding efficiency. We further introduce a Multi-Ring Spherical Convolution that aggregates neighboring pixels over a nearly uniform spherical receptive field across latitudes. Experiments on a public omnidirectional image dataset demonstrate BD-rate reductions of 16.3%, 26.5%, and 19.5% over VVC in terms of V-PSNR, V-MS-SSIM, and V-LPIPS, respectively. Our method also achieves a 13.1% BD-rate reduction over ERP-based Cool-Chic 5.0 in terms of V-PSNR, while providing 2.6-3.6x faster decoding than the evaluated learned autoencoder codecs.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于HEALPix球面表征的过拟合图像编解码器，用于全向图像实时解码，通过球面熵模型和多环球面卷积提升压缩效率与VR适配性。
AI.motivation: 全向图像实时解码对沉浸式VR体验至关重要。传统学习型图像压缩的解码复杂度较高，而过拟合编解码器借助轻量隐式神经表征可降低解码开销。但现有方法多基于等距矩形投影（ERP），存在球面采样不均匀、空间失真、极区冗余采样和纬度相关感受野等问题。
AI.method: 作者提出基于多尺度HEALPix球面表征的过拟合编解码器，实现等面积采样和分层球面信号建模；进一步设计球面尺度间条件熵模型，利用HEALPix潜变量之间的空间相关性和跨尺度相关性提升编码效率；同时引入多环球面卷积，在不同纬度上聚合近邻像素，获得较均匀的球面感受野。
AI.result: 在公开全向图像数据集上，该方法相对VVC在V-PSNR、V-MS-SSIM和V-LPIPS上分别取得16.3%、26.5%和19.5%的BD-rate降低；相对基于ERP的Cool-Chic 5.0在V-PSNR上取得13.1%的BD-rate降低；同时解码速度比所评估的学习型自编码器压缩方法快2.6至3.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于HEALPix的球面过拟合编解码器能够同时改善全向图像的压缩率、感知质量和解码实时性，为面向VR应用的高效全向图像压缩提供了更具球面一致性的解决思路。

title: Reuse, Don't Retrain: Efficient, Modality-Versatile Geospatial Foundation Models through Feature Distillation
summary: Geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) are costly to pretrain, yet model families often repeat this process across backbone scales and sensing modalities. We investigate feature distillation as a more efficient way to reuse existing representations. First, we distill frozen CROMA and TerraMind teachers into smaller Vision Transformers through patch-level feature matching. Across nine PANGAEA tasks, distilled TerraMind Tiny, Small, and Base outperform their scale-matched released counterparts by 2.76, 3.02, and 1.87 mean IoU points, respectively; each also matches or exceeds the next-larger released model. Distilled CROMA-Base gains 2.05 points. TerraMind-Base required only 43 A6000 GPU-hours, approximately 0.5\% of the reported cost of independent pretraining. Second, we introduce TEDI, an unpaired multi-expert approach combining TerraMind for multispectral imagery and DINOv3 for high-resolution RGB. Separate patch embeddings route unpaired inputs into a shared Transformer trunk, removing the need for co-registered data. TEDI-Large achieves the highest single-model mean in our PANGAEA-9 comparison (62.51 mIoU), outperforming both teachers overall while retaining their modality-specific strengths. TEDI-Base reaches 61.75 mIoU with 72\% fewer parameters. These results show that distillation improves the GeoFM accuracy-compute frontier while consolidating complementary experts into a single versatile backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文利用特征蒸馏替代高成本重复预训练，将大型地球空间基础模型表示迁移到更小视觉Transformer，并进一步提出无配对多专家蒸馏框架TEDI，以更低算力成本获得更强、更通用的遥感基础模型。
AI.motivation: 地球空间基础模型（GeoFMs）预训练成本高昂，但模型家族常在不同骨干规模和不同传感模态上重复预训练，造成资源浪费。作者希望复用已有教师模型的特征表示，通过知识蒸馏更高效地获得小型化、多模态且高性能的GeoFM。
AI.method: 方法分为两部分：首先，在补丁级特征匹配中，将冻结的CROMA和TerraMind教师模型蒸馏到更小的Vision Transformer中；其次，提出TEDI，一种无配对多专家蒸馏方法，分别利用TerraMind处理多光谱影像、DINOv3处理高分辨率RGB影像，并通过独立补丁嵌入将无配对输入送入共享Transformer主干，从而避免配对/配准数据需求。
AI.result: 在九项PANGAEA任务上，蒸馏得到的TerraMind Tiny、Small和Base相对规模匹配的已发布模型分别提升2.76、3.02和1.87个平均IoU点，且均达到或超过大一档的已发布模型；蒸馏CROMA-Base提升2.05个平均IoU点。TerraMind-Base仅需43个A6000 GPU小时，约为独立预训练报告成本的0.5%。TEDI-Large在PANGAEA-9中取得最高单模型平均性能62.51 mIoU，整体优于两个教师模型并保留各模态优势；TEDI-Base达到61.75 mIoU，参数量减少72%。
AI.conclusion: 特征蒸馏能够有效提升地球空间基础模型在精度—计算成本曲线上的表现，使小模型以极低预训练成本复用大模型知识；多专家无配对蒸馏还能将不同模态教师的能力整合到单一通用主干中，为高效、可扩展的GeoFM建设提供可行路径。

title: Standing on Open Shoulders: Regional Fine-Tuning of Open-Weight Camera-Trap Models for UK Wildlife with Modest Data and Compute
summary: Camera-trap species classification is dominated by large models from well-resourced organisations, which often lack the species-level distinctions regional conservation needs, such as native red versus invasive grey squirrels in the UK. We ask whether open weights let a small team with a modest dataset and a single GPU take a real part in AI development. We fine-tuned the open DeepFaune classifier on 28 UK classes, paired it with the unmodified MegaDetector v6, and compared the resulting DeepFaune-UK v1.2 with DeepFaune v1.5.0 and SpeciesNet on 20,212 hand-verified MammalWeb citizen-science images, after removing sequences sharing any of 1,039 images with our training archive. DeepFaune-UK achieved a strict image-level accuracy of 88.8%, including empty frames, against 56.5% and 59.0% for the baselines, but at DeepFaune's coarser label resolution DeepFaune v1.5.0 was more accurate, though not significantly under contributor resampling (91.4% vs. 88.8%). As DeepFaune v1.5.0 uses a newer DINOv3-based classifier, we applied the identical recipe, without new data, to that classifier. The resulting DeepFaune-UK v1.3 reached 90.6% strict accuracy, narrowed the like-for-like gap to 0.8 points and reduced roe deer misclassified as fallow deer by 69%. On 1,850 images from the 26 contributors with no overlapping images, the three DeepFaune-based models did not differ significantly (90.5%, 90.6%, 89.9% like-for-like). Fine-tuning on 10% of the training crops (about 150 per class) gave out-of-distribution accuracy similar to using all of them, and a DINOv2 run on this subset took about 22 minutes with under 4 GB of GPU memory. Open weights thus make regional model development feasible for small teams, but the largest like-for-like gain came from a newer base model trained by others, so this democratisation depends on large actors continuing to release open weights, under licences that may change.

AI.tldr: 该研究验证了开放权重模型能否让小团队在有限数据和单GPU条件下参与区域化相机陷阱物种分类开发，并通过微调DeepFaune模型在UK物种识别上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前相机陷阱物种分类主要由大型机构的大模型主导，但这些模型往往缺乏区域保护所需的细粒度物种区分，例如英国本地红松鼠与入侵灰松鼠。论文希望探讨开放权重模型是否能降低小型团队参与AI开发的门槛，使其能够基于有限数据和本地需求构建更实用的模型。
AI.method: 研究者在28个UK类标上微调开源DeepFaune分类器，并将其与未修改的MegaDetector v6结合，形成DeepFaune-UK v1.2。模型在20,212张经人工验证的MammalWeb公民科学图像上评测，并移除与训练集存在1,039张图像重叠的序列，以减少数据泄漏。随后与DeepFaune v1.5.0和SpeciesNet进行比较。由于DeepFaune v1.5.0采用更新的DINOv3分类器，研究者又在无新增数据条件下使用相同微调流程得到DeepFaune-UK v1.3，并进一步评估小数据微调效率与GPU资源需求。
AI.result: DeepFaune-UK v1.2的严格图像级准确率为88.8%，包括空帧，高于DeepFaune v1.5.0的56.5%和SpeciesNet的59.0%。但在DeepFaune原有较粗标签体系下进行同口径比较时，DeepFaune v1.5.0达到91.4%，高于v1.2的88.8%，只是在贡献者重采样下差异不显著。使用更新基础模型后的DeepFaune-UK v1.3严格准确率达到90.6%，将同口径差距缩小至0.8个百分点，并使狍被误判为黇鹿的比例下降69%。在1,850张无图像重叠、来自26位贡献者的图像上，三个DeepFaune系模型的90.5%、90.6%和89.9%同口径准确率无显著差异。仅使用约150张/类的训练裁剪时，其分布外准确率接近全量训练效果，DINOv2微调约22分钟完成，GPU内存低于4GB。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重模型使小型团队能够以较低数据量和计算成本开发区域化相机陷阱分类模型，从而实际参与AI构建。但研究也表明，最大的同口径性能提升主要来自他人发布的新基础模型，因此这种“AI开发民主化”高度依赖大型机构持续以开放权重形式发布模型；若许可证政策变化，该路径的可行性将受到影响。

title: Hair Segmentation and Skin Characterization on Macroscopic Dermatological Images for Laser Treatment Parameterization
summary: Current light-based devices, such as laser hair removal, intense pulsed light (IPL), vascular laser therapy, and dermatologic phototherapy, are widely used in clinical dermatology but rely heavily on subjective manual parameterization or uncalibrated point-based colorimeters. To overcome these limitations, this work presents a unified system for hair segmentation and skin characterization in macroscopic dermatological images. Unlike most existing literature that relies on dermoscopic datasets captured under highly controlled conditions, our approach is specifically designed for macroscopic images that replicate real clinical laser treatments. The proposed pipeline integrates a custom-trained variant of the YOLOv9 deep learning architecture for instance segmentation and classical image processing within a single workflow to extract objective skin and hair parameters such as phototype, hair density, color, and thickness. A color calibration stage using spectrophotometric measurements ensures accurate feature estimation regardless of illumination conditions. Experimental results show competitive segmentation metrics (mAP@50 $\approx$ 0.80) on a custom dataset featuring short, shaved hairs, typical of pre-treatment scenarios. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed pipeline in providing the objective, foundational skin and hair features required for future automated laser parameterization, paving the way for its extension to broader light-based medical therapies.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种面向宏观皮肤科图像的统一系统，用于毛发分割与皮肤特征量化，旨在为激光脱毛、IPL、血管激光治疗及皮肤科光疗等设备提供客观、可校准的皮肤和毛发参数，减少人工主观设置和未校准测色设备的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有光疗设备参数设置高度依赖操作者主观经验或使用未校准的点式比色计，难以稳定、客观地获取真实临床场景中的皮肤类型、毛发密度、颜色、粗细等关键参数；且多数现有研究依赖高控制条件下的皮肤镜数据集，无法充分代表实际激光治疗中的宏观图像场景。
AI.method: 提出整合深度学习实例分割与经典图像处理的统一流程：使用自定义训练的YOLOv9变体进行毛发实例分割；在单一工作流中提取皮肤和毛发相关客观特征，包括光敏类型、毛发密度、颜色、厚度等；引入基于光谱测量数据的颜色校准阶段，以消除不同光照条件对特征估计的影响。
AI.result: 在包含治疗前典型短毛发/剃毛场景的自建宏观图像数据集上，分割任务取得接近竞争水平的性能，mAP@50约0.80；颜色校准使皮肤和毛发特征估计在不同光照条件下更稳定。整体结果验证了该流程在真实临床激光治疗前图像中提供基础客观参数的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该统一系统能够从宏观皮肤科图像中实现毛发分割和皮肤-毛发特征量化，为未来自动激光参数设置提供客观基础，并可扩展至更广泛的光学医疗治疗场景。

title: DriveOSS: Dataset and Benchmark for 3D Anomaly Segmentation and Open-set Semantic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent advances in 3D semantic segmentation have significantly improved scene understanding in autonomous driving. However, existing methods are typically developed under a closed-set assumption and evaluated under standard driving conditions, where all categories are known in advance. In real-world driving, autonomous vehicles inevitably encounter previously unseen objects, making closed-set perception insufficient for safe deployment. To address this challenge, we introduce DriveOSS, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first real-world multimodal dataset and benchmark specifically designed for 3D anomaly segmentation and open-set semantic segmentation. It contains 12,661 synchronized and annotated frames captured using six surround-view RGB cameras, a 128-beam LiDAR, and a GPS/IMU unit. The dataset comprises 52 real-world driving scenes collected under clear, nighttime, cloudy, rainy, and snowy conditions and is organized into ID (in-distribution) and OOD (out-of-distribution) subsets. The ID scenes contain only known classes and are used for training, whereas the OOD scenes additionally contain unknown objects annotated as the outlier class and are used for validation and testing. Extensive experiments show that unseen objects remain a major challenge for current 3D perception systems. The dataset, benchmark protocols, and code are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DriveOSS，首个面向自动驾驶3D异常分割与开放集语义分割的真实世界多模态数据集和基准，用于评估系统在未知物体场景下的感知能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D语义分割方法多基于闭集假设并在标准驾驶条件下评测，难以应对真实场景中出现的未知物体，存在安全部署风险。
AI.method: 构建包含12,661帧同步标注数据的多模态真实驾驶数据集，采用六路环视RGB相机、128线激光雷达和GPS/IMU采集52个不同天气场景，并划分为仅含已知类别的ID训练子集与包含未知异常目标的OOD验证测试子集。
