title: EditJev: System One Routing for Image Editing Models
summary: Instruction-based image editing models exhibit pronounced sample-specific performance variation: different models can produce substantially different results for the same source image and editing instruction, and the best-performing model often varies across requests. These models also differ substantially in inference latency, making fixed-model deployment inefficient. We therefore study image editing model routing, which dynamically selects an editor from a candidate pool given an input image and editing instruction. We introduce EditJev, a System One routing model that directly predicts sample-level preference scores over candidate image editing models in a single forward pass. A lightweight preference head on a vision-language backbone produces a fixed-dimensional score vector without autoregressive model-name generation or response parsing. To train EditJev, we construct pairwise preferences from offline candidate outputs and optimize a pairwise ranking objective to learn relative model suitability. At inference time, EditJev combines the predicted preference scores with model-level speed scores to balance editing quality and generation latency. Experiments on ImgEdit and GEdit-En show that EditJev improves aggregate quality over the strongest fixed editor, from 4.540 to 4.592 and from 8.194 to 8.255, respectively, while reducing estimated end-to-end latency by 60.8% and 31.7%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of direct, structured model routing for efficient image editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EditJev，一个面向指令型图像编辑模型的“系统一”路由器，单次前向预测各候选编辑器的样本级偏好分数，并结合速度分数选择质量与延迟折中的最佳模型。
AI.motivation: 不同图像编辑模型对同一源图和指令的表现差异显著，最优模型随请求变化；同时模型推理延迟差异大，固定选择单一编辑器部署效率低，因此需要动态路由。
AI.method: 在视觉-语言骨干网络上加入轻量偏好头，直接输出固定维度的候选模型分数向量，避免自回归生成模型名或解析回复；利用离线生成的候选输出构造成对偏好数据，并以成对排序目标训练模型，学习候选编辑器的相对适配性；推理时将预测的偏好分数与模型级速度分数结合，兼顾编辑质量与生成延迟。
AI.result: 在 ImgEdit 和 GEdit-En 上，EditJev 相比最强固定编辑器将总体质量分别从 4.540 提升到 4.592、从 8.194 提升到 8.255，同时估计端到端延迟分别降低 60.8% 和 31.7%。
AI.conclusion: 直接、结构化的模型路由能够在不牺牲编辑质量的前提下显著提升效率，为大规模指令型图像编辑服务的动态模型选择提供了有效方案。

title: SemGeo-Gen: Unsupervised Generation of Approximate Cross-Instance Semantic-Geometric Correspondences
summary: We introduce SemGeo-Gen, an unsupervised method for generating approximate cross-instance semantic-geometric supervision from weakly aligned 3D object collections. Our goal is not to recover exact point-level correspondences, which are often ambiguous across different instances and would require expensive, impractical manual supervision at scale. Instead, we automatically produce approximate correspondences that are semantically meaningful, geometrically consistent, and diverse enough to train modern correspondence models. Given only coarse category-level rotation alignment, SemGeo-Gen lifts multi-view DINOv2 features to 3D, aligns object instances using continuous piecewise-affine registration, and prunes candidate matches using semantic consistency. The resulting 3D correspondences can be projected into rendered views, yielding scalable 3D-3D, 3D-2D, and 2D-2D supervision without manual annotation. We validate the generated correspondences against sparse human annotations from KeypointNet, obtaining 93% PCK@0.10 and 97% PCK@0.15. More importantly, we show that using the generated correspondences for synthetic pretraining improves recent state-of-the-art semantic correspondence models on SPair-71k after fine-tuning on real data, with gains of up to 5 PCK@0.10 points. Together, these results indicate that approximate semantic-geometric supervision generated from 3D assets can improve real-image correspondence learning and serve as a scalable alternative to costly manual annotation. AI.tldr: 本文提出 SemGeo-Gen，一种无监督方法，可从弱对齐的 3D 物体集合中生成近似的跨实例语义-几何对应关系，用于可扩展训练语义对应模型。
AI.motivation: 不同物体实例之间的精确点级对应关系往往模糊且难以获得，人工标注成本高、难以规模化。因此，需要自动生成语义上有意义、几何上一致且足够多样化的近似对应关系，作为训练现代对应模型的弱监督来源。
AI.method: 方法仅利用类别级别的粗略旋转对齐，首先将多视角 DINOv2 特征提升到 3D 空间，随后使用连续分段仿射配准对齐不同物体实例，并通过语义一致性剪枝候选匹配。最终得到的 3D 对应关系可以投影到渲染视图中，生成 3D-3D、3D-2D 和 2D-2D 监督信号。
AI.result: 在 KeypointNet 的稀疏人工标注上，生成的对应关系达到 93% PCK@0.10 和 97% PCK@0.15。更重要的是，使用该生成数据进行合成预训练，并在真实数据上微调后，可提升 SOTA 语义对应模型在 SPair-71k 上的表现，最高提升 5 个 PCK@0.10 点。
AI.conclusion: 从 3D 资源中生成的近似语义-几何监督能够有效提升真实图像中的语义对应学习，并可作为昂贵人工标注的可扩展替代方案。

title: The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible. Zooming in recovers the evidence, but the region must be chosen before the model answers. We find that MLLMs know where the evidence is, but not in a form that can be read before they answer: the answer tokens localize it from the middle layers on, whereas the attention available before answering does so only in the top layers, at a depth that varies across models, and diffusely. Supervising the pre-answer attention to point degrades reading, and the benefit of zooming is governed by each image's information gap. Building on these findings, we introduce ours, which lets an MLLM look where its answer would. A dedicated look token, processed in a single prefill and kept out of the answering pass, learns in hindsight to attend as the model's own correct answers do, extracting this knowledge into a concentrated pointer before any answer exists. Its hidden state then selects how to look, from no zoom to crops, square windows, windows that adapt to the pointer and foveated warps, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view. ours needs no box annotations, per-model layer search, external localizers or generation before the answer. On Qwen3-VL at three scales and five text-rich benchmarks, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 4.8-9.1 points at 98 visual tokens per view and attention-guided zooming by 11.1-17.0 points, while running faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型在低视觉token预算下难以读取文档、图表和信息图中细小文字的问题，提出一种“让模型先看再答”的注意力引导缩放方法：通过一个专用的look token在生成答案之前预测证据位置并选择观察方式，从而在不使用外部检测器、框标注或逐模型调层的情况下显著提升文本富集场景下的读取能力，同时降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 高效部署多模态大语言模型时，每张图片分配的视觉token数量有限，导致文档、图表、信息图等图像中的细小文字难以识别。放大相关区域可以恢复可见性，但模型必须在正式作答前决定要查看哪里。作者发现：MLLM的中间层隐藏状态已经能够定位答案证据位置，但答案生成前的注意力通常只在较顶层才提供较弱且分散的定位信号；直接监督作答前注意力反而损害阅读能力，而缩放收益取决于图像的信息缺口。因此需要一种能利用模型内部“知道答案在哪里”的知识、又能在答案产生前集中定位并选择观察策略的机制。
AI.method: 提出一种基于“look token”的预答案观察机制：该token在单次prefill中被处理，但不进入正式作答过程。训练时，让look token以“事后”方式模仿模型正确答案自身的注意力分布，从而将原本仅在答案token和顶层注意力中出现的证据定位知识，压缩为答案产生前的集中指针。随后，根据look token的隐藏状态选择不同观察方式，包括不缩放、裁剪、方形窗口、随指针自适应的窗口以及foveated warp等，并通过每种视图的反事实结果进行监督。该方法不需要人工框标注、不需要针对每个模型搜索层位、不依赖外部定位器，也不需要在答案生成前进行文本生成。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL的三个模型规模和五个文本富集基准上，该方法在每视图98个视觉token的严格预算下，相比最强基线提升4.8至9.1个百分点，相比注意力引导缩放提升11.1至17.0个百分点，并且运行速度优于注意力引导缩放和基于grounding的缩放方法。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明：MLLM内部确实存在“知道证据在哪里”的可利用知识，但这种知识在生成答案前以不可读、分散和依赖模型的方式存在。通过look token将该知识提前转化为集中注意力指针，并用反事实视图监督选择观察策略，可以在无需外部监督的紧凑预算下实现高效文本图像读取。该方法兼顾准确性、效率和部署简洁性，为小视觉预算下的多模态文档理解提供了新的解决路径。

title: SP-Guide: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Spatial Priors
summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (AVLN) requires a UAV to reach a language-described target from partial egocentric observations while reasoning over large outdoor scenes. Existing approaches typically fuse view-centered RGB observations and globally anchored history maps as generic visual embeddings, leaving cross-modal spatial alignment to be learned from sparse navigation supervision. We present SP-Guide, a transformer- based goal-prediction framework that addresses this weakness of alignment through a Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder, an Instruction Enhanced Decoder, and a Goal Convergence Filter for terminal target refinement. Experiments implemented on the CityNav benchmark show that SP-Guide improves success rate over the representative baselines, with the largest gains on unseen environments. These results indicate that physically grounded spatial priors provide an effective inductive bias for robust AVLN.

AI.tldr: SP-Guide是一种面向无人机空中视觉语言导航的目标预测框架，通过显式空间先验增强跨模态对齐，从而提升导航成功率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将视角中心RGB观测和全局历史地图融合为通用视觉嵌入，导致跨模态空间对齐依赖稀疏导航监督学习，难以稳定建模目标位置与场景结构之间的关系。
AI.method: 该方法基于Transformer的目标预测框架，引入空间先验跨模态编码器、指令增强解码器以及用于终端目标细化的目标收敛过滤器。
AI.result: 在CityNav基准上的实验表明，SP-Guide相较于代表性基线提高了成功率，并且在未见环境中的提升最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 物理落地的空间先验能够为空中视觉语言导航提供有效归纳偏置，增强模型在复杂户外场景中的鲁棒性和跨环境泛化能力。

title: Are Textual Residuals Truly Complementary? Learning Visual Complements under Semantic Superposition for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
summary: Text-enhanced visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) exploits textual descriptions to compensate for appearance cues that are weak or unavailable under infrared imaging. Existing methods construct compensation from differences between modality-oriented textual representations, implicitly assuming that textual differences are visually complementary. We revisit this assumption through semantic superposition and show that dense textual residuals may entangle useful appearance variations with redundant, making direct residual fusion unreliable. We propose Superposition-Aware Residual Calibration, which transforms dense textual differences into selective and visually grounded complements. Low-Interference Sparse Residual Learning represents modality-oriented text embeddings as sparse activation strengths over a shared dictionary, selects positive strength differences, and suppresses both dictionary-level overlap and activation-weighted interference to reconstruct a compact, selectively controlled residual. Visual Complement and Counterfactual Calibration further calibrates the residual against identity-specific RGB-IR visual discrepancies, encouraging retained semantics to provide meaningful compensation while preserving the residual structure. Experiments on Tri-SYSU-MM01, Tri-RegDB, and Tri-LLCM show that SARC consistently improves the VI-ReID backbone and remains competitive with text-assisted methods. Mechanism analyses show that SARC produces more concentrated textual variations, reduces dictionary-level feature interference, and improves residual-visual-complement alignment for most samples. These results demonstrate that effective cross-modal compensation requires textual residuals to be selectively represented and explicitly calibrated, rather than directly treated as visual complements. Code and implementation details will be released upon publication.
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures

AI.tldr: 这篇论文针对文本增强的可见光-红外行人重识别（VI-ReID），提出“叠加感知残差校准”（Superposition-Aware Residual Calibration, SARC），将文本模态间差异从直接用于视觉补偿的稠密残差，转换为稀疏、可选、并与视觉互补信息对齐的文本残差，从而更可靠地补偿红外图像中缺失或弱化的外观线索。
AI.motivation: 现有文本增强 VI-ReID 方法通常利用不同模态导向文本表示之间的差异来构建补偿信号，隐含假设文本差异可以直接对应视觉上的互补信息。作者通过语义叠加分析发现，稠密文本残差可能同时混合有效外观变化与冗余或相互干扰的信息，因此直接残差融合不可靠，无法保证文本残差真正对应跨模态视觉补偿。
AI.method: 提出 SARC 框架，包含两个核心机制：\n1. 低干扰稀疏残差学习：将模态导向文本嵌入表示为共享字典上的稀疏激活强度，仅保留正激活强度差异，并抑制字典级重叠与激活权重造成的干扰，从而得到紧凑且选择性受控的文本残差。\n2. 视觉互补与反事实校准：利用身份相关的 RGB-IR 视觉差异对文本残差进行校准，使保留下来的文本语义真正提供有意义的跨模态补偿，同时保持残差结构。
AI.result: 在 Tri-SYSU-MM01、Tri-RegDB 和 Tri-LLCM 等基准上，SARC 能够一致提升 VI-ReID 骨干模型的性能，并与文本辅助方法保持竞争力。机制分析表明，SARC 产生更集中的文本变化，减少字典级特征干扰，并提升文本残差与视觉互补信息之间的对齐程度。
AI.conclusion: 有效的跨模态补偿不应把文本残差直接视为视觉互补信息，而应对其进行选择性稀疏表示和显式视觉校准。该工作强调文本与视觉之间的语义对齐和干扰抑制，为文本增强 VI-ReID 提供了更可靠的残差建模思路。

title: CityLift: Compositional 3D Urban Generation from a Single Image
summary: Generating editable 3D urban scenes from a single image requires detailed building assets with a coherent spatial arrangement. Occlusion and perspective ambiguity make it difficult to infer complete building geometry together with consistent relative scales and positions. We present CityLift, a framework that generates individual textured building meshes from an urban image by coupling scene-level spatial modeling with building-level synthesis. CityLift first learns building shape and placement jointly through coupled scene and instance streams, producing coarse sparse structures in a common coordinate system. We then introduce generative spatial inheritance, which maps each building's coarse occupancy and scene-conditioned 3D feature field into a local volume to guide a flow model that generates finer structure. The same coordinate mapping places the generated meshes back into the scene, preserving their spatial relationship to the scaffold. To address the scarcity of urban data pairing scene images with individual 3D buildings, we construct CityLift-5K, comprising 4,997 synthetic scenes with instance masks, building meshes, and placement annotations. Experiments on CityLift-5K and scene blocks from UrbanScene3D and InstanceBuilding demonstrate improved building geometry and scene composition. The project page is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: CityLift是一种从单张城市图像生成可编辑3D城市场景的框架，通过联合建模场景级空间布局与建筑级精细生成，推断被遮挡和透视模糊下的完整建筑几何及其一致的空间关系。
AI.motivation: 从单张城市图像生成可编辑3D城市场景需要具有合理空间布局的高质量建筑资产，但遮挡和透视歧义使得推断完整建筑几何、统一相对尺度与位置非常困难；同时，配对场景图像与独立建筑3D资产的城市数据稀缺。
AI.method: CityLift首先通过耦合的场景流和实例流联合学习建筑形状与位置，在统一坐标系中生成粗稀疏结构；随后提出“生成式空间继承”机制，将每栋建筑的粗占据信息和场景条件的3D特征场映射到局部体积中，引导流模型生成更精细的建筑结构；生成后的网格通过同一坐标映射放回场景中，保持与场景脚手架的空间关系。为支持训练，作者构建CityLift-5K数据集，包含4,997个合成城市场景，并提供实例掩码、建筑网格和位置标注。
AI.result: 在CityLift-5K以及UrbanScene3D和InstanceBuilding的场景块上，CityLift改善了建筑几何质量和场景组合效果。
AI.conclusion: CityLift通过场景级空间建模与建筑级生成分解的协同机制，缓解了单图城市3D生成中的遮挡、尺度不一致和空间布局歧义问题，并利用新构建的CityLift-5K数据集推动可编辑3D城市场景生成研究。

title: Cross-Architectural Feature Fusion for Coronary Artery Stenosis Detection in X-ray Angiography
summary: Coronary artery disease remains a leading cause of mortality, with stenosis detection from invasive X-ray Coronary Angiography (XCA) critical for diagnosis. Manual interpretation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable, especially under low contrast and vessel overlap. Existing deep learning methods often rely solely on detection or segmentation, limiting this http URL propose a hybrid framework, Fusion-YOLOv11-L, combining a YOLOv11-L detector with a pretrained UNet++ via a channel attention gating module. This enables fusion of semantic and vessel-aware structural features, improving localisation of stenotic regions. The UNet++ is pretrained on ARCADE vessel segmentation dataset to provide anatomically informed representations. Experiments on the relabeled ARCADE (ARCADE*) dataset show improved performance over YOLOv11-L, achieving AP@50 of 0.585 and F1-score of 0.596. Cross-domain evaluation on a dataset from the Oxford Acute Myocardial Infarction (OxAMI) Study reveals performance degradation due to domain shift, mitigated using test-time adaptation and augmentation. Test-time augmentation improves AP@50 from 0.434 to 0.480, indicating better generalisability. These results show that cross-architecture feature fusion and lightweight adaptation improve robustness and generalisability of automated stenosis detection in XCA.
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Fusion-YOLOv11-L，用于XCA冠状动脉狭窄检测。
AI.motivation: 旨在缓解人工XCA判读耗时主观及现有模型单任务限制。
AI.method: 融合YOLOv11-L检测器与UNet++特征，并用注意力门控及测试时自适应增强。
AI.result: 在ARCADE*上AP@50为0.585，F1为0.596；OxAMI跨域性能下降，但TTA将AP@50提升至0.480。
AI.conclusion: 跨架构特征融合与轻量适配可提升XCA狭窄检测的鲁棒性和泛化性。

title: SCDM-HTD: Spectral-Wise Conditional Diffusion Model for Hyperspectral Target Detection
summary: Hyperspectral target detection (HTD) aims to locate and recognize objects at a fine-grained scale, playing a pivotal role in remote sensing. Despite significant progress, current HTD methods primarily focus on feature comparison while neglecting distribution learning for background-target separation, which can limit detection robustness in practical applications. This paper addresses this issue by introducing a spectral-wise conditional diffusion model that reformulates HTD as a task of generating a detection map. Specifically, we treat background and target confidence scores as training samples and use the corresponding pixel spectra as guiding conditions to capture the distributional discrepancy between background and target through diffusion and denoising. To enhance practical applicability, we propose a lightweight conditional denoising network based on multilayer perceptron to map noisy confidence scores to their ideal counterparts and adopt a deterministic reverse non-Markov chain to skip sampling steps, thereby accelerating the generation process. Furthermore, we introduce a composite loss to improve background-target separation. This loss integrates constrained energy minimization loss to enhance target saliency and suppress the background by maximizing the target response while minimizing average output energy, alongside binary cross-entropy loss to classify background and target using pixel-wise labels. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, with improvements in both quantitative metrics and qualitative visual effects.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种光谱条件扩散模型，将高光谱目标检测重构为检测图生成任务，通过利用背景与目标的置信度分布差异提升检测鲁棒性，并用轻量去噪网络和快速采样策略增强实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱目标检测方法主要依赖特征比较，缺乏对背景与目标分布差异的学习，导致实际场景中的检测鲁棒性和分离能力有限。
AI.method: 提出谱级条件扩散模型：将背景与目标置信度分数作为训练样本，以对应像素光谱作为条件引导，通过扩散与去噪建模背景—目标分布差异；设计基于多层感知机的轻量条件去噪网络，将含噪置信度映射到理想置信度；采用确定性反向非马尔可夫链跳过部分采样步骤以加速生成；引入复合损失，结合约束能量最小化损失提升目标显著性并抑制背景，同时结合二元交叉熵损失进行像素级背景/目标分类。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在定量指标和定性可视化效果上均能取得改进，验证了扩散建模与谱条件引导对高光谱目标检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过条件扩散模型学习背景与目标的置信度分布差异，可同时改善目标检测鲁棒性、背景目标分离能力和推理效率，为高光谱目标检测提供了从特征匹配到分布生成建模的新思路。

title: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks. Moreover, existing compression methods often overlook the explosive accumulation of approximation errors. To address this issue, we propose Video-MemComp, a training-free and sensitivity-aware context management framework for memory-constrained streaming video understanding. Our method theoretically decomposes compression error into orthogonal local approximation error and layer-wise structural sensitivity via a first-order Taylor expansion. To minimize local approximation error, we perform token aggregation in a pre-RoPE safe zone with an attention-conserving logit bias, mitigating geometric distortions caused by RoPE rotations. To manage layer-wise structural sensitivity, we dynamically allocate the KV cache budget based on offline gradient priors and online context entropy, prioritizing high-sensitivity layers. Video-MemComp outperforms or achieves performance comparable to full-cache and state-of-the-art compression methods on benchmarks including MLVU, VideoMME, and EgoSchema. Notably, it improves the overall accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B from 62.3% to 64.1% while reducing the KV cache to an equivalent of 6,000 tokens per layer, saving over 90% of KV memory.
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出一种免训练、敏感度感知的流式视频上下文管理框架 Video-MemComp，通过预 RoPE token 聚合与基于梯度先验和上下文熵的层间 KV cache 动态分配，在大幅压缩 KV cache 的同时保持甚至提升长视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 随着视频数据快速增长，多模态大语言模型在长而连续的视觉输入理解中面临严重的显存瓶颈。现有压缩方法往往忽视了近似误差在压缩过程中逐层累积并放大的问题，因此需要一种能够兼顾内存效率与视频理解精度的方法。
AI.method: 该方法首先利用一阶泰勒展开将压缩误差分解为正交的局部近似误差和逐层结构敏感度。为降低局部近似误差，在预 RoPE 的安全区域进行 token 聚合，并引入注意力的 logit bias 以保持注意力分布，从而缓解 RoPE 旋转带来的几何失真。为管理逐层结构敏感度，结合离线梯度先验和在线上下文熵，动态分配各层 KV cache 预算，优先保留对误差更敏感的关键层。整个框架无需训练，适用于内存受限的流式视频理解。
AI.result: 在 MLVU、VideoMME 和 EgoSchema 等基准上，Video-MemComp 相比完整 KV cache 和先进压缩方法取得优于或相当的性能。尤其对于 Qwen2.5-VL-3B，整体准确率从 62.3% 提升到 64.1%，同时每层 KV cache 被压缩至相当于 6,000 个 token 的规模，节省超过 90% 的 KV 显存。
AI.conclusion: Video-MemComp 证明，在流式视频理解中，通过理论分解压缩误差、针对性抑制 token 近似失真，并按层敏感度动态分配 KV cache 预算，可以在大幅降低显存占用的同时保持高精度，为资源受限场景下的长视频多模态理解提供了有效方案。

title: SREdit: Scene Response Guided Appearance Editing for Projection Mapping
summary: Projection-based appearance editing changes selected visual attributes of a physical object through projection mapping (PM). To display a desired appearance, PM typically uses projector compensation, which computes a projector input that counteracts the geometric and photometric distortions of the scene. Compensation can only approximate this appearance within the available projection range, and it cannot revise the appearance itself. Pretrained LLM-based image editors provide a direct way to produce the desired appearance from a text prompt or reference image; projector compensation can then attempt to reproduce the edited result through projection. However, these editors do not have an accurate measure of the scene geometry or scene response. Therefore, their outputs may contain geometric misalignment, inconsistent shading, or changes outside the available projection range, which downstream projector compensation cannot correct. To address this problem, we introduce SREdit, an efficient response-guided framework for projection-based appearance editing. SREdit estimates a scene response map from the reconstructed scene that reflects how strongly projected illumination can affect different surface regions. SREdit uses the source appearance to constrain the early sampling process and preserve registration with the fixed physical object, while the scene response map adapts the amount of editing across surface regions. Experiments across two pretrained image editors show that SREdit improves projected appearance quality and reproduction fidelity. It adds less than one second per image with negligible VRAM overhead. Participants also consistently preferred the results produced with SREdit in our user study.
comment: 28 pages, 65 figures

AI.tldr: 提出SREdit，一个面向投影式外观编辑的响应引导高效框架，通过估计场景响应图并约束编辑过程，使预训练图像编辑器的输出更适合投影补偿复现。
AI.motivation: 投影外观编辑需要让目标外观落在物理对象几何与光度响应可投影范围内；但预训练LLM图像编辑器缺乏场景几何和场景响应信息，可能产生几何错位、阴影不一致或超出可投影范围的编辑结果，投影补偿无法修正。
AI.method: SREdit首先从重建场景中估计场景响应图，量化不同表面区域对投影光照的影响强度；然后以源外观约束早期采样过程，保持与固定物理对象的配准，并根据场景响应图自适应调节各表面区域的编辑幅度，从而生成更适合投影复现的外观。
AI.result: 在两种预训练图像编辑器上的实验表明，SREdit提升了投影外观质量和复现保真度；每张图像增加耗时不足一秒，显存开销可忽略；用户研究中参与者也普遍更偏好SREdit生成的结果。
AI.conclusion: SREdit通过显式引入场景响应信息，使预训练图像编辑器生成的外观更符合真实投影系统的能力范围，是一种高效且实用的投影式外观编辑增强框架。

title: Consommé: Conditioned Token Merging for Split Inference
summary: Split inference partitions a Vision Transformer between a resource-constrained edge device and a server. However, transmitting intermediate tokens across the communication channel is costly. Deploying fine-tuned backbones to every endpoint becomes expensive as well. We study token reduction for split inference under a frozen backbone, where only a small adapter is shipped. We observe that the CLS token plays a dual role: it acts as the global summary the receiver needs for classification, and it serves as a signal on which patches to keep. We propose Consommé, a method utilizing both characteristics. There, an information bottleneck compresses the CLS token into a compact latent which is transmitted in place of the full CLS token and conditions a learned patch gate merging patches into exactly $k$ tokens via soft assignment. It reaches any budget in a single step, thus escaping the per-layer cap of bipartite matching (BPM). On DeiT-S/T, it leads all methods at aggressive token budgets and remains operable at shallow splits where BPM cannot operate, while matching fine-tuned methods at gentle budgets at a fraction of their deployment cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Consommé，一种面向冻结骨干的视觉 Transformer 分割推理 token 压缩方法，利用 CLS token 的双重作用，将全局表征与 patch 选择统一到一个可一次分配任意预算的轻量适配器中。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备与服务端之间的分割推理中，中间 token 传输成本很高，而将微调后的完整骨干部署到各端点又带来额外开销。因此，需要在冻结主干网络的前提下，仅通过小型适配器减少跨端传输的 token 数量。
AI.method: Consommé 观察到 CLS token 既是接收端分类所需的全局摘要，又是决定保留哪些 patch 的信号。方法通过信息瓶颈将 CLS token 压缩为紧凑潜变量并替代原始 CLS token 传输，同时以该潜变量条件化学习到的 patch gate，经软分配将 patch 合并为恰好 k 个 token，从而一步支持任意 token 预算。
AI.result: 在 DeiT-S/T 上，Consommé 在激进的低 token 预算下优于对比方法，并能在 bipartite matching（BPM）无法工作的浅层分割点保持可用；在较宽松预算下，其性能可与需要微调的方法相当，同时部署成本显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模 CLS token 的全局摘要作用与 patch 选择信号，Consommé 实现了冻结骨干下高效、灵活且可跨分割深度使用的 token 压缩，为资源受限的 ViT 分割推理提供了低成本部署方案。

title: CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
summary: Real-world 3D reconstruction pipelines often rely on multi-view images degraded by lossy compression. While compression artifacts have been extensively studied in single-image or video restoration, their impact on multi-view geometry remains largely overlooked. In this work, we identify compression-induced cross-view geometric inconsistency as a critical failure mode, where view-dependent artifacts disrupt feature matching, dense correspondence, camera parameter estimation, and downstream 3D reconstruction tasks such as novel view synthesis. To address this problem, we propose CompMVR, a compression-aware multi-view diffusion restoration framework that jointly refines compressed views while preserving cross-view consistency, and construct compressed datasets for systematic evaluation. Unlike conventional restoration methods that optimize each image independently for 2D perceptual quality, CompMVR leverages learned compression priors and cross-view correspondence to recover visual details while improving geometric reliability across views. Experiments across diverse datasets, codecs, and compression levels demonstrate gains in restoration quality and downstream 3D tasks, including novel-view synthesis, camera pose estimation, and view matching. These results establish compressed multi-view restoration as a distinct problem and highlight its importance for 3D reconstruction under lossy compression. Code and data for this paper are available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Technical paper)

AI.tldr: 提出CompMVR压缩感知多视图扩散修复框架，联合恢复受有损压缩影响的多视图图像，并显式维护跨视图几何一致性，以提升下游3D重建性能。
AI.motivation: 真实世界3D重建常依赖多视图图像，而这些图像往往受到JPEG、视频编码等有损压缩影响。已有压缩伪影修复研究主要面向单图或视频质量恢复，忽视了压缩会引入视图相关伪影，破坏特征匹配、稠密对应、相机参数估计及新视角合成等几何相关任务。因此，论文识别出“压缩导致的跨视图几何不一致”作为关键失败模式。
AI.method: 作者构建面向多视图修复的压缩数据集，并提出CompMVR：一个压缩感知多视图扩散修复框架。该方法不再对每张图像独立优化二维感知质量，而是利用学习到的压缩先验与跨视图对应关系，在扩散恢复过程中联合精化多个压缩视图，从而在恢复视觉细节的同时增强跨视图几何一致性。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、编码格式和压缩强度下的实验表明，CompMVR在图像修复质量上优于传统独立修复方法，并显著提升下游3D任务表现，包括新视角合成、相机位姿估计和视图匹配。结果说明联合、几何感知的多视图压缩修复更有效。
AI.conclusion: 论文将“有损压缩下的多视图修复”确立为一个独立且关键的研究问题，并表明维护跨视图几何一致性能改善真实3D重建流程。所提出的CompMVR为压缩感知多视图恢复提供了有效范式，代码与数据已公开。

title: SPOOK: Sparse Pixel Optimization for Off-Manifold Knowledge in Vision Encoders
summary: Modern vision encoders are widely used as semantic representations, but the relationship between embedding similarity and human-visible semantics can become unclear far from the natural-image manifold. We probe this regime in a black-box setting by applying sparse pixel edits to blank canvases with a simple pixel-level hill-climbing procedure. Across ImageNet and Flickr30k, we evaluate whether these edited blank canvases can retrieve chosen targets in multimodal contrastive encoders and self-supervised visual encoders. On OpenCLIP, inputs optimized toward class prompts achieve strong top-1 and top-5 targeted retrieval performance; on DINOv3, inputs optimized toward class prototypes achieve high target alignment and near-top prototype ranks. These results show that sparse edits on otherwise blank, visually non-semantic inputs can enter target semantic basins in both language-aligned and self-supervised visual representation spaces. Our findings identify a shared off-manifold failure mode of modern vision encoders and suggest sparse blank-canvas optimization as a simple probe of representation geometry.
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, and 14 pages of Supplementary Material with 8 figures

AI.tldr: 论文发现，对空白画布进行极稀疏像素编辑即可让现代视觉编码器检索到目标语义类别，揭示了模型在远离自然图像流形时的共享失效模式，并提出了一种简单的表示几何探针方法。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉编码器常被用于语义表示，但其嵌入相似性与人类可见语义之间的关系，在远离自然图像流形的输入上可能变得不清晰。本文旨在黑盒条件下探索这一区域，检验视觉编码模型是否容易被非自然、无可见语义的输入触发目标语义检索。
AI.method: 研究从空白画布出发，采用像素级爬山优化和稀疏像素编辑，构造视觉上几乎无意义但能操纵嵌入表示的输入。针对多模态对比模型和自监督视觉模型，在ImageNet和Flickr30k数据上评估这些输入是否能检索到指定目标：对OpenCLIP优化类文本提示，对DINOv3优化类原型。
AI.result: OpenCLIP上，优化后的空白画布对类提示达到较强的top-1和top-5定向检索效果；DINOv3上，优化后的输入与目标原型高度对齐，并接近最高原型排序。结果表明，稀疏编辑的空白输入可以进入语言对齐和自监督视觉表示空间中的目标语义盆地。
AI.conclusion: 现代视觉编码器在远离自然图像流形时存在共同的失效模式：嵌入语义并不必然对应人类可理解视觉语义。稀疏空白画布优化可作为简单、通用的探针工具，用于检测表示空间几何结构和潜在安全性/鲁棒性问题。

title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
summary: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.

AI.tldr: EchoChat 是一种面向超声心动图综合分析的生成式多模态视觉-语言模型，通过融合大量医学知识与链式思维推理，以可解释方式辅助临床医生判读超声心动图图像，并在多中心数据集与读者研究中显示出优于现有基础模型的诊断与量化能力。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图是心血管疾病诊断的核心检查手段，但全球范围内具有丰富判读经验的专科医生短缺，限制了其临床应用。现有人工智能解决方案多为黑箱模型或任务范围较窄，难以体现临床指南指导下的整体推理过程，因此需要能够模拟心脏病专家认知工作流、结合视觉证据与临床推理的可解释AI系统。
AI.method: 研究提出 EchoChat，一个用于超声心动图综合分析的生成式多模态视觉-语言模型。该方法基于来自46,358次超声心动图检查的“图像-指令”配对数据进行训练，将医学知识与链式思维推理机制结合，使模型能够根据视觉证据显式支持其诊断结论。研究在来自六家国际医学中心的不同队列中评估模型，覆盖33种心脏疾病或征象，并与现有最佳基础模型在疾病识别和定量测量方面进行比较；同时开展来源盲化的超声心动图医生读者研究，评估 EchoChat 辅助生成报告对诊断准确性和完整性的影响。
AI.result: EchoChat 在多个外部队列中取得了新的最佳性能。该模型支持33种心脏疾病和超声征象识别，其中15种新增条件在可用外部评估中平均F1达到73.7%。与现有表现最佳的基础模型相比，在共享任务中疾病识别的平均召回率提高13.54%，定量分析的平均R²提升0.275。在来源盲化的读者研究中，由 EchoChat 辅助生成的超声心动图报告被两名资深超声心动图医生评价为具有更高的诊断准确性和完整性；与常规仅由医生判读的报告相比，F1评分从72.78%提升至82.75%。
AI.conclusion: 将临床推理能力整合到多模态医学AI中，有助于提升超声心动图诊断的可解释性、准确性和覆盖范围。EchoChat 能够在一定程度上缓解专科判读资源不足的问题，支持更广泛、标准化和以证据驱动的心脏影像分析，具有推动心血管诊疗能力均质化和改善临床实践潜力的应用价值。

title: VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering
summary: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode topological patterns (e.g., connectivity and holes). These sources of information play distinct and complementary roles: visual-structural features provide the primary discriminative representation for clustering, while topological features provide additional global geometric cues for residual visual ambiguities. We introduce VTRL-Med, a progressive visual-structural learning framework with topology-guided regularization for medical image clustering. VTRL-Med first adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract image features that retain structural cues inherited from mask-supervised pretraining. It then generates reliable pseudo-labels through a two-step filtering process that combines prototype-based selection with k-nearest neighbor consistency validation. Finally, it progressively refines the visual branch while an auxiliary topology branch, constructed from persistent homology (PH) descriptors, provides additional geometric regularization during training. Across 13 medical image benchmarks, VTRL-Med achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance, improving average accuracy by 4.48% over existing methods. On three representative datasets, topology-guided regularization further improves accuracy by 1.3--4.3% over visual refinement alone.

AI.tldr: 提出VTRL-Med：面向医学图像深度聚类的渐进式视觉结构学习框架，利用SAM保留结构先验，并通过持久同调拓扑特征提供几何正则化，以提升聚类准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像深度聚类方法常忽略两类互补信息：一是与类别无关但反映物体边界和区域的结构先验；二是连通性、孔洞等显式拓扑模式，导致难以区分视觉外观相似但结构语义不同的样本。
AI.method: VTRL-Med包含三阶段：1）微调Segment Anything Model（SAM）提取保留掩码监督预训练结构线索的视觉特征；2）通过原型选择与k近邻一致性验证生成可靠伪标签；3）渐进优化视觉聚类分支，同时引入基于持久同调（PH）描述子的辅助拓扑分支，对模型施加全局几何正则化。
AI.result: 在13个医学图像聚类基准上达到当前最优性能，平均准确率较已有方法提升4.48%。在3个代表性数据集上，拓扑引导正则化在仅使用视觉渐进精炼的基础上进一步提升1.3%至4.3%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结构先验与拓扑信息可形成互补：SAM-derived视觉结构特征提供主要判别表征，持久同调拓扑特征提供全局几何线索，用于缓解视觉歧义，显著提升医学图像深度聚类性能。

title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
summary: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. We prove that this construction is structurally limited: any Lipschitz location encoder produces an output of intrinsic dimension at most 2, regardless of architecture or bandwidth, which forces the contrastive loss to strictly exceed its asymptotic optimum. Empirically, joint training also collapses the encoder's embedding covariance to low rank. Although dimension-limited, current location encoders sidestep this spectral collapse by training against a frozen image encoder, which we reinterpret as a covariance regularizer that supplies a high-rank target for the location encoder to fold onto. However, extending this approach to multimodal inputs is challenging, as location encoders should simultaneously map a single location to multiple, potentially incompatible, descriptors. We identify two requirements a regularizer must satisfy for location encoding in multimodal regimes: co-alignment across modalities, since adapters alone cannot align independently pretrained encoders; and high effective rank, since the location encoder inherits its target's spectrum. We propose LoCA (Location Contrastive Alignment), a two-stage pipeline that satisfies both. Stage 1 jointly trains Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 encoders with contrastive learning, producing a co-aligned, high-rank multimodal target. Stage 2 freezes the image encoders and trains a location and a tabular metadata encoder as projection adapters with multi-view contrastive learning. Against five state-of-the-art encoders on 17 tasks ranging from land cover and wildfire forecasting to geophysical, socio-economic, biodiversity and climate applications, LoCA achieves the most task wins, is the only model to outperform every other on a majority of tasks, and wins 68.8% of all per-task comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LoCA，用于缓解地理坐标位置编码器在对比学习中的内在低维与谱坍缩问题，并通过多模态对比对齐提升下游地理任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有位置编码器通过地理坐标与地球观测影像的对比对齐训练，但作者证明任意 Lipschitz 位置编码器的输出内在维度最多为 2，导致对比损失无法达到渐近最优；联合训练还会使嵌入协方差矩阵发生低秩坍缩。现有冻结影像编码器的方法虽能避免谱坍缩，但扩展到多模态输入时，位置编码器需要将同一位置映射到多个可能不一致的描述符，因此需要新的正则化/对齐机制。
AI.method: 提出两阶段 LoCA（Location Contrastive Alignment）。第一阶段联合训练 Sentinel-1 和 Sentinel-2 影像编码器，通过对比学习生成跨模态共同对齐且高有效秩的多模态目标表示。第二阶段冻结影像编码器，并将位置编码器和表格元数据编码器作为投影适配器，用多视角对比学习训练。作者进一步指出，多模态位置编码中的正则化器需要满足两个条件：跨模态共同对齐，以及高有效秩，因为位置编码器会继承目标表示的谱结构。
AI.result: 在 17 个任务上评测，任务类型涵盖土地覆盖、野火预测、地球物理、社会经济、生物多样性和气候等。相比五个先进位置/地理编码器，LoCA 获得最多任务胜利，是唯一在多数任务上超过所有其他模型的方法，并在全部单任务比较中赢得 68.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究从理论、谱分析和多模态对齐角度揭示了当前位置编码器的结构性局限：内在维度限制和对比训练中的协方差谱坍缩。LoCA 通过构造高秩、跨模态共同对齐的影像目标，并将位置/表格编码器训练为投影适配器，有效缓解上述问题，从而在多种地理空间预测任务上取得更稳健、更优越的性能。

title: STROKE: Simple Sparse Structural Occlusions for Black-Box Adversarial Attacks
summary: We introduce STROKE, a query-efficient score-based black-box adversarial attack that constructs perturbations from simple oriented rectangular occlusions. STROKE optimizes these perturbations through a lightweight greedy add-and-refine procedure. Across diverse image classifiers, STROKE achieves high attack success with low query counts at nominal 1--2\% area settings, showing favorable performance relative to existing patch-based attacks in several configurations. Matched comparisons further demonstrate substantial reductions in wall-clock attack time, while ablation studies examine the key design choices and effectiveness across structural primitives. These findings suggest that simple structural occlusions offer an effective and computationally efficient search space for black-box adversarial attacks.
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, and 16 pages of Supplementary Information with 3 figures and 5 tables

AI.tldr: STROKE 是一种查询高效的基于分数的黑盒对抗攻击方法，通过简单带方向的矩形遮挡构造扰动，以低查询数和高计算效率实现强攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 黑盒对抗攻击通常依赖大量查询或复杂优化，本文希望探索一种更简单、更高效的扰动搜索空间，使攻击者能在极少查询和较短运行时间内完成有效攻击。
AI.method: 提出 STROKE，将扰动构造为简单的定向矩形遮挡，并使用轻量级贪心的“添加与细化”过程进行优化；在多种图像分类器上评估，并与现有基于 patch 的攻击进行比较，同时开展关于关键设计选择和结构原语有效性的消融实验。
AI.result: STROKE 在名义 1%--2% 遮挡面积设置下能够以较低查询数取得较高攻击成功率，在若干配置中优于现有基于 patch 的攻击；匹配比较还显示其攻击 wall-clock 时间显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 简单的结构型遮挡能够为黑盒对抗攻击提供有效且计算高效的搜索空间。

title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear structure, or risk reproducing anomalous content. Flownomaly instead casts the problem as normal-counterpart recovery in frozen DINOv2 feature space. Given normal supports, a velocity field is learned through conditional flow matching over frozen patch tokens to transport Gaussian noise toward normal features. Along straight paths, a single recovery step using one evaluation of the optimal field yields the posterior mean of the clean normal token without trajectory integration. The operating time governs how strongly recovery modifies a query token. With no anomalous validation samples available for tuning, a normal-only Jacobian gain-to-noise criterion selects this time from the supports alone. Squared residuals between query tokens and their recovered counterparts yield anomaly signals for both dense localization and image-level detection. Across 1-, 2-, and 4-shot benchmarks on MVTec-AD and VisA, together with sample-shot evaluations on Real-IAD, Flownomaly achieves state-of-the-art performance against recent category-specific methods. In the 1-shot setting, image- and pixel-level AUROC reach 97.8% and 98.0% on MVTec-AD and 95.3% and 98.7% on VisA, with a 2.1-point image-level AUROC improvement over the strongest baseline on VisA. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027

AI.tldr: Flownomaly 将少样本工业异常检测建模为在冻结 DINOv2 特征空间中的“正常对应特征恢复”问题，通过条件流匹配学习从噪声到正常特征的映射，并用查询特征与恢复特征之间的残差进行异常定位与检测。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测需要仅凭少量无缺陷图像学习类别特定的正常分布。现有方法常依赖存储示例、刚性线性结构，或可能复制异常内容，难以在极少样本下稳健刻画正常模式。
AI.method: 给定正常支持图像，在冻结 DINOv2 patch token 特征上，用条件流匹配学习速度场，将高斯噪声映射到正常特征。沿直线路径仅使用一次最优速度场评估即可得到干净正常 token 的后验均值，无需轨迹积分。异常查询 token 与其恢复正常对应物之间的平方残差作为异常分数，用于像素级密集定位和图像级检测。由于缺乏异常验证样本，采用仅基于正常样本的 Jacobian gain-to-noise 准则选择恢复时间步。
AI.result: 在 MVTec-AD 和 VisA 的 1/2/4-shot 基准以及 Real-IAD 的样本量评测中取得最先进性能。1-shot 下，MVTec-AD 的图像级和像素级 AUROC 分别为 97.8% 和 98.0%；VisA 为 95.3% 和 98.7%，图像级 AUROC 比最强基线提升 2.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Flownomaly 通过冻结特征空间中的正常对应恢复与流匹配，实现了无需异常样本调参的少样本异常检测，为类别特定正常模式建模提供了一种比存储示例或线性结构更灵活的方案。

title: MiD-VLM: Detecting and Grounding Global Semantic Misinformation in Image-Caption Pairs
summary: Semantic misinformation can arise when an authentic image is paired with a caption that changes or distorts its narrative. Because the image itself may contain no visible signs of manipulation, methods designed to detect pixel-level artifacts can miss these misleading image-caption pairs. We study this problem using DGM4+, a dataset designed to evaluate the detection of global scene and semantic inconsistencies. We propose a multimodal model that combines image-text representations from SigLIP with visual scene features from DINOv2 through a projection MLP, and adapts Qwen2-VL-7B using LoRA. The model jointly predicts whether an image-caption pair is authentic, identifies the manipulation type, and grounds the misleading caption tokens. On the DGM4+ validation split, the model achieves an F1 score of $0.9679$ for binary authenticity classification. These results suggest that parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language models is promising for detecting semantic inconsistencies, while also motivating further work on precise token-level grounding.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种多模态模型，用于检测真实图像与被操纵说明之间产生的语义错误信息，并预测真伪、操纵类型及误导性词元位置。
AI.motivation: 传统检测依赖图像像素级篡改痕迹的方法难以发现“图像本身真实但说明文字歪曲叙事”的语义错误信息，因此需要关注全局场景和图文语义不一致的识别能力。
AI.method: 作者基于 DGM4+ 数据集构建多模态检测模型，融合 SigLIP 的图文表征与 DINOv2 的视觉场景特征，并通过投影 MLP 整合信息；随后使用 LoRA 对 Qwen2-VL-7B 进行参数高效微调，使模型同时判断图文对是否真实、识别操纵类型，并对误导性说明词元进行定位。
AI.result: 在 DGM4+ 验证集上，二分类真伪识别的 F1 分数达到 0.9679，表明该模型能够有效检测语义层面的图文不一致。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效微调的视觉语言模型对检测语义错误信息具有潜力，但词元级精确定位仍需进一步研究和改进。

title: FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
summary: To estimate correspondences across images, existing approaches match either sparse interest points, which is highly efficient but limited by repeatability, or dense pixel grids, which is robust but expensive. Furthermore, these approaches are trained with only matching pairs and thus often fail to reject unrelated pairs that exhibit visual symmetries, which is equally important in applications like Structure-from-Motion (SfM). We bridge these gaps by introducing FlexGlue, a neural network for asymmetric sparse-to-dense matching and disambiguation. Given two images and coordinates of points in the first image, FlexGlue estimates the coordinates of the corresponding points in the second image while simultaneously rejecting the pair if non-matching. By searching for a limited set of correspondences among dense pixels, our approach is both fast and effective at both matching and disambiguation: it combines the sub-pixel accuracy of dense matching with the speed of sparse matching, while rejecting incorrect pairs with high precision. Experiments on multiple datasets show that FlexGlue pushes the Pareto frontier in relative pose estimation and significantly outperforms existing approaches for SfM and visual localization. FlexGlue is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 FlexGlue，一种用于非对称“稀疏到稠密”图像匹配与歧义判别的神经网络：给定首图若干关键点，它在第二图的稠密像素中搜索对应点，并同时判断图像对是否真正匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有跨图对应估计方法各有局限：稀疏兴趣点匹配高效但受重复性限制，稠密像素网格匹配鲁棒但计算昂贵；同时，多数模型仅使用正样本匹配对训练，难以拒绝具有视觉对称性或无关的伪匹配，而这在 Structure-from-Motion 等应用中同样关键。
AI.method: FlexGlue 接收两张图像以及第一张图像中的点坐标，在第二张图像的稠密像素候选中搜索有限数量对应关系，输出匹配点的亚像素坐标；同时引入判别机制，对不匹配的图像对直接拒绝。该方法以非对称方式融合稀疏查询与稠密搜索，从而兼顾稀疏匹配的速度与稠密匹配的精度和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，FlexGlue 在相对位姿估计任务中推高了精度—效率的帕累托前沿，并在 SfM 和视觉定位任务上显著优于现有方法，同时能够高精度拒绝错误匹配图像对。
AI.conclusion: FlexGlue 证明了“稀疏查询 + 稠密候选 + 匹配拒绝”可以在同一框架中同时解决图像匹配、非匹配判别与效率问题，为 SfM 和视觉定位等几何视觉任务提供了更高效鲁棒的对应估计方法。

title: Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining on Multi-Domain Raman Spectra
summary: Raman spectroscopy generates large volumes of unlabeled data that are difficult to exploit with conventional supervised learning. This work introduces a multi-domain self-supervised learning framework based on a masked autoencoder (MAE) for learning transferable Raman spectral representations from heterogeneous biological, chemical, forensic, and materials datasets. The proposed pretraining strategy incorporates physics-aware objectives by combining masked intensity reconstruction with a sparse Voigt-profile decoder that models spectral peak structure through differentiable peak centers, widths, and amplitudes. A denoising objective is further included to improve robustness to spectral corruption. The learned encoder is evaluated on substance classification, component identification, concentration estimation, and spectral denoising under linear probing, attention-based probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and training from scratch. Experimental results show that self-supervised pretraining is most beneficial for challenging tasks with limited labeled data. Attention-based probing also reveals substantially more useful information in the frozen representation than linear probing, indicating that conventional linear evaluation may underestimate representation quality. In addition, the benefits of pretraining become more pronounced with increasing encoder capacity. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates that physics-aware, multi-domain self-supervised pretraining can improve label efficiency, robustness, and transferability across diverse Raman spectroscopy tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出面向拉曼光谱的多域自监督预训练框架，以掩码自编码器为核心，结合物理感知的Voigt峰结构解码和去噪目标，学习可迁移、抗噪且标签高效的拉曼光谱表征。
AI.motivation: 拉曼光谱会产生大量无标签数据，传统监督学习难以充分利用这些数据；同时不同领域的拉曼光谱数据分布差异大，需要一种能提升跨域迁移、鲁棒性和少标签任务性能的通用表征学习方法。
AI.method: 构建基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的多域自监督学习框架，对异构生物、化学、 forensic 和材料拉曼数据进行预训练；预训练目标结合掩码强度重建、稀疏Voigt轮廓解码器（通过可微峰中心、峰宽和峰幅度建模谱峰结构）以及去噪目标，以增强物理一致性和抗腐蚀能力。下游评估包括物质分类、成分识别、浓度估计和谱去噪，并使用线性探测、注意力探测、端到端微调和从头训练等方式比较。
AI.result: 自监督预训练在标签有限或难度较高的任务中最具优势；注意力探测相比线性探测能更有效利用冻结表征，说明线性评估可能低估表征质量；预训练收益随编码器容量增加而更明显，表明该框架可提升标签效率、鲁棒性和跨任务迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知、多域自监督预训练能够显著改善拉曼光谱表征的学习质量，尤其适用于少标签、复杂和跨域应用场景，为拉曼光谱的大规模无标签数据利用提供了有效范式。

title: PaperScorer: How Predictable Is Paper Acceptance?
summary: Automated research is largely evaluated by benchmark performance, but the value of research rarely reduces to a single score. Humans judge a work's holistic contribution through peer review, which is hard to model because it is noisy and depends on many factors. However, what if, given only the paper, we could predict its peer-review decision directly? We introduce PaperScorer, a family of models that predict a paper's accept or reject decision from its extracted text or page screenshots, training only on the decision after removing author identity and formatting shortcuts. Vision models are the most predictive (68% accuracy on ICLR papers and 77% on ML papers from arXiv), beating text-only and frontier reasoning models. Unlike plain text, page images retain figures, layout, and presentation. This signal is robust, surviving smaller models and even compressing the whole paper into a single image. But accurate predictions are not evenly spread. PaperScorer is strongest on the lowest and highest rated papers, while papers rated in the middle stay unpredictable for our models and frontier systems alike. Additionally, its confidence is calibrated, so its most confident predictions are also its most accurate. Overall, PaperScorer shows how much of the decision a paper carries on its own, marking a first step toward AI-driven research evaluation.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PaperScorer，一种仅根据论文文本或页面截图预测其同行评审接收/拒稿决定的模型家族；视觉模型表现最佳，说明论文本身携带了大量评审决策信号。
AI.motivation: 当前自动科研评价多依赖基准分数，但真实科研价值往往由同行评审综合判断。由于评审噪声大、因素复杂且难以建模，作者尝试一个极端问题：在给定论文本身、并去除作者身份与格式捷径后，模型能否直接预测论文的录用/拒绝决定。
AI.method: 作者训练了一组 PaperScorer 模型，输入包括从论文中提取的纯文本和论文页面截图。训练目标是预测同行评审决定，并显式去除作者身份信息和可利用的格式捷径。模型比较包括文本模型、推理模型和视觉模型；输入还包括整篇论文被压缩为单张图像等设置，以检验布局、图表和呈现方式等视觉线索的作用。
AI.result: 视觉模型最具预测能力：在 ICLR 论文上达到 68% 准确率，在来自 arXiv 的机器学习论文上达到 77% 准确率，超过纯文本模型和前沿推理模型。视觉信号较强，能在小模型和单张压缩图像设置下保留信息。但预测效果并非均匀分布：模型在评分最低和最高的论文上最强，对中等评分论文难以预测。模型的置信度具有校准性，高置信预测通常也更准确。
AI.conclusion: PaperScorer 表明论文自身承载了相当比例的评审决策信号，尤其是在视觉呈现与整体质量可区分的论文中。该工作为面向自动科研评价的 AI 系统提供了初步证据，但中等质量论文仍需要更复杂的评价机制。

title: SAGE: Sense-Aligned Multimodal Grounding Evaluation with Gloss-Augmented Reasoning
summary: This paper introduces Sense-Aligned Grounding Evaluation (SAGE), a unified 10-candidate image-selection benchmark that reformulates VWSD, VerSe, and WikiDiverse into a shared term-centric protocol covering noun-, verb-, and entity-centered grounding. SAGE includes confusable hard negatives and a context-swapped VerSe diagnostic to probe target-term grounding beyond direct caption--image compatibility. We further propose Gloss-Augmented Reasoning (GAR), a training-free framework combining definition grounding with constraint-guided semantic verification. Experiments show that strong VWSD performance does not transfer uniformly across grounding settings. With Gemma3-12B, definition augmentation improves all three subsets, while constraint-guided reasoning improves VWSD and yields particularly strong gains on VerSe, but is less effective on WikiDiverse. Combining the two signals achieves the best macro-average performance, improving Hits@1 from 65.90 to 71.22. These results show that SAGE supports both unified evaluation and fine-grained analysis of explicit semantic reasoning across grounding settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SAGE 这一统一的 10 候选图像选择基准，用于评估视觉—语言模型在名词、动词和实体中心条件下的目标词接地能力，并提出训练自由的 GAR 方法，通过定义增强和约束引导语义验证提升显式语义推理效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基准如 VWSD、VerSe 和 WikiDiverse 侧重不同接地形式，难以在统一协议下系统比较模型对目标词的语境理解。论文希望将多种接地任务整合为共享的以词为中心评估框架，并考察模型是否真正依赖目标词含义，而非仅凭标题与图像的直接匹配进行选择。
AI.method: 论文将 VWSD、VerSe 和 WikiDiverse 统一为 10 候选图像选择基准，覆盖名词、动词和实体中心接地，并引入易混淆难负例和 VerSe 的语境交换诊断，以测试模型超越简单图文兼容性的目标词接地能力。同时提出 Gloss-Augmented Reasoning（GAR）框架：一方面引入定义信息辅助目标词接地，另一方面通过约束引导语义验证候选图像是否符合词义与上下文限制，且无需模型训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，在 VWSD 上表现优秀的模型不一定能均匀迁移到其他接地设置。以 Gemma3-12B 为例，定义增强能提升三个子集上的表现；约束引导推理能提升 VWSD，并在 VerSe 上带来显著增益，但在 WikiDiverse 上效果较弱。结合定义增强与约束引导推理后，宏观平均性能最佳，Hits@1 从 65.90 提升到 71.22。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 能够作为统一评估工具，支持对不同接地设置下的显式语义推理进行细粒度分析；GAR 中的定义信息与约束验证具有互补性，但不同接地任务对两类信号敏感程度不同，说明目标词接地评估需要区分名词、动词和实体场景下的语义推理机制。

title: EgoForesight: Effectively Scaling Policy Learning with Noisy Egocentric Actions
summary: Scaling policy learning requires broad experience and reliable supervision. Robot demonstrations provide high-quality trajectory supervision but are costly to collect. Egocentric videos broaden task and environment coverage, yet motion reconstruction and retargeting introduce noisy action labels. To address this challenge, we introduce EgoForesight, a vision-language-action framework that learns jointly from both sources by reducing the influence of unreliable action labels and exploiting demonstrated outcomes as complementary supervision. A joint vision-action flow couples future visual representation prediction with action generation, unifying reliability-aware action learning with outcome-informed representation transfer. Specifically, reliability-conditioned corruption allocates action supervision across noise levels according to source reliability, while reliability-weighted regression regulates each source's contribution. Complementing this treatment of noisy labels, privileged-future representation distillation draws supervision from demonstrated outcomes. An exponential-moving-average teacher observes the current scene and clean future to encode action-relevant structure from the resulting scene change. Its deeper representations supervise an earlier student layer receiving a corrupted future, providing outcome-informed structure beyond noisy action annotations. Together, these mechanisms support effective scaling with noisy egocentric actions. Over the tested range, EgoForesight exhibits steeper scaling slopes than the baseline, reducing real-world open-loop action MSE by 20.5% and improving RoboCasa few-shot success by 8.1 percentage points at 30,000 hours of pretraining data. After post-training, it also achieves strong absolute performance in both simulated and real-world dexterous manipulation.
comment: Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: EgoForesight 提出一种联合利用机器人演示与第一视角视频的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过可靠性感知动作学习和基于未来结果的表示蒸馏，缓解第一视角动作标签噪声，实现可扩展策略学习并提升真机与仿真灵巧操作性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模策略学习需要广泛经验与可靠监督：机器人演示质量高但采集昂贵；第一视角视频覆盖任务和环境更广，但运动重建与动作重映射会引入噪声动作标签。如何同时利用两类数据并抑制不可靠动作监督，是核心问题。
AI.method: EgoForesight 采用联合视觉-动作流，将未来视觉表示预测与动作生成耦合。其可靠性条件化腐蚀按不同数据源可靠性分配不同噪声水平的动作监督；可靠性加权回归控制各源贡献。同时，特权未来表示蒸馏使用演示中的干净未来作为监督：由当前场景和干净未来构成教师模型，编码动作相关场景变化结构，并监督接收腐蚀未来的学生较早层。
AI.result: 在测试范围内，EgoForesight 相比基线具有更陡的 scaling 斜率；在 30,000 小时预训练数据下，真机开环动作 MSE 降低 20.5%，RoboCasa few-shot 成功率提高 8.1 个百分点。经后训练后，在仿真和真灵巧操作任务中也取得较强绝对性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠性感知的动作监督与未来结果导向的表示蒸馏，EgoForesight 能有效利用噪声第一视角动作并互补高质量演示，推动视觉-语言-动作策略在大规模数据下的可扩展学习。

title: Scaling Transformer Energy-based Models For High Quality Image Synthesis
summary: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositional generation and inference-time scaling, where sample quality can be refined simply by increasing sampling steps. However, severe challenges in high-dimensional sampling and training instabilities with deep architectures have restricted EBMs to low-dimensional regimes. To resolve these bottlenecks, we introduce the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), a scalable transformer energy function operating entirely within a latent space. On top of this backbone, we extract energies at multiple layers and sum them, composing complementary constraints from local texture to global semantics. Furthermore, two components make this high-quality at scale: Positive Representation Alignment (PRA), which supervises TEM's intermediate representations with a vision foundation model, and advanced sampling strategies that improve sample quality at inference. TEM-XL achieves an FID-50K of 3.82 on class-conditional ImageNet 256$\times$256 without classifier-free guidance, showing that a contrastive EBM can generate high-fidelity images. On ImageNet 512$\times$512, TEM achieves an FID-50K of 8.24, demonstrating that the approach scales to higher resolution. We further validate the core promises of EBMs: compositional generation, zero-shot inpainting, and out-of-distribution detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Transformer Energy-Based Model（TEM），通过在潜空间中构建可扩展的多层 Transformer 能量函数，并结合正表征对齐与改进采样策略，使基于能量的生成模型首次在 ImageNet 高分辨率图像生成中实现高保真结果，并验证了组合生成、零样本修复和分布外检测能力。
AI.motivation: 能量模型具有将概率建模与生成过程解耦的灵活性，天然支持组合生成和推理时扩展；但传统 EBM 在高维图像采样和深层网络训练上不稳定，限制了其扩展到高分辨率真实图像生成。本文旨在解决这一可扩展性与训练稳定性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 TEM：完全在潜空间中运行的 Transformer 能量函数；从多个层提取能量并求和，以融合局部纹理和全局语义约束；引入 Positive Representation Alignment，用视觉基础模型监督 TEM 的中间表征；并采用先进采样策略提升推理阶段生成质量。
AI.result: TEM-XL 在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上取得 FID-50K 3.82，且不使用 classifier-free guidance；在 ImageNet 512×512 上取得 FID-50K 8.24，表明方法可扩展到更高分辨率。实验还验证了组合生成、零样本 inpainting 和 out-of-distribution detection 等 EBM 核心能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过潜空间 Transformer 架构、多层能量组合、表征对齐与更强采样策略，基于能量的对比模型可以突破高维生成限制，实现高分辨率图像生成并保留 EBM 在组合与推理时扩展方面的独特优势。

title: VisFlow: Interpretable Flow Matching for Visibility Reconstruction, Characterization, and Recognition
summary: Methods for learning continuous representations, such as latent manifolds, are fundamental and ubiquitous in modern machine learning. Yet many geometric objects combine continuous shape information with discrete combinatorial structure. This combination presents a fundamental challenge for representation learning because small geometric perturbations can induce abrupt changes in the underlying discrete representation. As a result, the smoothness assumptions that make continuous representations effective no longer hold. Polygons provide a canonical example. Their vertex locations vary continuously, but infinitesimal changes in geometry can dramatically alter the associated visibility graph. Existing methods address the inverse mapping from visibility graphs to polygon geometry using vertex-, triangulation-, or signed-distance-function (SDF)-based representations. Vertex- and triangulation-based approaches construct polygons through explicit geometric operations. However, they are less effective at modeling the relationship between geometry and visibility. SDF-based approaches capture this relationship more naturally. Their intermediate states, however, do not correspond to explicit stages of polygon construction. We present VisFlow, a novel, interpretable flow formulation that combines continuous SDF representations with explicit polygon evolution. We evaluate VisFlow on Visibility Reconstruction and Visibility Characterization. Visibility Reconstruction generates one polygon consistent with a visibility graph (G), while Visibility Characterization characterizes all such polygons. VisFlow maintains 20% more visibility relations on Visibility Reconstruction and improves coverage by 30% on Visibility Characterization compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisFlow，一种结合连续符号距离函数表示与显式多边形演化过程的可解释流模型，用于从可见性图反向生成多边形，并在可见性重建与可见性表征任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 连续表示学习在现代机器学习中广泛使用，但许多几何对象同时包含连续形状信息与离散组合结构。微小的几何扰动可能导致底层离散结构发生突变，破坏连续表示所依赖的平滑性假设。以多边形为例，顶点位置连续变化，但可见性图会因几何的微小改变而发生剧烈变化。现有方法通过顶点表示、三角剖分或符号距离函数将可见性图映射回多边形几何：顶点和三角剖分方法通过显式几何操作构造多边形，但难以建模几何与可见性之间的关系；SDF 方法更自然地捕捉这种关系，但其中间状态不对应多边形构造的显式阶段，解释性不足。
AI.method: 作者提出 VisFlow，一种新的可解释流公式，将连续 SDF 表示与显式多边形演化相结合。该方法不仅保留 SDF 对几何—可见性关系的良好表达能力，还通过显式的多边形演化阶段增强中间状态的可解释性。模型在两类任务上进行评估：Visibility Reconstruction，即根据给定可见性图 G 生成一个与之相容的多边形；Visibility Characterization，即刻画所有满足该可见性图的多边形。
AI.result: 与当前最先进方法相比，VisFlow 在可见性重建任务中能够维持更多可见性关系，提升约 20%；在可见性表征任务中改善覆盖能力约 30%，说明其能更准确、更全面地表示与给定可见性图相容的多边形几何空间。
AI.conclusion: VisFlow 通过融合连续 SDF 表示和显式多边形演化，缓解了几何连续性与离散可见性结构之间的建模冲突，提高了可解释性并显著增强了从可见性图重建和表征多边形几何的能力。该工作表明，将连续表示与显式结构阶段结合是处理几何—组合耦合问题的一种有效路径。

title: Rethinking Representation Geometry in Supervised Contrastive Learning under Long-Tailed Data
summary: Supervised contrastive learning and its balanced variants have demonstrated their effectiveness for representation learning under long-tailed distributions. However, although prior analyses suggest that their optimal representations may exhibit a regular simplex geometry, whether such a geometry is indeed exhibited remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we present a theoretical framework for these objectives that characterizes whether a regular simplex is formed at the optimum. By applying this to representative objectives, we show that these objectives fail to form a regular simplex at the optimum because they remain dependent on the number of samples per class. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce structural balancing that can be applied to contrastive objectives, and propose a fully balanced contrastive objective that provably forms a regular simplex geometry at its optimum. Both theoretical and empirical results demonstrate that the proposed method yields a more balanced representation space and improves performance on long-tailed recognition and transfer learning tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个理论框架，分析监督对比学习及其平衡变体在长尾分布下是否能在学习最优解形成正单形（regular simplex）几何结构，并指出已有目标往往受每类样本数影响而无法实现该几何；随后提出一种“结构平衡”方法和完全平衡的对比目标，可在最优解上被证明形成正单形，并在长尾识别与迁移学习中取得更均衡表示和更好性能。
AI.motivation: 监督对比学习及其平衡变体在长尾分布表示学习中有效，但先前分析暗示其最优表示可能呈现正单形几何，然而是否真正形成这种几何仍不清楚。理解这一几何是否成立有助于判断目标函数是否真正消除了类别不平衡带来的偏置。
AI.method: 首先建立理论框架，刻画不同监督对比目标在最优解处是否满足正单形几何条件。将该框架应用于代表性目标后发现，这些目标仍依赖每类样本数，因此不能在学习最优解处形成正单形。受此启发，引入结构平衡机制，并提出一个完全平衡的对比目标，从理论上证明其在最优解处可形成正单形表示几何。
AI.result: 理论与实验结果表明，所提出的完全平衡对比目标能够形成更均衡的表示空间，并在长尾识别和迁移学习任务上提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 监督对比学习的平衡变体并不天然消除样本数依赖，也不一定形成正单形几何；通过结构平衡设计完全平衡目标，可以从理论和实践上实现更理想的等距等角表示几何，从而改善长尾表示学习。

title: X-Dubbing: Speech-to-Speech Translation under Temporal and Visual Constraints
summary: Cross-lingual dubbing aims to convert source speech into target-language speech that remains synchronized with the original video. The key to this task is to produce a faithful translation that is naturally speakable within the source timing, which is non-trivial because languages differ in duration, rhythm, and articulation. In this paper, we propose X-Dubbing, which formulates the task as a joint problem of time-aware speech-to-text translation and video-aware text-to-speech. Specifically, our method consists of a Dubbing Translator that generates temporally structured scripts and a Voice Actor that renders them in synchrony with the source video, both grounded in a language-agnostic timing budget. We further refine the translator with dubbing-aware feedback from the synthesized speech, encouraging scripts that yield well-synchronized dubbing. This design requires no paired dubbing data, as the two components are trained on speech-text and monolingual audio-visual data respectively. Extensive experiments show that X-Dubbing outperforms recent baselines across diverse metrics, including isochrony and audio-visual correspondence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 X-Dubbing，将跨语言配音拆解为“时间感知的语音到文本翻译”和“视频感知的文本到语音合成”两个联合任务，以在无需配对配音数据的情况下实现同步、自然的跨语言视频配音。
AI.motivation: 跨语言配音需要在保持翻译忠实性的同时，使目标语言语音在源视频时间轴内自然可说；由于不同语言在时长、节奏和发音上存在差异，这一约束难以仅通过传统翻译或合成满足。
AI.method: X-Dubbing 包含两个核心模块：Dubbing Translator 生成具有时间结构的脚本，Voice Actor 基于源视频将脚本合成为同步语音。二者共享语言无关的时间预算（timing budget），并通过合成语音反馈进一步优化翻译器，使其生成更易同步、更适合配音的脚本。该框架分别利用语音-文本数据和单语音视频数据进行训练，不依赖成对配音数据。
AI.result: 在多样指标上的广泛实验表明，X-Dubbing 优于近期基线方法，尤其在等时性（isochrony）和音视频对应关系（audio-visual correspondence）方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过把跨语言配音建模为时间约束下的联合翻译与合成任务，并结合配音感知反馈优化，显著提升了配音同步性和自然度，提供了一种无需配对配音数据的有效方案。

title: TTT in VLA Models: Exploring Training with Human Demonstrations
summary: Long-horizon robot tasks require retaining and using past information. We integrate Test-Time Training (TTT), which stores context in fast weights, into InternVLA-A1 and Pi0.5 to study action generation conditioned on human demonstrations through training on paired demonstrations and robot trajectories. We implement memory transfer between the two phases and truncated backpropagation, and examine training objectives, gradient coverage, and contrastive regularization across video, short-video, and single-frame cue tasks. In our experiments, adding TTT and training on paired data at the current scale did not lead to consistent target selection based on demonstrations. Under the tested settings, shorter sequences, full trajectory gradient connectivity, and contrastive regularization did not clearly improve responsiveness to demonstrations. When demonstrations were reduced to single-frame cues, real-robot execution still showed a preference for cups at fixed positions. We document the implementation, training configurations, and observations to support further inspection and replication.
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, a techreport form standard-robots company

AI.tldr: 本文将测试时训练（Test-Time Training, TTT）中的“快权重”上下文记忆机制整合进 InternVLA-A1 和 Pi0.5，探究在长时序机器人任务中能否通过配对的人类演示与机器人轨迹训练，使动作生成更稳定地受演示条件约束；实验总体显示该方案在当前规模下未带来一致的基于演示的目标选择效果。
AI.motivation: 长时序机器人任务需要模型保留并利用过去信息。现有视觉-语言-动作模型在依赖人类演示进行动作条件化方面仍具挑战，因此作者希望引入 TTT，将上下文存储到快权重中，并研究跨阶段记忆传递、梯度覆盖和对比正则化等因素是否能提升模型对演示的响应能力。
AI.method: 作者将 TTT 集成到 InternVLA-A1 和 Pi0.5 两个模型中，并使用配对的人类演示与机器人轨迹进行训练。具体包括实现两阶段之间的记忆传递和截断反向传播；同时围绕训练目标、梯度覆盖范围以及对比正则化，在视频、短视频和单帧提示任务上进行考察。实验还关注不同长度输入序列和真实机器人执行条件下的表现。
AI.result: 在当前实验规模与设置下，加入 TTT 并使用配对数据训练并未使模型形成稳定的、基于演示的目标选择能力。缩短序列长度、实现完整轨迹梯度连通以及引入对比正则化，都没有显著提升模型对演示的响应性。当演示被压缩为单帧提示时，真实机器人执行仍表现为偏好固定位置上的杯子，说明条件化行为尚不充分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作主要报告了一项负结果与实现细节：TTT 快权重机制在 VLA 模型中的初步集成能够支持上下文存储，但不足以让模型在机器人动作生成中稳定利用人类演示信息。作者公开实现、训练配置与观察结果，为后续检查、复现和进一步改进演示条件化策略提供依据。

title: Playing Bias: Epistemic Games for Interpreting Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems do not merely render prompts; they circulate defaults for "what X looks like," shaping recognition through pose, camera, costume, props, and setting. While technical audits quantify disparities, they rarely cultivate the literacy needed to argue how images assemble stereotypes and confer authority. This paper translates a three-stage, humanities-informed framework into a set of epistemic games that make this cultural work visible and debatable: Interpret (art-historical close looking with AI outputs), Interrogate (counter-intent prompting as artistic exploration), and Expose (creative misuse through paired prompts with a constant motif and a BiasSlot rule, in which only the bias cue varies). In a pilot with undergraduate fine-arts students, the games shifted discussion from impressionistic reactions to concise, warranted hypotheses grounded in visual evidence, supported by lightweight classroom instruments that enabled reproducibility and structured collaboration. We argue that such game-based approaches foster critical literacy across educational contexts, equipping learners to recognize, discuss, and contest how T2I models encode bias.
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at iLRN 2026, the 12th International Conference of the Immersive Learning Research Network, Athens, Greece, June 2026. Video presentation: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向文生图（T2I）系统偏见的“认知游戏”教学框架，通过“解读—质疑—暴露”三阶段活动，帮助学习者把图像中的刻板印象与权威建构转化为可观察、可辩论、可复现的视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图偏见审计大多停留在量化差异层面，缺少能够培养批判性图像素养的教学工具。学习者往往难以系统论证图像如何通过姿态、镜头、服装、道具和场景等元素组装刻板印象并赋予其文化权威。
AI.method: 论文将一种人文取向的三阶段框架转译为一组课堂化的“认知游戏”：Interpret（对AI生成图像进行艺术史式细读）、Interrogate（以反向或对抗性提示作为艺术探索）、Expose（固定母题的成对提示实验，通过BiasSlot规则仅改变偏见线索以揭示差异）。随后在本科美术学生中开展试点，并设计轻量级课堂工具以支持可复现性和结构化协作。
AI.result: 试点结果显示，这些游戏使课堂讨论从印象式反应转向基于视觉证据的简洁且有依据的假设，同时课堂工具有助于实现重复操作、比较观察和协作分析。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，游戏化的批评性教学能够促进跨教育场景的AI图像素养，使学习者学会识别、讨论并挑战文生图模型中所编码的偏见。

title: $Ψ$-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
summary: Humans reason about the physical world by flexibly combining different forms of inference as a problem unfolds. Achieving this flexibility is a major open challenge in AI: capabilities often remain separated across specialized models, limiting how they can be composed and jointly adapted to a task. We introduce $\Psi$-0.6, a unified vision-language world model that adaptively composes perception, language, geometry, and simulation within a shared reasoning process we call streams of thought. These streams interleave images, text, and explicit representations of geometry and motion, all of which the model can generate and interpret through a shared token interface. $\Psi$-0.6 surpasses leading open-weight models zero-shot on multi-view spatial reasoning, with further gains from reasoning through geometric intermediates. It also supports counterfactual simulation: generating and interpreting imagined scenes to determine, for example, whether moving an object would obstruct a pathway. Reinforcement learning from task feedback jointly optimizes the selection, generation, and use of intermediate representations, improving visual question-answering accuracy with gains that transfer to unseen benchmarks. $\Psi$-0.6 offers a path toward adaptive physical reasoning -- not only predicting the physical world but also choosing the representations through which to reason.

AI.tldr: Ψ-0.6 是一个统一视觉-语言世界模型，可在同一推理过程中自适应组合感知、语言、几何与仿真，并通过图像、文本、几何和运动表示交织的“思维流”提升物理空间推理与反事实模拟能力。
AI.motivation: 人类能在问题展开时灵活组合不同推理形式，而当前 AI 能力常分散在专用模型中，难以协同组合和联合适配；本文旨在构建统一模型以实现自适应物理推理。
AI.method: 提出 Ψ-0.6，用共享 token 接口生成和解释图像、文本、几何与运动表示，形成 interleaved “streams of thought”；通过几何中间表示进行推理，并用任务反馈的强化学习联合优化中间表示的选择、生成与使用。
AI.result: 在零样本多视角空间推理上超过领先开源权重模型，几何中间推理带来进一步提升；支持生成和解释想象场景进行反事实模拟，例如判断移动物体是否阻塞路径；视觉问答准确率提升，且增益可迁移到未见基准。
AI.conclusion: Ψ-0.6 展示了通向自适应物理推理的路径：不仅预测物理世界，还能主动选择用于推理的中间表示，实现更灵活、可组合和可迁移的世界建模。

title: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种风险鲁棒的神经架构搜索迁移方法，通过结合稀疏源任务日志与零成本代理指标，利用冠军模型初始化和成对排序器联合预训练，降低跨任务迁移中的最坏情况失败风险。
AI.motivation: 神经架构搜索成本高昂，跨任务知识迁移可降低成本，但现有方法在搜索历史稀疏以及任务特定迁移失败的情况下表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出风险鲁棒策略，将稀疏源任务日志与零成本代理指标结合，采用基于冠军模型的初始化，并进行成对排序器的联合预训练，以增强迁移稳定性并降低最坏情况风险。
AI.result: 在 TransNAS-Bench-101 上，该方法显著缓解严重最坏情况失败：Micro autoencoding 的 worst-10% 排名从 290 提升至 43，Macro room layout 从 465 提升至 45。在 13 个 cell-space 目标中，该方法在 10 个目标上的平均性能和最坏情况性能均优于仅使用代理指标的排序器，同时保持有竞争力的平均表现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过整合稀疏迁移知识、零成本代理和成对排序预训练，提高了 NAS 跨任务迁移的鲁棒性，尤其有效降低了任务特定迁移失败带来的最坏情况风险。

title: ChoreoStudio: Planning What, When, and Who in Music-Driven Group Choreography
summary: Music-driven group dance generation must decide not only how each dancer moves, but also what formation the group should form, when it should change, and who should execute each transition. Existing methods can generate orderly and rhythmically synchronized group motion, but remain limited in formation evolution and inter-dancer interaction. In human choreography, formation transitions often align with changes in high-level musical structure, such as the progression from an introduction to a chorus or from a chorus to a climax. We present ChoreoStudio, which makes choreography planning explicit. A music disentangler first decomposes the audio into frame-level rhythmic features and segment-level structural features. Given the segment-level features and sparse labels, a frozen omni-modal model acts as a scriptwriter, producing a global semantic description that guides the Director's choreography planning. Based on this context, the Director produces three coupled interaction decisions: a centroid-relative point set specifies what formation to produce, a transition gate determines when it should change, and a mobility allocation indicates who should execute the transition. The transition gate and mobility allocation are further conditioned on the planned geometric change, coupling formation targets with their temporal and dancer-specific execution. At a finer temporal scale, frame-aligned music features condition the diffusion generator to control detailed body motion and preserve beat-level alignment. The segment-level interaction plan is injected in parallel through frame-aligned instruction tokens and cross-dancer attention biases, coordinating how the generator realizes each transition. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChoreoStudio follows the planned interactions while achieving state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, group organization, and formation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ChoreoStudio，一种面向音乐驱动群体舞蹈生成的编舞显式规划框架，能够同时决定群体队形、队形切换时机、舞者执行分工以及细粒度动作节奏，并在 AIOZ-GDance 上取得更优的舞蹈质量、组织性和队形动态性。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐驱动群体舞蹈生成方法虽然可以产生整齐且与节奏同步的运动，但通常只关注个体动作生成，对“群体应该形成什么队形”“队形何时变化”“哪些舞者负责执行队形转换”等高层编舞决策建模不足。人类编舞中，队形转换往往对应音乐段落结构变化，如从引入到副歌、从副歌到高潮，因此需要将音乐高层结构显式纳入群体编舞规划。
AI.method: 方法包含三个主要层次。首先，音乐解耦模块将音频分解为帧级节奏特征和段级结构特征。其次，利用段级音乐特征和少量标注，让冻结的多模态模型作为“编剧”生成全局语义描述，再由“导演”模块进行显式编舞规划，输出三类耦合决策：以质心为参照的点集决定队形，切换门控决定队形变化时间，机动性分配决定由哪些舞者执行转换；其中切换门控和分配还依赖于计划中的几何变化，从而将队形目标与时间和执行者绑定。最后，在更细的时间尺度上，帧对齐的音乐特征条件化扩散生成器以控制身体动作并保持节拍同步，同时段级交互计划通过帧对齐指令 token 和跨舞者注意力偏置并行注入，协调生成器实现每个队形转换。
AI.result: 在 AIOZ-GDance 数据集上的实验表明，ChoreoStudio 能够遵循规划出的群体交互结构，并在动作质量、群体组织性和队形动态变化方面达到当前最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 该论文说明，音乐驱动群体舞蹈生成不应仅停留在逐帧动作同步层面，而应显式建模高层编舞结构。通过解耦音乐的节奏与段落结构，并引入全局语义规划、队形目标、切换时机和执行分工等联合决策，ChoreoStudio 实现了更具编舞语义和群体协作性的舞蹈生成，为复杂群体舞蹈生成提供了新的框架。

title: Online Continual Learning in Edge-Cloud Applications
summary: Deployed machine learning models in real-world IoT and edge/cloud systems face a critical reliability bottleneck: the requirement for online adaptation to non-stationary data streams while operating without access to the full original training dataset. Performance is severely degraded when models encounter Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs or suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Addressing these challenges requires adaptation mechanisms capable of learning from evolving data streams while preserving previously acquired knowledge. This paper proposes an edge-cloud methodology for integrating Continual Learning (CL) with Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection and Concept Drift Detection in IoT applications. The methodology incorporates ODIN and ECDD as alternative mechanisms for identifying informative samples for annotation and triggering rehearsal-based model updates. Experimental results across automotive, healthcare, and agricultural datasets demonstrate the applicability of the proposed methodology and its potential to support model adaptation while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向物联网边云系统的持续学习方法，将OOD检测、概念漂移检测与训练集重演更新相结合，以在无完整原始数据条件下应对非平稳数据流和灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 部署在现实IoT和边云系统中的机器学习模型常面临非平稳数据流、分布外输入和灾难性遗忘等问题，且通常无法访问完整原始训练数据，导致在线自适应可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出边云协同方法，将持续学习、OOD检测与概念漂移检测集成到IoT应用中；使用ODIN和ECDD作为替代机制识别有标注价值的样本，并触发基于重演的模型更新，从而在模型演化过程中保留已学知识。
AI.result: 在汽车、医疗和农业数据集上的实验表明，该方法具有适用性，能够支持模型对变化数据流的适应，并在一定程度上缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 将OOD/概念漂移检测与重演式持续学习相结合，可为缺乏完整原始训练数据的边云IoT系统提供更可靠的在线模型自适应方案，但仍需通过更广泛实验验证其实际部署效果和鲁棒性。

title: From Perception to Pixels: Human-Derived Visually Distinct Colors for Improved Dominant Color Extraction
summary: Dominant color extraction is a fundamental task in computer vision, with applications in design, image retrieval, and content recommendation. However, conventional algorithms based on device-oriented color spaces (e.g., RGB) and fixed quantization often fail to capture how humans perceive color differences. In this study, we propose a human-perception-based framework for dominant color extraction, built on a novel Human Color Dictionary (HCD) derived from a perceptual experiment. Participants (n=110) were sequentially shown 120 colors and asked to identify those they perceived as unique. Based on their responses, we constructed a 120 by 120 co-occurrence matrix and applied a greedy selection algorithm to derive 64 perceptually distinct colors, forming the HCD. This dictionary was integrated into RGB color histogram and K-means color extraction algorithms by initializing centroids and mapping pixel values to their nearest perceptual color using the deltaE 00 distance. Evaluation on a dataset of 4,562 images paired with expert-designed palettes demonstrated that our method improves perceptual alignment, as measured by Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) and best-match distance. Our findings suggest no meaningful gender differences in the number of uniquely perceived colors, indicating that sex does not significantly influence color perception in this task. Another key finding is that highly saturated colors are perceived as the most distinguishable, whereas dark and deep colors tend to perceptually collapse and are less reliably differentiated. The results confirm that incorporating experimentally derived human color representations ensures the generated color clusters align more closely with human perception, thus improving the usability of color palette generation in practical applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于人类颜色感知的主观化主色提取框架，通过实验构建包含64种颜色的人类颜色词典（HCD），并将其融入RGB直方图与K-means算法，从而提升生成色板与人类感知的一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统主色提取方法通常依赖面向设备的颜色空间（如RGB）和固定量化方式，难以准确反映人类对颜色差异的真实感知，导致提取出的主色或色板在视觉直观性和应用可用性上存在不足。
AI.method: 研究通过一项感知实验构建人类颜色词典：邀请110名参与者依次观看120种颜色，并判断哪些颜色具有独特感知；随后基于回答构建120×120共现矩阵，并采用贪心选择算法筛出64种在感知上最具区分度的颜色，形成HCD。将该词典整合进RGB颜色直方图和K-means主色提取算法，包括初始化聚类中心，并利用CIEDE2000颜色差异距离将像素映射到最近的人类感知颜色。最后在包含4,562张图像及专家设计色板的数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能更好地对齐人类颜色感知，在Earth Mover’s Distance（EMD）和最佳匹配距离等指标上优于传统方法。此外，研究还发现参与者在独特感知颜色数量上不存在显著性别差异；高饱和度颜色更容易被区分，而深色和颜色较深的颜色更容易发生感知合并，区分稳定性较低。
AI.conclusion: 将实验获得的人类颜色表征引入主色提取过程，可使生成的颜色聚类更符合人类主观感知，从而提高自动色板生成在图像检索、设计、内容推荐等实际应用中的可用性与有效性。

title: Shared Is Not Enough: Predictor Width and Factor Readability Under Masked Latent Prediction
summary: Masked latent prediction methods such as I-JEPA aim to learn predictable features, but what determines which information they retain is less clear. We built a simulator in which every factor behind an image is known, so a probe can measure how readable each factor remains after training. We trained small encoders (0.7M parameters) with I-JEPA, SimCLR and BYOL on the same pairs of views and probed a factor that both views share. I-JEPA had a predictor with half the encoder's width and depth, the proportions it uses for ViT-B. Its median score was about 40% of SimCLR's. Widening the predictor to the encoder's width reversed this ordering at every training seed, against both other methods. We release the simulator and the trained models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种可控模拟器与探测（probe）框架，用来量化自监督学习（SSL）训练后图像背后潜在因子在表征中的“可读性”；实验表明，I-JEPA 的 predictor 宽度/容量会显著影响其保留共享因子的能力，将 predictor 扩展到与 encoder 同宽后可超过 SimCLR 和 BYOL。
AI.motivation: 掩码潜预测（masked latent prediction）方法如 I-JEPA 旨在学习可预测特征，但其究竟保留哪些信息、哪些因素决定信息的可读性仍不清晰。现有真实图像难以精确得知所有生成因子，因此需要可控模拟器来系统评估不同 SSL 方法对潜在因子的编码能力。
AI.method: 作者构建一个图像模拟器，其中每个潜在生成因子均已知；训练小规模编码器（约 0.7M 参数），分别使用 I-JEPA、SimCLR 和 BYOL，并在相同视图对上进行训练；通过线性或浅层 probe 测量训练后各因子的可读性，尤其关注两个视图共享的因子。初始 I-JEPA 使用 ViT-B 比例中的半宽、半深 predictor，随后将 predictor 扩展到与 encoder 同宽进行比较。
AI.result: 当 I-JEPA 的 predictor 为 encoder 半宽半深时，其共享因子的中位可读性得分约为 SimCLR 的 40%。将 predictor 宽度扩展到与 encoder 相同后，在每一训练种子上都反转了方法排序，使 I-JEPA 优于其他两种方法。作者还发布了模拟器和训练模型。
AI.conclusion: predictor 的容量，尤其是宽度，是影响掩码潜预测方法保留共享/可预测信息的重要因素；该可控模拟器为 SSL 表征信息保留提供了可诊断、可复现的评估工具。

title: Earth embeddings are decomposable records of the land surface
summary: Ecological monitoring, carbon accounting and biodiversity assessment increasingly rely on annual Earth embeddings--learned vectors that compress a year of satellite observation for every ten-meter pixel on Earth, consumed in place of the imagery itself. What these vectors mean has not been established. Here we decompose two widely used embedding products and show that they contain individual ecological features, including fire, forest clearing and crop type, validated against independent reference data on events across six continents. The recovered concepts date abrupt canopy loss to the first post-disturbance growing season and resolve severity well enough to separate prescribed fire from wildfire. Small fires that recover quickly are detectable in one product but not the other, which instead separates crops more strongly.

AI.tldr: 该研究对两种广泛使用的年度地球嵌入进行可解释性分解，发现它们编码了火灾、森林砍伐和作物类型等独立生态特征，并通过跨六大洲的独立参考数据进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 年度地球嵌入正在成为生态监测、碳核算和生物多样性评估的重要输入，但其语义含义和生态可解释性长期不明确，限制了对其可靠性和适用范围的判断。
AI.method: 作者对两种常用的年度地球嵌入产品进行概念分解或可解释性分析，从中提取与生态事件相关的潜在特征；随后利用六大洲的独立参考事件数据，对恢复出的火灾、森林冠层损失、作物类型等概念进行验证与比较。
AI.result: 结果表明，这些嵌入并非不可解释的黑箱表征，而是包含可用于识别火灾、森林砍伐和作物类型的生态概念。恢复出的概念能够将突发性冠层损失定位到扰动后的第一个生长季，并且严重程度分辨力足以区分计划火烧与野火。两种产品侧重不同：一个产品可检测快速恢复的小火，另一个产品则对作物类型分离更强。
AI.conclusion: 年度地球嵌入中确实存在可验证、可解释的生态信号，但不同产品在概念敏感度和适用范围上存在显著差异；因此，在将其用于生态监测、碳核算或生物多样性评估时，需要结合独立参考数据进行验证，并关注其语义偏置和检测能力边界。

title: Computational imaging through turbid, bubbly and flowing water near the telescope
summary: Cameras in the surf zone or behind ship wakes look through turbid, bubbly, moving water close to the lens, yet restoration networks are usually scored only on displayed images. We introduce a measured dataset of a telescope viewing displayed images and physical objects through a 25~mm water layer 45~mm in front of its objective, under seven combinations of flow, bubbles and turbidity, with clear-water recordings as a second reference. Because the suspension scatters light far outside the 1.3\textdegree{} field of view, turbidity mainly removes contrast, 4.4- to 4.8-fold on a Siemens star. Restoring the mean of eight frames improves structural similarity (SSIM) by 0.032 over a single frame, and learned fusion of the frames adds little. One raw frame supports five-category recognition (96.8\%) as well as restored images. Adding synthetic training pairs leaves display-image scores unchanged but raises the correlation of a restored Siemens star with its clear-water recording from below 0.5 to above 0.9.
